bluejetty:00152023:ios.name: BasketBlitz: Basketball Game
bluejetty:00152023:ios.summary: Step onto the court and show your basketball skills in this fast, exciting, and easy-to-learn game. Every stage gives you a new place to shoot, new paths to read, and new chances to score. The action is simple but feels rewarding as you aim
bluejetty:00152023:ios.description:
Step onto the court and show your basketball skills in this fast, exciting, and easy-to-learn game. Every stage gives you a new place to shoot, new paths to read, and new chances to score. The action is simple but feels rewarding as you aim carefully and send the ball straight toward the hoop. Every shot helps you grow as a player and understand the rhythm of the game.
Hold, aim, and swipe to shoot the ball into the basket while avoiding different moving objects that challenge your timing and accuracy. Some levels have spinning blocks, sliding walls, shifting hoops, and narrow openings. You must stay focused, choose the right power, and release your shot at the perfect moment. Even small adjustments make a big difference, and each successful goal feels like a true basketball highlight.
As you rise through the stages, you face opponents who test your timing and make the court more competitive. These rivals react, move, and force you to aim with precision. With every match you complete, you become sharper, quicker, and more confident with your shots. This game rewards smart thinking, strong ball control, and steady hands. Whether you play for a short break or a long run, you always feel progress.
Features:
- Smooth one-touch shooting controls
- Smart rival opponents that challenge your decisions.
- Realistic ball physics for accurate shot behaviour.
- Moving hoops and shifting obstacles that test aim.
- Progressive difficulty that improves your skill.
- Fun basketball stages designed for all ages.
- Clean court layouts for clear visibility.
- Short rounds perfect for quick play.
- Skill-based scoring with clear progression.
- Simple mechanics with deep shot strategy.
How to Play?
- Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to begin aiming your shot.
- Drag the arrow toward the hoop to shape your shooting path.
- Adjust the line to control power, angle, and curve.
- Release your finger to shoot the ball.
- Watch how the ball reacts to physics and obstacles.
- Keep practicing to master difficult levels and beat stronger rivals.
- Learn timing, control, and precision to score baskets consistently.
Are you ready to show your power on the court? Step in, grab the basketball, and take your best shot. Each basket brings you closer to mastering every level, beating tough rivals, and rising to the top. The court is open, the hoop is waiting, and every throw matters.
Start playing now, make your best shot, and become the ultimate basketball champion. Let your skills grow, your aim sharpen, and your confidence rise with every basket you score.

bluejetty:00116749:ios.description:
Mongolian Horse Race – Real-Time Multiplayer Racing
Saddle up and experience the spirit of Mongolia’s legendary horse racing tradition.
Mongolian Horse Race is a competitive online multiplayer game where you race iconic Mongolian horses across breathtaking landscapes in real time.
Race to Victory Across the Steppe
Compete against players from around the world in thrilling 5-player online matches. Choose your horse, master the timing, and sprint to the finish line in high-speed races set in the heart of Mongolia.
Features:
Real-Time Multiplayer Races
Challenge real players in competitive 5-horse races.
Authentic Mongolian Horses
Race with traditional breeds like Соёолон, Азарга, and Их нас—each with their own stats and charm.
Cultural Experience
Immerse yourself in the traditional visuals, music, and racing style of Mongolian Naadam festivals.
Progression & Customization
Upgrade your horses, unlock new gear, and personalize your ride for better performance and style.
Rewards & Leaderboards
Win coins, earn achievements, and rise in the rankings to become a true racing champion.
Free to Play
Start your journey with a free horse and race your way to greatness.
Whether you’re a fan of racing games or looking to experience Mongolian culture in a new way, Mongolian Horse Race delivers fast-paced fun and fierce competition.

bluejetty:00017924:ios.description:
Focus Taiwan’s free news app is the top source of English-language coverage of all things Taiwan, from breaking news to politics, business, technology, sports, culture and much more.
The updated app maintains a similar look to the Focus Taiwan website, but also has a "Media" section, which includes a playlist of the latest 30 news stories in audio and video formats.
In addition to scrolling up and down to read articles and lists of news headlines, mobile device users can also swipe right or left to browse different news categories and articles.
The updated app allows users to bookmark articles and videos in the new "My Stories" feature which can be found in the "Menu" section.
Users will be able to choose the font size and layout of the page to suit their reading habits from the "Menu" section and are welcome to leave reviews or contact Focus Taiwan with feedback.

bluejetty:00065901:ios.summary:
Embark on an exhilarating puzzle adventure with Connect Bubbles®, the game that's captivating players worldwide! Join the ranks of puzzle enthusiasts and discover a world of vibrant bubbles, challenging levels, and endless fun. 
With its c
bluejetty:00065901:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating puzzle adventure with Connect Bubbles®, the game that's captivating players worldwide! Join the ranks of puzzle enthusiasts and discover a world of vibrant bubbles, challenging levels, and endless fun. 
With its challenging levels, engaging gameplay, and endless replayability, it's the ultimate puzzle experience for players of all ages.
This is a game filled with challenges and fun. Connect bubbles one by one by moving your finger across the screen to make them disappear. Form groups of three or more neighboring bubbles of the same color to bust them. Aim for the longest connections to get bigger scores.
Immerse Yourself in Puzzle Paradise with these GAME MODES:
- Engage in a thrilling Classic mode with unlimited levels and limited moves per level.
- Race against time in Time Mode, where every second counts.
- Unwind in Zen mode, where you can play endlessly without interruptions.
- Conquer 345 captivating Quest levels filled with special bubbles, multipliers, prizes, and power-ups that will test your IQ and ignite your brainpower.
FEATURES
- Effortless gameplay that's perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
- Feast your eyes on vibrant graphics and captivating animations that bring the bubbles to life.
- Immerse yourself in captivating sound effects and background music that enhance the gameplay.
- Customize your game with a wide range of bubble styles, backgrounds, connectors, and more.
- Track your progress with comprehensive statistics and unlock achievements that celebrate your puzzle prowess.
- Vibrations
- Designed for both Tablets and Phones
- Offline highscores
- Stylus support
- Online leaderboards to compete with people everywhere
- Enjoy seamless gameplay across your devices with Cloud Save, ensuring your progress is always at your fingertips.
TIPS for Puzzle Triumph
- Tap the screen and connect bubbles of the same color one by one.
- Release the drag to make the bubbles burst and earn points.
- You win 10 points for each bubble you connect and additional points if you connect more than 3 bubbles.
- In order to pass from one level to another you have to achieve greater and greater scores.
- At the top of the screen you will find your current score and the score you need to achieve to pass to the next level. 
If you have any technical problems, please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Connect Bubbles!

bluejetty:00145904:ios.description:
Stay Ahead with Every Apple Beta Release
iBeta is your essential companion for tracking Apple's latest beta software updates across all platforms. Whether you're a developer, tech enthusiast, or early adopter, iBeta keeps you informed about every iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and Xcode beta release all in one beautifully designed app.
NSTANT UPDATE NOTIFICATIONS
• Receive push notifications the moment new beta versions are released
• Track both developer betas and public beta releases
• Never miss a critical update or security patch
• Customizable notification preferences
COMPREHENSIVE DEVICE COMPATIBILITY
• Check if your devices support the latest updates instantly
• View compatibility for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV
• Add your personal devices for personalized compatibility insights
• Filter updates to show only compatible versions for your devices
DETAILED UPDATE INFORMATION
• Complete release notes and build numbers
• Beta version history and timelines
• Release dates and signing status
• Direct links to official Apple resources
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Smart device management - track all your Apple devices
• Widget support - stay updated from your home screen
• Dark mode and beautiful interface design
• Multi-language support (English, Arabic, German)
• iCloud sync across all your devices
• Historical data and support duration insights
BETA TRACKING MADE EASY
• Track development cycles and release patterns
• View average support durations for each OS
• Comprehensive timeline charts and statistics
• Compare beta vs. public release schedules
PERFECT FOR
• iOS and macOS developers testing new features
• Beta testers wanting to stay current
• Tech enthusiasts following Apple's development
• IT professionals managing device fleets
• Anyone curious about upcoming Apple features
PRIVACY FIRST
• No account required
• Your device data stays on your device
• Optional iCloud sync for your convenience
• No tracking or analytics
Note to users: Beta is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Apple Inc. All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners.

bluejetty:00066122:ios.name: MaskGun - Online shooting game
bluejetty:00066122:ios.summary:
Join the FPS PVP shooting game with 40+ weapon customization, awesome maps, custom characters and brand-new mode 1v1 mode. MaskGun is Made In India game for all gun games lovers across the world. 
Take the challenge, upgrade your characters
bluejetty:00066122:ios.description:
Join the FPS PVP shooting game with 40+ weapon customization, awesome maps, custom characters and brand-new mode 1v1 mode. MaskGun is Made In India game for all gun games lovers across the world. 
Take the challenge, upgrade your characters, invite your friends who love gun games with easy controls and auto-shooting.
Spectacular FPS PVP shooting game modes for you:
Team Deathmatch: Invite your squad and combat against other teams for a winner takes all team deathmatch. Be tactical and strategic or go on a rampage to reach the kill target.
Rumble: An exciting 5v5, 1v1 and 2v2 modern combat game mode for all levels of shooters with varied choice of weapons including snipers, pistols and shotguns. You can play together with your friends or challenge one of them for a standoff. Engage in some friendly banter with Voice Chat or see your friends in action with the Spectate Mode feature, exclusively unlocked for the popular 1v1 Private Matches. 
Control point: Capture & control three objectives on the map to earn points.
Enjoy the free & immersive PVP FPS gun games with features such as:
► Simple and Easy to Learn Shooter Controls: Get started quickly with auto-shooting.
► Over 40 Modern Combat Guns: Choose your own shooting tactics for battle: sniper, shotgun, machine gun, pistol, or assault rifles
► Nine Maps including Yard, Ryokan, Downtown, Airport, Courtyard, Mayan, Blizzard, Favela, and LightHouse
► Real-Time Friends System: Recruit friends and play with them when they are online in a PVP mode
► Exclusive 1v1 mode: Challenge your friends or other global shooters for a standoff in 1v1 and 2v2 to test your true shooter skills. Rank up the leaderboard and earn Gold for every win.
► Missions and Achievements: Complete missions and achievements to Level Up and Unlock content. Get VIP to boost rewards and progression
► Player Gear Customization: Customize your shooter character using a variety of equipment, masks, armor, and gear. Choose from a variety of guns including sniper 3d, shotgun, pistol etc. Pick a character that suits your personality like gangsters, mobile legends, or fun female agents.
► Free to Play: Play as much as you want, no energy system like in other gun games
► Updated Regularly: New Content, Modes & Maps are being added every month to ensure endless PvP action!
► Global Clan Competitions: Participate in Clan Events with players worldwide. Can your clan dominate and be competitive with globally playing clans?
___
MaskGun is for people that love shooting games and we love your feedback!
Keep those comments coming and send us an email at maskgun@junegaming.com
MaskGun ® is a registered trademark.

bluejetty:00162167:ios.description:
The 16:8 Diet & 18:6 Fasting Timer is a fantastic tool for slimming to achieve weight loss goals through fasting. Fasting has grown in popularity as a way to lose weight, improve health, and increase energy levels. 16:8 Diet & 18:6 Fasting Timer offers an easy and effective way to track fasting progress and stay on track with diet plans! 
The app includes a 16:8 fasting timer, which is one of the most popular fasting methods. This method involves fasting for 16 hours and then eating during an 8-hour window. Furthermore, 16:8 Diet & 18:6 Fasting Timer app offers other fasting options, such as 18:6 and intermittent fasting, which can be more challenging but can also provide greater weight loss benefits.
Benefits of using a fasting tracker app:
•User-friendly interface
The fasting tracker will help you lose weight without counting calories, just mark the beginning and end of fast.
• Different diet plans
Choose a program intermittent diet plan for your level. Pick a program suitable to your skill level - from novice to experienced.
• Fasting tracker
Now you can track the changes your body goes through while fasting with the tracking system. This will help you understand when blood sugar levels are low, high, and when gluconeogenesis and ketosis occur, which is especially useful in the context of a ketogenic diet.
• Track weight loss
The fasting diet app is convenient to weight loss. And keep track of changes in weight loss over time. This is help you form fasthabit intermittent fasting and it will become part of your lifestyle.
• Works offline
You don't need an internet connection to track your fasting diet
With its user-friendly interface, comprehensive tracking features, and supportive community, the 16:8 Diet & 18:6 Fasting Timer app is an excellent tool for anyone serious about losing weight and improving their health through fasting. Users can monitor their progress, set goals, and connect with others who are using the app for advice and support. Overall, this app is sure to help users achieve their weight loss goals and live a healthier, happier life.
Disclaimer
The contents of this app are intended for informational purposes only and not for the purpose of rendering medical advice. If you have any health issues, please consult your doctor before fasting and making any medical decisions

bluejetty:00016687:ios.description:
Play Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 the most delectable match-3 game in a candy wonderland!
If you have a BIG sweet tooth, you’ve hit the sweet spot with the classic gameplay in a rainbow mania of mixed candy drops and lollipops!
Join Jenny on her scrumptious journey to win back the lollipops stolen from the sneaky Marshmallow brothers! Sweeten up the challenge as you crush assorted colorful candies through various quests in beautiful delicious environments, like Lollipop Wood and Fudge Desert.
One of the best casual games for unlimited fun!
HOW TO PLAY
• Swap and match 3 or more candies.
• Remove as many candies in as few moves as possible.
• Create amazing combinations like striped and rainbow candies!
• Earn 3 stars to get more coins.
FEATURES
• Simple and fun match-3 puzzle gameplay
• Hundreds of unique levels with regular updates.
• Various tasty missions, like catch the Marshmallow Brothers, collect various treats and drop sweets to the bottom and much more!
• Create colorful candy combos and use awesome power-ups, like Magic Wand and Honey Stick, to help you with stickier levels.
• Candies can come from all different directions, not just down!
• No time limit so play at your own pace.
• No WiFi required. Enjoy online and offline!
NOTES
• Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 contains ads like banner, interstitial, video and house ads.
• Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like AD FREE and coins.

bluejetty:00172569:ios.description:
With this app you can convert single pages, multiple pages or all pages of a PDF document into images. 
The images can be saved or shared with any app. 
You can choose between JPEG, PNG and HEIC image formats. 
In addition to the desired DPI value, you can also set the maximum pixel value for the width and height of the image.

All pages can be unlocked by a one-time in-app purchase for all PDF documents for an unlimited time. 
The ads can be removed completely and forever via an additional, one-time in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00082157:ios.summary:
Challenge your mind with Suguru, the addictive logic puzzle game! Inspired by Sudoku and Kakuro, Suguru offers a refreshing twist on number puzzles with its unique grid layout and rules.
Suguru & Variants by Logic Wiz is a free entertainin
bluejetty:00082157:ios.description:
Challenge your mind with Suguru, the addictive logic puzzle game! Inspired by Sudoku and Kakuro, Suguru offers a refreshing twist on number puzzles with its unique grid layout and rules.
Suguru & Variants by Logic Wiz is a free entertaining logic game and brain training app, joining a family of Sudoku, Logic games and brain training apps developed by Logic Wiz. THe variants are are entertaining and adding additionl layer of logic and challenge to classic Suguru.The puzzles are beautifully handcrafted.
The variants:
Classic, Killer, Thermo, Palindrome, Arrow, XV, Kropki, Ones, Reflection, Bishop, Even-Odd, German Whispers, Dutch Whispers, Renban lines, Little Unique Killer, Between Lines, Lockout lines, Slingshot, Quadruple, Consecutive, Non-consecutive, Diagonal and Chess Knight
Featuring a clean and intuitive interface, Suguru is easy to learn and play, but hard to master. The game offers various difficulty levels, from beginner to expert, to cater to all skill levels.
The Logic Wiz free apps were chosen as the ‘Best Sudoku app’ and ‘the Best Brain Training app’.
About Suguru:
Suguru is a logic number game. The objective is to fill a board with digits, so that each N size block contains all the digits from 1 to N and adjacent cells in all directions(including diagonally) cannot contain the same digit.
Puzzle Features:
* Beautiful handcrafted boards.
* Difficulty levels from beginner to expert.
* Unique solution to each puzzle.
* All boards designed and created by Logic-Wiz.
Game Features:
* Smart Hints to help and teach.
* Weekly Challenge.
* Gallery game view.
* Play multiple games concurrently.
* Cloud Sync - Synchronize your progress over multiple devices.
* Keep Screen Awake.
* Light and Dark Theme.
* Sticky digit mode.
* Remaining cells of a digit.
* Select multiple cells at once.
* Select multiple cells at distributed locations of the board.
* Multiple pencil marks styles.
* Double notation.
* Auto remove pencil marks.
* Highlight matching digits and pencil marks.
* Multiple error modes.
* Performance tracking for each puzzle.
* Statistics and Accomplishments.
* Unlimited Undo/Redo.
* Various cell marking options- highlights and symbols
* Track and improve solving time.
* Board preview.
* Mobile Phones and Tablets.

bluejetty:00115082:ios.description:
The Nebraska Blue app gives you control over your health care, wherever you are.
Track claims and preauthorizations in real time, find nearby providers, compare costs,
manage prescriptions, and more - putting you in charge, wherever you are. As a BCBSNE member, you can use the app to:
● Find care near you: Need urgent or scheduled care? Get help choosing the best
option.
● Explore pharmacy options: Compare prescription prices and manage your
medications.
● Check care costs: Compare price estimates for procedures at nearby providers.
● Track claims: Get real-time updates on your claims and preauthorizations.
● Access your ID card: View, share, or download your card - with a quick-view
option right on the login screen.
● Share health information: Let others on your plan view your personal health
information - or request access to view theirs.
● Quickly access your account: Use Face ID to sign in instantly - no typing
required.
● Review coverage: See what’s covered and how close you are to meeting your
deductible and out-of-pocket limits.
● View billing information: See statements, track payments, and stay on top of
your premiums.
● Get help fast: Message support directly from the app - even from a claim
screen. Your claim information will be included automatically.

Everyone will find their favorite genre: adventure, action, detective, fantasy, melodrama, comedy, or horror. Pick a new movie online every day. Online lessons without subscription are available for Ukrainian people. There are also children's channels in English and different languages, so the kids will definitely be delighted!

– TV control. Pause live TV shows and rewind commercials while you watch recorded broadcasts. Programs are stored for a few days, so you can watch them later in the record.

Even more great features: 
– One subscription — different devices. Connect different devices to your account. Watch online cinema and online television on several devices simultaneously.
– No commitments. Subscribe in a few clicks and cancel your subscription easily at any time.
– Support service is available 24/7.

bluejetty:00162238:ios.description:
Online Alışverişte Tüm Markalar FLO’da!
FLO uygulaması ile hızlı ve güvenli alışverişin tadına varacaksınız! Adidas, Nike, Puma, Lumberjack, Skechers, New Balance, Hummel, Reebok, Vans, Crocs, Calvin Klein, Vicco, Dockers by Gerli, U.S. Polo ASSN, Kinetix, Polaris, İgor, İnci, Nine West, Badbear, Lotto, Slazenger ve aradığınız diğer tüm markalar burada! İndirim fırsatlarıyla ve kolay ara yüzüyle FLO mobil uygulama sizlere alışverişin kapılarını açıyor!
FLO’layan Kasım İndirimleri Başlıyor!
Yılın en heyecan verici alışveriş günleri geldi. FLO kadın, erkek ve çocuk modasında ayakkabıdan çanta ve spor giyime kadar her kategoride cazip indirimleri erken kasım fırsatı ile sunuyor. Geniş ürün yelpazesiyle dolabınızı yenilemek veya sevdiklerinize hediye almak için muhteşem kasım indirimlerini kaçırmayın!
Markaların En Özel Koleksiyonları
Yerli ve yabancı tüm önemli markaların ürünlerinde en özel koleksiyonlar, trend ürünler ve cazip fiyat avantajları FLO uygulama mağazasında yer alıyor. Nike Air Force, Adidas ayakkabı, en güzel sweatshirt modelleri, trend mont çeşitleri, erkek spor ayakkabı modellerinde yeni sezon ürünler, erkek bot kreasyonları, Crocs terlik çeşitleri, krampon ve daha fazlası burada! FLO, sizlere aradığınız tüm ürünleri en avantajlı fiyatlarla sunuyor.
Kaliteye FLO ile Ulaşın!
Basketbol ayakkabısı mı arıyorsunuz? Topuklu ayakkabı modelleri içerisinde bu sezon en çok tutulanları hangisi? Puma ayakkabı çeşitlerinde yeni sezonlar geldi mi? Erkek ayakkabı renklerinde hangi seçenekler mevcut? Nike Air Max kampanyası var mı? Güneş gözlüğü indirimleri başladı mı? Nike krampon modellerinde en son çıkan ürünler geldi mi? Seyahate çıkacaksınız, valiz ihtiyacınız mı var? Yaz tatili için terlik mi bakıyorsunuz? Erkek arkadaşınıza pantolon mı alacaksınız? Tüm soruların en kampanyalı cevapları FLO online mağazada sizleri bekliyor!
Sporcuların İlk Tercihi
FLO mağazası, spor ayakkabı erkek modelleri ve kadın spor ayakkabı çeşitlerinde yüzlerce markanın binlerce ürününü sizlere sunuyor! Adidas, Puma, Nike kadın spor ayakkabı modelleri ve daha fazlası için uygulamayı hemen indirebilirsiniz! Koşu ayakkabısı, kız çocuk spor ayakkabı, halısaha ayakkabısı ve aradığınız tüm kategoriler burada!
Futsal ayakkabısı, koşu ayakkabısı, voleybol ayakkabısı, tenis ayakkabısı, kadın ya da erkek basketbol ayakkabısı, trekking ayakkabısı ve daha fazlası! Sporcuların ihtiyaç duyacağı tüm ürünleri en uygun fiyatlarla sunuyoruz.
Aradığın Ne Varsa Burada!
Halı saha ayakkabısı, kadın ve erkek kol saati, yılbaşı hediyeleri, erkek ve kız çocuk bot, etek, gömlek, sandalet, laptop çantası, kadın ve erkek eşofman altı ya da üstü, kol saati, polar, bluz, askeri bot, outdoor ayakkabı, kar botu, forma, topuklu terlik…vs her ne arıyorsan FLO ile kapında! Aradığınız tüm ürünlere hızlı bir şekilde FLO mağazasından ulaşabilir, kampanyalı fiyatlarla hemen sipariş verebilirsiniz.
Yaz Günlerinin Aranan Tüm Ürünleri!
Erkek ve kadın mayo, terlik, sandalet, şort, güneş gözlüğü, plaj terliği, tişört ve aradığınız tüm yazlık ürünler FLO’da sizlerle! Yerli ve yabancı markaların klasik ürünlerinin yanı sıra yeni sezon için tasarladıkları modelleri inceleyebilirsiniz.
Kış Aylarının En Çok Arananları
Yağmur çizmesi, outdoor bot, yağmur botu, su geçirmez ayakkabı, mont gibi kış aylarında ihtiyaç duyacağınız tüm ürünler sizleri bekliyor! FLO ayrıcalığıyla tüm markaların kışlık ürünlerine anında ulaşabilirsiniz.
FLO Ayrıcalıklarıyla Tanışın!
Erkek ev terliği, erkek ve bayan sandalet, Crocs terlik kadın ve erkek modelleri, çocuk ayakkabı, kadın ve erkek panduf, abiye ayakkabı, erkek ya da kadın tişört, kışlık ve yazlık ayakkabı çeşitleri, yetişkin ve çocuklar için atlet modelleri, çocuklar için ışıklı ayakkabı seçenekleri ve binlerce ürün… FLO dünyasının ayrıcalıklarını hemen keşfetmek için uygulamayı indirebilir, en avantajlı fiyatlarla dilediğiniz ürünü satın alabilirsiniz!
Yüzlerce marka FLO’da sizi bekliyor!

bluejetty:00151268:ios.description:
A helpful insurance app. 
Managing your home and car insurance has never been easier. Get instant access to your insurance documents or submit a claim and upload your photos in just a few minutes. 
When life’s unexpected moments happen, get instant access to all your insurance info no matter where you are or when you need it! 
Check out some of the Servus Insurance Services | Home and Auto App features: 
MANAGE POLICIES 
View your insurance policy details, access all your documents and more on-the-go. 
DIGITAL PROOF OF INSURANCE 
Access proof of your car insurance directly on your smartphone rather than reaching for the glove box. 
ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE*1 
Contact emergency roadside assistance for help with battery boosting, door unlocking, gas delivery, towing, wheel changes and winching. Plus, track the status of your request too. 
SUBMIT A CLAIM 
Submit and track a car or home insurance claim in a couple of clicks at your convenience. You can easily add photos of the damages along with any receipts. 
BILLING INFORMATION 
View your payment information and previous payments or purchases. 
* Conditions, limitations and exclusions apply, and features may vary in each province. Visit servus-homeauto.ca for details. Your insurance contract prevails at all times; please consult it for a complete description of coverage and exclusions. 
1. Services offered by an independent third party as part of the roadside assistance endorsement. 
By clicking Install, you consent to the installation of the Servus Insurance app on your mobile device, and any future upgrades or updates thereto. You further agree that the Servus Insurance app, or any updates or upgrades thereto, could or will perform the functions described above. You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the Servus Insurance app from your mobile device. The Servus Insurance app is offered free of charge, but standard data rates and fees may apply. This app is not optimized for tablets.

bluejetty:00079665:ios.description:
Form the ultimate team of Power Rangers and save Angel Grove from Rita Repulsa!
The original Mighty Morphin Power Rangers are back, but now they’re joined by Rangers from the future to take on Rita and repair the Morphin Grid! Power Rangers Mighty Force features a brand new, original Power Rangers story. Enjoy a nostalgic trip back to the 90’s and the original Power Rangers team, mixed with nods and references to classic moments from across Power Rangers’ history. The Mighty Morphin Power Rangers are about to face their biggest threat yet! Rita Repulsa’s ancient magic has broken the Morphin Grid, sending the Rangers’ powers haywire, and allowing Rita to summon monsters from across time and space to early 90s Angel Grove. Join now! 
But the Mighty Morphin Rangers aren’t alone – the broken Grid means that fan favorite Power Rangers from across the entire history of Power Rangers will be joining the fight! Form a team made up of Rangers from every series and take on Rita’s monstrous forces – a mix of classic Finster creations and dastardly villains from other Power Rangers series.
- Build a team made up of Rangers from across the franchise: Unlock fan-favorite characters to fight alongside the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, Lightspeed Red Ranger, Time Force Pink Ranger, Turbo Yellow Ranger and many more.
- Take down enemies with your Rangers’ unique skills, abilities and iconic weapons: Power Rangers Mighty Force pairs idle gameplay with an exciting battle system! Make teams out of your unlocked rangers and battle to restore the grid!
- Unlock bonuses and defeat bosses to progress the story: Continue to uncover an epic Power Rangers story at the end of each Episode.

bluejetty:00016383:ios.description:
Roll the dice and test your luck in Farkle, the exciting and addictive classic dice game! Whether you want to play alone, challenge friends, or compete online, Farkle offers endless fun and strategy. 
We bring you the all new Farkle game in a completely revamped avatar which we are sure you will love to play.
In this game, you can now play Farkle alone, or in a multiplayer mode and the best of all, ‘Pass & Play’ on the same device with your friends, family and loved ones and have the best of your times. 
Farkle Rules:
At the start of each turn, the player throws all 6 dice at once. One or more scoring dice will be set aside after each throw. After this, the player may then either end their turn and bank the score, or continue to throw the remaining Dice.
If all six dice are scored, they have a 'hot dice' and continue their turn with a new throw of all the six dice adding to the score they have already accumulated. If none of the dice scores in any throw, the play has 'farkled' and all points are lost for that turn.
Features You'll Love:
*Play Alone – Challenge yourself to reach the target. Never get bored and wait for others. Always keep honing your Farkle skills.
* Multiplayer Mode – Compete online against players worldwide.
* Pass & Play Mode – Play with friends on the same device. 
* Classic Farkle Rules – Enjoy traditional scoring.
* Smooth & Intuitive Gameplay – Simple controls with a seamless experience.
*How to Play:
Roll six dice and score points based on different combinations.
Set aside scoring dice and re-roll the rest—or risk it all for a Farkle!
Reach the target score before your opponent and win the game!
Ready to roll the dice and see if luck is on your side? Download Farkle now and start playing!
Will you play it safe or risk it all for a big win? Download to Find out!

bluejetty:00014732:ios.description:
Connect the jobsite to the office with SKYSITE, the cloud based construction app that allows you to manage your construction documents, projects, and information from a desktop or mobile device. 
This contractor app allows you to version your drawings and specs by the revision date as it shows on the title block of your documents. SKYSITE’s "Latest documents" feature automatically creates the current drawing set for your project. Markups automatically sync to all users in real time. Upload and store unlimited documents. Offline sync lets you view documents, markup, create punches, and RFIs, all while you are still at the jobsite, even without internet access.
With our construction project management software you can manage submittals, RFIs, punch lists, and photos all within one application; no need to juggle between multiple apps. 
SKYSITE allows Contractors, Owners, Developers, Architects, Engineers and project teams to:
• Manage documents with the app built for design & construction
• Access and share construction documents from anywhere, on any device
• Access the current drawing set, specs and other construction project documents
• Store unlimited information, with no sheet limits 
• Create RFIs
• Create punch lists
• Manage photos
• Access submittals
• Markup, collaborate, and sync in real time
• Search document content (including OCR content), not just filenames
• Auto-Hyperlink drawing sets
• View and markup documents offline
• Sign in using Single Sign-On 
SKYSITE is ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified

bluejetty:00096588:android.summary: Impostor Challenge: Guess Who mixes word guessing with classic impostor gameplay in a unique imposter party word game and social party game experience. Each round, everyone knows the secret word-except one. Can you identify who is the impos
bluejetty:00096588:android.description:
Impostor Challenge: Guess Who mixes word guessing with classic impostor gameplay in a unique imposter party word game and social party game experience. Each round, everyone knows the secret word-except one. Can you identify who is the imposter by observing their answers and behavior? Use your instincts, read each reaction, and try to guess the imposter before they slip away. Dive into this hilarious and strategic imposter who challenge where every round brings new surprises 🎉.
Watch carefully as players bluff, hesitate, or try to fakeit while pretending they know the word. This social deduction adventure delivers nonstop fun as you race to uncover the liar in this thrilling imposter who party game.
🎭 Get ready for chaos and clever thinking in this imposter party word game and social party game:
- All players see the secret word - except the imposter.
- The imposter sees nothing but the word “Imposter.”
- Everyone gives one clue about the real word, trying not to be obvious.
- The imposter tries to fakeit, hoping nobody notices their strange hints.
- The group argues, laughs, and tries to decide who is the imposter based on every clue.
- Reveal the liar dramatically and jump straight into the next imposter who round.
Each game is fast, tense, and full of surprises. Whether you're the Imposter, Mr White, or a Civilian, your mission is to read the room, protect the Secret Word, and uncover the liar before it's too late. Play like a high-stakes version of words with friends, but with bluffing, deception, and clever undercover tactics at every turn. Step into the role of a social spy as you analyze clues, catch slip-ups, and keep everyone guessing in this fun family game filled with laughter and suspense.
🧩 Key Features:
- Simple rules, endless mind games, and tons of replay value
- A hilarious imposter party word game that feels like social spy games
- 10+ fun categories: food, movies, hobbies, and more
- 500+ words encouraging players to bluff, twist clues, and fakeit like pros
- Great for gatherings with friends, family, or classmates-perfect for any “imposter who” moment.
🔥 Ready to test your deduction skills? Impostor Challenge throws you into an intense Party Word Challenge filled with sneaky hints and bold bluffs. Everyone gets the hidden word, but one player is faking it. Study every reaction and clue, then try to guess who knows the words without falling for their tricks. When the tension peaks, stand your ground and vote out the Imposter to claim victory 🥳.

bluejetty:00126079:ios.description:
Asked to fax something to a doctor's office, an insurance company, or a government office? Send it from your iPhone or iPad. No fax machine needed.
Scan it, sign it, send it, and see when it arrives.
No subscription. No monthly fee. Buy fax pages only when you need them. They never expire.
Faxeau sends faxes. It can't receive them.
"I'VE NEVER SENT A FAX"
1. Add your pages: scan paper, or pick a PDF, Word file, or photo.
2. Type the fax number.
3. Check your fax, then tap Send Fax.
The app guides you through each step. No fax experience needed.
"I NEED TO FAX THIS TODAY"
• Scan paper with your camera. Pages come out straight and clean for faxing.
• Send PDFs, Word files, and photos from Photos or Files, including iCloud Drive.
• Put scans, photos, and files together in one fax, in any order.
• On iPad, drag a file onto the Send screen to start a fax.
"I HAVE TO SIGN IT AND FILL IT IN"
• Type into fillable PDF forms. No printing.
• Write, type, or add the date anywhere on a page.
• Sign with your finger or Apple Pencil. Your signature is saved for next time.
• Start from a ready-made records request, authorization form, or letter.
• Add a cover page in one of 4 styles: Standard, Urgent, Confidential, or Minimal. Add your phone number so the office can call you back.
• On devices with Apple Intelligence (iOS or iPadOS 26 or later), type one sentence and the app writes the cover page subject and notes for you.
• Cover pages and ready-made forms stay clear in black and white, the way fax machines print.
"IT HAS TO GO TO THE RIGHT NUMBER"
• We check the number as you type: missing or extra digits, a missing area code, or an extension (a fax can't dial one).
• Letters in the number, or an area code that can't exist? We point that out too.
• Before you send, you see the number in big, clear digits, with every page that will go.
• Pick a number from Contacts. If your contacts list it as a mobile, we point it out.
"DID IT ARRIVE? DO I NEED TO CALL THEM?"
• Watch your fax go from "On its way" to "Delivered". It updates by itself.
• Get a notification when it's delivered. On iPhone, a fax to one number also shows live on your Lock Screen.
• Still on its way after 20 minutes? We tell you to call the office before you send it again.
• If it fails, we tell you why when we can, like a busy line or a wrong number, and whether sending again will help.
• Only some pages arrived? We tell you that too.
• If we can't confirm it arrived, we say so instead of guessing.
• Sent to several offices? You get an answer for each one.
"HOW MANY PAGES WILL IT USE?"
• Before you send, you see how many pages the fax will use. Once you're signed in, you also see how many you'll have left.
• Once you're signed in, your page balance is at the top of the Send screen.
• If a fax fails, we tell you whether your pages came back.
• Tapped Send twice by mistake? The fax is sent, and charged, only once.
"THEY SAY THEY NEVER GOT IT"
• Save a PDF receipt for any fax: where it went, when, and what happened. For a delivered fax, it can also show the pages received and how long the call took.
• Your sent faxes stay in your account. Find one by name, number, date, or status.
• Send it again in a few taps. Your pages and number are already filled in.
"I WANT IT EASY AND PRIVATE"
• Works with large text and VoiceOver.
• Your saved numbers, signatures, and sender name sync across your devices with iCloud.
• Look around and see prices first. You only sign in to buy pages or send, with Sign in with Apple. No passwords.
• Delete your account and its data from inside the app, anytime.
Privacy Policy: https://fierce-inlet-63133.herokuapp.com/fax-privacy-and-term
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00061137:ios.description:
Turn your mobile phone into your own, personal First Southern banker! First Southern National Bank’s Mobile App allows you to manage your accounts from your mobile device quickly and securely – anytime you’d like.
First Southern’s free* mobile app allows customers to:
- Check Account Balances
- Access Online Bill Pay
- Transfer Funds Between Accounts
- View Transaction History and Check Images
- Locate Branches and ATMs
- Contact Customer Service
- Deposit Checks
- Turn Your Card On|Off in Real-Time 
- Make a Loan Payment
- See Enhanced Transaction Details
- PIN Login
- View Online Statements
Logging in is quick and easy for existing First Southern National Bank Online Banking customers. To login to the First Southern National Bank Mobile App, use your current Online Banking credentials.
If you’re a current customer, but are not enrolled in Online Banking, visit our website at www.fsnb.net and click Sign Up, stop by your local branch or give us a call to get started. 
Still not a First Southern customer? We’d love to earn your business! Visit us online, anytime at www.fsnb.net to see what makes us different or to find a branch near you.
Security:
First Southern National Bank’s Mobile Banking App protects your financial information from unauthorized access by:
- Secure login with user ID and password
- Auto-logout after 10 minutes of inactivity
- No transmission of complete account numbers
Thank you for choosing First Southern National Bank. We appreciate your business.
Member FDIC. *Wireless carrier fees may apply. Check with your wireless provider for details.
To learn how we protect your privacy, please visit www.fsnb.net.

bluejetty:00030459:ios.description:
Creality Cloud App 
Creality Cloud – The Ultimate 3D Printing Platform
Unleash Your Creativity with the World's Leading 3D Printing Community
Creality Cloud is the all-in-one 3D printing platform built for makers, hobbyists, and professionals. Join a thriving global community of over 4 million users and explore a vast 3D model library, AI-powered tools, and seamless built-in cloud slicing. Manage your prints remotely, connect with fellow creators, and bring your ideas to life—all in one powerful app.
Key Features
Explore a Vast 3D Model Library
Browse millions of high-quality 3D models, including thousands of free designs ready for download and printing.
AI-powered search helps you find models faster with image-based search and semantic search.
Discover trending, exclusive, and premium models, curated just for you.
Join themed design contests and showcase your creativity to the world.
Slice & Print with Cloud-Based Slicing
Slice and print directly from your phone—no software downloads required.
Convert STL files to G-code effortlessly and preview sliced files within the app.
Supports 10+ languages, ensuring a seamless experience for users worldwide.
Earn Rewards & Grow as a Designer
Earn points when your models are downloaded, sliced, or printed, and redeem them for exciting rewards.
Receive boosts from active users with platform-issued boost tickets.
Set your own prices for paid models and offer discounts to boost sales.
AI-powered upload assistant helps you tag, categorize, and describe models more efficiently.
Enhanced dashboard - Insights provides real-time updates on model performance, fan interactions, and earnings.
Remote Control for Your 3D Printer
Control and manage your 3D printer from anywhere using your mobile device.
Print 3MF files instantly without the need for slicing.
Control multiple printers remotely with an intuitive dashboard.
Capture and view timelapse videos of your printing process.
Connect with a Thriving 3D Printing Community
Engage with millions of makers and printing enthusiasts from around the world.
Share your projects, seek advice, and exchange ideas to enhance your skills.
Unlock Exclusive Premium Benefits
Upgrade to premium membership and enjoy free downloads of 400+ premium models.
Faster model downloads and slicing speeds for an enhanced experience.
Auto-Renewing Subscription
 Creality Cloud Premium: Monthly (1 month) & Annual (12 months)
Auto-Renewal
Your iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current period ends. The subscription will auto-renew unless canceled.
 Cancel Subscription (Apple):
 Go to Settings → iTunes & App Store → tap Apple ID → View Apple ID → Subscriptions → select Creality Cloud Premium → tap Cancel.
Service agreement:
 https://file2-cdn.creality.com/Auto-Renewal-Service-Agreement.html
Who We Are
Creality is a leading global brand in 3D printing, dedicated to making 3D printing smarter, easier, and more accessible. Our mission is to empower creators with cutting-edge technology while promoting sustainable and innovative solutions.
New User Welcome Bonus
Sign up today and enjoy 7 days of free premium membership, including exclusive model downloads and premium perks!
Get in Touch
Creality Cloud is a free and open platform for everyone to explore, create, and share. Have questions or feedback? Contact us at APPservice@creality.com.
Are you a talented 3D designer? Join our Designer Partner Program and unlock new opportunities. Reach out to us at APPservice@creality.com to get started!

bluejetty:00029750:ios.description:
Feel the rush. Own the streets. Become a legend.
Race Max Pro is the most thrilling mobile racing simulator you'll ever experience — an incredible world where street racing, drifting, and drag racing come alive with breathtaking speed, stunning supercars, and pure adrenaline.
LEGENDARY SUPERCARS & HYPERCARS
Get behind the wheel of the world's most iconic, awe-inspiring machines. Race extraordinary legends from Aston Martin, Pagani, BMW, Audi, Ford, Nissan, Jaguar, Lotus, Chevrolet, Subaru, Mazda, Renault, Peugeot, Volkswagen, AC Cars, Rezvani, RUF, and Naran.
Experience the sheer power of icons like the Nissan GT-R R34 Skyline, Audi RS7, BMW M3 GTR, Chevrolet Camaro, Ford Mustang, Aston Martin Valhalla, and Pagani Zonda R. Every car is a masterpiece — and it's waiting for you.
Fans are already dreaming of Lamborghini, Ferrari, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, and Rolls-Royce joining the lineup — and we hear you. The garage is growing with every update. More legendary machines are joining the race — and the best is yet to come.
THREE INCREDIBLE RACING DISCIPLINES. ENDLESS THRILLS.
• Street Racing: Blast through stunning urban circuits, dominate every rival, and taste sweet victory.
• Drift Racing: Master the perfect slide, chain breathtaking drifts, and earn your title as drift king.
• Drag Racing: Experience the explosive launch, the perfect shift, the glorious finish — nothing beats the thrill of pure speed.
• Events & Challenges: Exciting brand showcases, intense time trials, and thrilling seasonal tournaments keep the action fresh every day.
YOUR DREAM CAR. YOUR MASTERPIECE.
Race Max Pro isn't just a car game — it's your ultimate automotive fantasy. Upgrade engine, turbo, gearbox, nitro, tires, and reduce weight to unleash your car's true potential.
Fine-tune your perfect setup for breathtaking drift precision or unstoppable drag dominance. Personalize every gorgeous detail — custom paint, stunning rims, bold decals, aerodynamic spoilers, and sleek window tints. Build the car you've always dreamed of.
BEAUTIFUL TRACKS. EPIC RACING.
Race across spectacular circuits inspired by the stunning Amalfi Coast, breathtaking Nordic roads, vibrant Far East city streets, and iconic U.S. highways. Every location is a visual masterpiece designed for unforgettable racing.
COMPETE. CELEBRATE. RISE TO GLORY.
Challenge the world in exhilarating real-time multiplayer racing leagues and ranked seasons. Rise through the leaderboards, earn incredible rewards, and prove you're the ultimate racing champion.
Love the freedom of solo play? Race Max Pro offers a complete, deeply satisfying offline career with 215+ thrilling races — no Wi-Fi needed, just pure racing joy.
EVERYTHING YOU'VE EVER WANTED IN A RACING GAME
Awe-inspiring licensed supercars & hypercars
Street Racing, Drifting & Drag Racing — three incredible worlds in one
215+ exhilarating career races across gorgeous global tracks
Deep, rewarding car customization, tuning & building
Heart-pounding multiplayer racing & competitive ranked leagues
Full offline racing — enjoy anytime, anywhere
Exciting updates — spectacular new cars, seasons & events
Download Race Max Pro today. The ultimate street racing simulator is here — and it's absolutely glorious.
Feel the speed. Own every drift. Win every drag race. Your legend starts now.

bluejetty:00166179:ios.description:
43 types of instant · CCD · film cameras. With just one click, instantly restore the authentic shooting experience, and you can even see the grain of the photo when zooming in!
The initial inspiration for TOK CAM came from instant imaging cameras, which do not require film processing and development. Later on, we added many elements of film to provide users with a better experience.
TOK CAM Main Features, besides basic camera and film simulation, it includes four major feature categories:
1. Creative Shooting Modes: Double Exposure, Half Frame, Tilt Shift, Spin Focus, Long Exposure
2. Lens Effects: Grain Lens, Low Light Lens, Light Leak, Vintage Prism, Veteran Texture, Sparkle Lens, Fisheye
3. Border Styles: Square, Wide, Airmail, Film Border, Vintage Date Stamp, Time & Location Watermark
4. Beauty Retouch: Big Eyes, Face Slimming, Skin Smoothing, Natural & Sweet Mode, one-click switchable
5. Save RAW photos in original format, enjoy boundless space for post-processing
In addition, TOK CAM is continuously developing new shooting capabilities, so stay tuned!

Step into the electrifying world of our Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) fight game and experience the adrenaline-pumping action like never before. Immerse yourself in the intensity of the octagon as you take on the role of a rising MMA star, determined to climb the ranks and claim the championship belt.

bluejetty:00027661:ios.name: Files HD - File Manager
bluejetty:00027661:ios.summary: Files HD (formerly known as Downloads Lite - Download Manager for iPad) features a Web browser that lets you save documents to your iPad so that you can work with them offline. It has a built-in file manager, with robust viewer for all iOS
bluejetty:00027661:ios.description:
Files HD (formerly known as Downloads Lite - Download Manager for iPad) features a Web browser that lets you save documents to your iPad so that you can work with them offline. It has a built-in file manager, with robust viewer for all iOS supported document types, powerful photo browser, advanced PDF reader, full Dropbox support, and more.
NOTE: This app does not support downloading of audio or video content.
FEATURES
√ File manager
- Folders support
- Move, rename and delete files
- Search by file name
- Document viewer that supports .pdf, .doc, .xls, .ppt, .txt, .html, .webarchive and .rtf file formats
- Extract ZIP and RAR archives
- Import photos from camera roll 
√ Tabbed browser
- Provides a user experience very similar to Safari
- Supports unlimited tabs
- Tap and hold on a link to open it in new tab or download it
- Fully featured bookmark manager
- History support
- Address bar auto-completion
- HTTP basic authentication
- Form-based authentication
- Integrated Google or Yahoo! search
- Ability to spoof browser's User-Agent string to display web pages like Firefox
- Unified smart search field. Type a URL or search term in the unified smart search field, the browser automatically suggests the closest match to what you’re looking for.
√ Download manager
- Fast downloading speed
- Save pages with images for offline viewing
- Supports resuming of interrupted downloads reliably
- Live download progress bar and speed indicator
- Active downloads badge number
- Add arbitrary download link 
- Always download with correct filename 
- Ability to download file of unknown size
√ Dropbox integration
- Upload, download and manage files
- Sync what you want, keep files on your device
√ Advanced PDF viewer 
- Huge PDF files work flawlessly 
- Text search 
- Tap PDF links to jump across the file 
√ Photo viewer
- Swipe to move between images in a folder
- Zoom in and out with pinch gesture
- Thumbnails view of all images in a folder
- Ability to save images to photo album
√ File transfer
- iTunes USB File Sharing lets you drag and drop files between your iPad and computer
- Supports HTTP and FTP protocols
- Transfer files to and from computer that is in the same Wi-Fi network
- Send files as email attachments
√ Passcode lock
√ Mobile Safari integration
- Bookmarklet that lets you send links from Mobile Safari to Files HD app
√ Multitasking
- Background downloading 
√ Inter-app document interchange
- Other apps can save their files to Files HD app (e.g. Email app can save attachments to Files HD app)
√ Recovery Mode
- If the browser caught in an endless loop of pop-up alerts, go to the iOS built-in "Settings" app, find "Files HD", turn on "Recovery Mode", then force-quit and relaunch the app.
Terms of Use: https://downloadsapp.info/terms
Privacy Policy: https://downloadsapp.info/privacy

bluejetty:00090772:ios.description:
문 앞에서 맡기고 받는 가장 가까운 세탁소, 런드리고
■ 모바일 프리미엄 세탁 서비스 
번거롭고, 무거운 세탁물도 간편한 수거신청으로 문 앞에서 맡기고 받으세요.
수거 배달은 물론, 케어라벨에 따라 세심하게 세탁해요.
■ 런드리고가 특별한 이유
1. 믿을 수 있는 비대면 세탁 
세탁물 수거용 가방(런드렛/라이트백)에 세탁물을 담고, 앱으로 수거 요청하면 세탁 완료! 분실이나 시간 약속 걱정 없이 편리하게 세탁 고민을 해결하세요.
2. 내 라이프스타일에 맞게 직접 선택하는 배송방법
한밤배송
업계 최단 시간 내 세탁 완료 
오늘 밤 맡기면 내일 밤 문앞배송!
주소지에 따라 한밤배송 옵션이 제공되지 않을 수 있습니다.
여러밤배송 
여유있게 세탁 맡기고 할인 받기 
오늘 밤 맡기면 네밤 이내 문앞배송
3. 실시간 세탁물 확인 
신청한 세탁물의 진행 상황을 실시간으로 확인하세요. 
비포 애프터 세탁 상태와 진행 상황을 직접 확인할 수 있으니까 
더 안심하고 이용하실 수 있어요. 
4. 맞춤형 할인 가격
자유 이용 서비스: 안심 정찰 가격으로 필요할 때, 필요한 만큼 이용!
* [AI 세탁비 계산]을 통해 카메라로 찍어 보면 미리 예상 세탁비 견적을 받을 수 있어요. 
구독 서비스: 자주 맡기는 세탁물은 기본 할인 + 추가 세탁 이용 20% 할인 + 의류 보관 서비스 + 추가로 지급되는 이불 세탁/무료배송 혜택까지!최대 ~44%까지 할인!
5. 바이러스까지 케어하는 안심 세탁 
항균력 99.9% 바이러스 케어 세제로 바이러스 걱정 없는 세탁물을 받아보세요. 
(우수한 국가공인 인증기관에 의해 품질 인증을 받았습니다*)
6. 자취생, 직장인, 주부, 맞벌이, 임산부, 다인 가족 필수 추천 앱 
원룸이라 세탁 공간이 부족한 1인 가구라면, 동네 세탁소가 너무 멀리 있어 불편한 뚜벅이라면, 육아/청소/설거지 등 집안일에 치이며 사는 다인 가족도, 야근으로 지쳐 여유 시간이 필요한 사람도, 주말까지 집안일에 시간 뺏기기 싫은 현대인 모두 - 귀찮은 세탁, 런드리고에 맡겨보세요.
드라이 클리닝, 신발, 이불, 카페트, 커텐, 패딩, 코트, 의류, 생활빨래, 얼룩 제거, 수선까지! 
■ 앱 접근 권한 안내 
런드리고를 더 편하게 이용하기 위해 해당 권한이 필요합니다. 자세한 내용을 확인해 주세요. (*선택 권한을 허용하지 않아도 서비스를 이용할 수 있지만, 일부 서비스 이용 제한이 있을 수 있습니다.) 
[ 필수적 접근 권한 ] 
기기 및 앱 기록: 앱 버전 확인과 사용성을 개선할 때 사용됩니다. 
[ 선택 접근 권한 ] 
카메라 / 사진 및 동영상: 프리미엄 / 수선 / 보관 서비스를 신청할 경우 세탁물과 요청사항을 등록할 때 사용됩니다. 
[이용문의] 앱 사용 중 불편하신 사항이 있으실 경우 MY > 고객센터 > 문의하기에 남겨주시면 빠르게 답변 드리겠습니다. 
■ 웹사이트 https://www.lifegoeson.kr/

bluejetty:00044368:ios.description:
Ready your strategy, Commander!
Draft Showdown hurls you onto a dynamic battleground where every choice can crown a champion or spell defeat. In brisk duels, you’ll draft a squad, watch them clash in real‑time auto‑combat, and pivot your tactics round after round.
DRAFT IN SECONDS, OUTSMART IN MOMENTS
Three draws, three picks, limitless outcomes. Will you unleash an Archer volley, roll explosive TNT into enemy lines, or gamble on a mighty Goose Army? No two drafts are ever alike.
AUTO-COMBAT, REAL STAKES
Once the horn sounds, your hand is off the board - units fight automatically, and the first player to lose all lives bows out. Victory is decided long before the swords touch steel.
EPIC COMEBACKS
Fell behind? The innovative fourth draw grants a surge of fresh options, keeping matches tense until the final blow.
BUILD YOUR SIGNATURE DECK
Craft a four‑card load‑out that reflects your style. Chain synergies, counter popular metas, and surprise rivals with off‑beat combos.
HYBRID-CASUAL THRILLS
Matches last minutes, not hours, making Draft Showdown perfect for a quick break or an evening ladder grind - depth for veterans, accessibility for newcomers.
Draft, adapt, and dominate! Download Draft Showdown NOW and prove your tactical brilliance!

bluejetty:00069041:ios.description:
Hippovibe is the #1 software for managing your stable. No more paper notes, whiteboards or WhatsApp groups: everything around your stable now lives in one central place – for you and your whole team.
Our software is already trusted by leading international stables such as Aubenhausen, Stephex Stables, Hof Sosath and Joe Stockdale.
What Hippovibe makes easier for your stable:
· All your horse data in one place – pedigree, videos, X-rays, invoices, always at hand
· Task planning your whole team sees in real time – no more notes or voice messages
· Health management with a digital record that reminds you in time about vaccinations, the farrier and dewormings
· Shows and appointments in a shared calendar, visible to everyone
· Feeding plans, financial overview and individual access rights

Grocery List ◎ is an easy to use app that provides you with a checklist of all the important things to consider when grocery shopping.
 ——— SHARE & COLLABORATE YOUR LISTS ———
Shopping just got smarter and more social. With our latest update, you can now share your grocery lists with family, roommates, or friends — and work on them together in real time!
——— PICK SUGGESTED ITEMS ———
Get up and running with very little effort by using our Pick Suggested Items feature. Just tap on Pick Suggested Items and our recommendations will show up.
You can pick items from these categories: Baby Care, Beverages, Breakfast, Cleaning, Condiments, Eggs & Dairy, Frozen, Fruits, Meat, Poultry, Pet Items, Toiletries, Vegetables and many more!
Select the items that you would like to add to your list and tap done.

Created your list on your iPad but want to check it on your iPhone? Got a new iOS device and want to see your lists there?

——— MANAGE ITEM QUANTITIES ———

——— REUSE YOUR EXISTING LISTS ———
This is one of the best kept secrets of every seasoned shopper. Keep refining your list, and reach sorcerer-level shopping skills. You’ll soon forget why you ever shopped differently in the past!
——— QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK? ———
We love hearing from you and we read every single email you send us!
Have suggestions? Please, feel free to reach us at grocerylistshoppingapp@gmail.com

حرب الأسئلة:
bluejetty:00070501:ios.description:
استعد لتجربة التحدي الأكبر في "أزبري"، لعبة الذكاء الجديدة التي تجمع بين متعة التعلم وحماس المنافسة. مع لعبتين رئيسيتين داخل التطبيق، ندعوك لتختبر معلوماتك وسرعتك في ترتيب الكلمات بطريقة لم تعهدها من قبل. هل أنت مستعد للتحدي؟
حرب الأسئلة: انضم إلى معركة الذكاء حيث يتنافس لاعبان في الإجابة على 5 أسئلة متنوعة. من يجيب على أكبر عدد من الأسئلة بشكل صحيح سيفوز ويحصل على نقاط. إظهار مهاراتك العقلية أمر حتمي للنجاح هنا.
حرب الكلمات: لعبة تنافسية حيث يدخل لاعبان لترتيب جملة مع الإجابة المبعثرة. اللاعب الأول الذي ينجح في ترتيب الجملة بشكل صحيح يفوز. السرعة والدقة هما مفتاحك للنصر.
كل لاعب يمتلك مؤشر ذكاء يزداد مع كل فوز وينقص مع الهزيمة. فكل تحدي تتجاوزه يعكس قدرتك وذكاءك.
نتحداك! هل تملك الجرأة لتجرب حظك وذكاءك؟ هل تستطيع أن تكون الأذكى بين أصدقائك ومنافسيك؟ انضم إلى أزبري الآن واثبت قدراتك. كل تحدي تواجهه ليس مجرد لعبة، بل هو خطوة نحو إثبات ذكائك.

bluejetty:00013985:ios.summary: Easily access the information available with your CoStar account from your phone! While away from the office, commercial real estate professionals can now find detailed information on properties, space for lease, properties for sale, sale c
bluejetty:00013985:ios.description:
Easily access the information available with your CoStar account from your phone! While away from the office, commercial real estate professionals can now find detailed information on properties, space for lease, properties for sale, sale comparables, lease comparables, and tenants and benefit from the depth of verified, continuously updated information provided by the CoStar service. With the new CoStar app, you now have access to the most accurate & comprehensive property information available from anywhere, and on the go!
Disclaimer: CoStar™ app is a mobile extension of the professional suite of CoStar Professional services and is intended only for CoStar users.
Features: 
·      Answer questions on the spot with access to CoStar information on your phone
·      Access CoStar’s massive database of over 5.2 Million commercial properties throughout the US, Canada and the UK!
·      View in-depth CRE information around your current location, including millions of photos.
·      Lookup every CRE professional in your area and access their contact information and properties they are associated with.
·      Communicate instantly with a call, email, or text message from the app
·      Perform Live map searches in your current location and see the map update with listing in real time while you’re on the move.
·      Move the map with your fingers or do a lookup to change your search area
·      Search for any property, available space, properties for sale, sale comparables, lease comparables, and tenants
·      Search filters are country specific and criteria options work seamlessly based on where the map is positioned. (eg. viewing London will display UK specific filter criteria)
·      Lookup geographies like cities, counties, postcodes/zips, submarkets, streets, as well as property addresses and building names.
·      Custom areas can be drawn on the map via interactive draw tools for area, radius, line corridor.
·      Analyze properties across all commercial property types.
CoStar’s professional suite of products provide unmatched local market insight and nationwide coverage, supported by the industry’s largest property research organization. With nearly 1,500 highly trained professionals, CoStar field and analytic researchers:
• Log more than 5.1 million data changes per day
• Make more than 1.9M calls a month (60K Calls a day) to brokers, owners, developers and other commercial real estate professionals
• Canvass more than 500,000 properties nationwide annually 
• Take more than 1 million property photographs annually
The result: Comprehensive, accurate and continuously updated commercial property information that helps win clients and close deals.
Note: Continued use of location services (GPS) running the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00073323:ios.description:
Top down arena shooter with autofire and a wide variety of guns to choose from. Survive waves of enemies by using the full arsenal of your pickle, including a dodge roll and other on-demand abilities.
Darkness has settled over the world, and our hero must find a way to survive against the waves of evil forces. Stack up, gear up, and create countless combinations of unique builds to become stronger than your enemies. Find the antidote and save the world!
Features:
- Tons of epic boss fights
- Rich environments with unique enemy mechanics per biome
- Deep progression system that leads to unique builds every run
- Super easy controls
- Various game-modes to mix it up
Details on Subscriptions
1. Subscription Pricing & Billing
You can subscribe within the game for ‘Vip Experience’, for $4.99 a calendar week or $12.99 a calendar month.
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers can enjoy the following privileges during the period:
- Instant 1000 gems
- Ad-free experience
3. Auto Renewals
The App Store Subscription feature renews automatically via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the subscription through your iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
Terms of Service: https://www.frojoapps.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.frojoapps.com/pickle-privacy-policy
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Pickle Pete’ to cancel it.

bluejetty:00096025:ios.summary:
8 Ball Battle — More than just a 8 Ball Pool Game
Sink shots, charge up your firepower, and blast through zombies—this is 8 ball pool like you’ve never seen it! Line up your cue, sink balls to take matches, rack up bullet points, mow down t
bluejetty:00096025:ios.description:
8 Ball Battle — More than just a 8 Ball Pool Game
Sink shots, charge up your firepower, and blast through zombies—this is 8 ball pool like you’ve never seen it! Line up your cue, sink balls to take matches, rack up bullet points, mow down the undead, and unlock legendary loot.If you want to chill with a game of 8 ball, 8 Ball Battle is your perfect match!
Easy to Play, Real and Fair Matches
 Enjoy smooth and realistic 1v1 8 ball pool matches. Pot balls, chain combos and aim to win — earn bullet score, climb daily leaderboards and progress faster. Whether it's 8 ball, 9 ball, or snooker, if you're a pool master, join and play! To be the king of pool! Play the most authentic 8-ball pool in 1v1 matches ！
Fight Zombies Before They Escape
 Use your bullet score to attack zombie enemies. Each zombie stays for a limited time — defeat them before they flee! Stronger zombies appear with even better rewards once the current one is beaten. Keep winning 8 ball pool games and defeating zombies to earn endless rewards in billiards!
Upgrade Tech & Heroes
 Play 8 ball pool matches and open chests to earn Coins, NoirGold and Diamonds. Play 8 ball battle to upgrade your tech tree and heroes to boost your score and zombie damage — and watch your power grow exponentially. Sharpen your aim, increase your duel, and challenge other players in a fast-paced 8 ball battle game, proving your skills in every shot. 
Join an Alliance
 Join forces with players worldwide — share rewards, speed up progress, boost Alliance tech and clash in Alliance vs Alliance battles. Together, you’ll grow faster and have more fun. Start the journey of 8 ball battle!
Daily Events & Challenges
 Jump into daily missions, hourly activities and weekly guild events. There’s always something to do — more ways to grow and earn big rewards in 8 ball battle. Join the 24/7 exciting challenge with updates from time to time in this 8 ball pool game.
Game Highlights:
- Classic 8-ball pool reimagined with upgrades, rewards and exciting challenges
- Bullet score system for ranking and zombie battles
- Upgrade your gear, heroes and tech for stronger plays
- No gambling — just play, improve and grow
- Friendly Alliance system with rich features
- Unique zombie-themed 8 ball pool experience
- Endless events and daily missions
Whether you're here for casual fun or the thrill of billiards, 8 Ball Battle has it all. Pot balls, earn power and push back the undead! Download 8 Ball Battle now and start your journey to becoming a 8 ball pool Legend!

bluejetty:00039088:ios.description:
Rakuten Link's basic features
■Calls: Unlimited domestic calling
Rakuten Mobile subscribers can make unlimited calls and send Link message to Rakuten Link users, as well as to other mobile networks and landline numbers in Japan and in 66 designated countries and regions through Rakuten Link. Calls to mobile phones and landlines including other carriers in Japan are free when calling to a Japanese number (some numbers not included).
■Messages: Fun group messages
You can create chat groups with other Rakuten Link users for up to 100 people, and share photos, videos, and documents, as well as messages.
■Home: Your gateway to all of Rakuten Group’s exciting offers and services!
As a Rakuten Mobile user, you can now enjoy easier, one-stop access to not only your favorite services in Rakuten Link but also exclusive deals across Rakuten Group services! Call, message, Check data usage and billing, earn points by using the Rakuten Link‘s Super Point Screen, chat with AI, access key Rakuten Group services and do much more - all from one screen!
■my Rakuten Mobile: Manage Account, Check Data Usage & Billing, and Get Customer Support
As a Rakuten Mobile user, you can check your data usage, billing information, payment status, and service details anytime. You can also apply for or modify optional services directly in the app. In Customer Support, you can find answers by browsing categories, searching by keyword, or using chat support.
*Chat response times may vary depending on inquiry volume.
■Wallet : Check Rakuten point status and access payment services easily
Using Rakuten Link's Wallet, you can send Rakuten Cash to anyone, pay and collect Rakuten Points through Rakuten Point Card, quickly check your Point balances such as "Available Points", "Term limited Points", etc., and conveniently access the Rakuten Pay app!
■Rakuten Link Super Point Screen : Earn Rakuten points easily just by looking at ads.
This is the Rakuten official “Point Reward” App. You can earn point quickly and effortlessly without any hassle. It’s not just about earning points; you can also discover promotional information and discounts.
■Missions: Earn points by using the app and participating in campaigns! Earn Rakuten points by using the app and participating in exciting campaigns. You can also check Start 1000, SPU (Super Point Up program), and the completion status of Start Bonus.
Additionally, follow the Mission Official Account and never miss out on current Point Campaigns and other promotions. Look out for updates from your favorite Official Accounts!
■News: Get news and weather info.
You can get the latest news every day and clip news for reading later. You can also check the weather forecast for the area you live in. 
* Certain numbers may not be supported. A 30-second call costs 22 yen when not using the app.　
* Certain numbers may not qualify for free calls.
For more detail information, please refer below links (Japanese).
https://network.mobile.rakuten.co.jp/service/rakuten-link/index.html

bluejetty:00182484:ios.description:
Become the Ultimate Supermarket Emperor!
Ready to take your humble market to the big leagues? Join the shopping frenzy and become a supermarket emperor in Hypermarket 3D! This engaging cashier game allows you to build the shopping paradise of your dreams.
Scan and Unlock Shiny Treasures!
Discover exciting new items and unlock them as you progress! The longer you play, the more unique items you will find to showcase.
Organize with Precision!
Sort your items and stock your shelves in perfect order—the neater and more organized, the better! Help your customers find what they need by keeping your store tidy.
Cart-Surfing Adventures!
Take a wild ride through the parking lot on your shopping cart for maximum fun! Can you chain them together without crashing into your customers’ cars?
Cleaning Frenzy!
Wipe your supermarket floor sparkling clean to keep your shoppers happy! Grab your mop and start cleaning to build the cleanest grocery store in town!
Colorful and Exciting Levels!
Each level offers fun and unique challenges with JUICY stages! Build the ultimate supermarket by completing all stages.
Easier Gameplay, More Fun!

ALWAYS KEEP YOUR BEST TOOLS WITHIN REACH. Everything AMSOIL. One tap away.
Protection You Demand. Performance You Deserve.®
AMSOIL products and tools now fit in your pocket. The AMSOIL Mobile app delivers the power of AMSOIL.com in a faster, smarter, more personalized experience. Whether you’re maintaining your daily driver, managing a garage full of toys, or building your next head-turner, AMSOIL puts premium protection and performance at your fingertips. From cars and trucks to motorcycles, boats, ATVs, UTVs, snowmobiles, and small engines — one app for every engine and every oil change.
Key Features
MyGarage
Add your vehicles, track maintenance and oil changes, set reminders and reorder AMSOIL products tailored to each ride.
License Plate & VIN Scanner
Scan your plate or VIN for instant product recommendations — no guesswork, just the right synthetic oil and filters.
Shop & Reorder with Ease
Browse AMSOIL synthetic motor oils by vehicle type, shop new products and reorder quickly when it’s time for your next oil change.
Fast & Secure Login
Access your account with Face ID or Touch ID biometric security.
Stay Updated
Get notifications for exclusive promotions, new product launches and personalized maintenance reminders.
Your Garage. Your Way.
From cars and trucks to motorcycles, boats, ATVs, UTVs, and snowmobiles — the AMSOIL app personalizes your experience to your vehicles and preferences.
Why Choose AMSOIL?
For over 50 years, AMSOIL has led the industry in synthetic motor oil innovation, delivering the protection you demand and the performance you deserve. With the AMSOIL app, you can get product recommendations for your vehicles, track oil changes and maintenance across your garage, and order products anytime, anywhere.
AMSOIL develops synthetic lubricants engineered to solve the toughest challenges for vehicles and equipment. From automotive and diesel engines to powersports, marine, racing, and small engines, our products deliver proven performance trusted worldwide.
We engineer lubricant solutions that protect your equipment, extend service life, and give enthusiasts confidence their vehicles and equipment are protected.
Join the AMSOIL community and experience the difference. Download AMSOIL Mobile today.

bluejetty:00173763:ios.description:
Roll, crush and build in Roll Machine - the most satisfying ASMR smashing game!
Drive your giant roller across fields of stone, crush everything in your path and haul the load to your factory. Turn every rock into cash, upgrade your machine and watch your empire grow. Simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.
KEY FEATURES
Satisfying Crushing
Steer a heavy roller through stone, crystal and themed blocks. Every crack, crunch and smash is designed to feel great - pure ASMR fun.
Upgrade Your Machine
Spend your earnings on a bigger roller, more speed, more capacity, a magnet, a helper track and powerful detonators. Every upgrade makes you visibly stronger.
Factory & Economy
Deliver crushed loads to the factory conveyor and convert them into money. Keep earning even while you are away with offline income.
Build Your City
Use your earnings to construct and expand your own city district, building by building.
Arena Battles
Enter timed arena battles against rival roller machines in themed maps. Out-crush your rivals and win rewards.
Power-Up Cards
Collect and upgrade cards that boost your income, speed and battle performance.
Endless Variety
Fresh themed levels with new obstacles, a road-crossing mini mode, daily rewards and quests keep every session exciting.
Skins
Unlock exclusive truck and character skins and roll in style.
Play offline, anytime. No account needed.
Download Roll Machine now and start smashing!

bluejetty:00085208:ios.description:
Get the most out of your Caffè Nero experience! Our app is the easiest way of paying and earning rewards every time you make a purchase. Scan your phone to pay securely and instantly collect loyalty stamps - all in less than 2 seconds!
It’s free, fast, and easy to use - we make each of your payments become a fun and rewarding experience.
PAY IN-STORE
With one scan of the app, you’ll pay, earn stamps, and receive a digital receipt. 
YOUR DIGITAL STAMP CARD
Instantly earn stamps every time you purchase a barista made drink with our app. Once our stamp card is complete we will send you a voucher for your favorite treat!
FIND A STORE
Easily find your way to the closest coffee, with our in-app store finder.
CLICK & COLLECT
Save time and seamlessly place your order and pay ahead of your arrival. Our baristas will have it ready for you at our collection point.
SHARE YOUR VOUCHERS 
Surprise your friends by sharing love and freebies with them. But if you don’t we won’t tell.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR SPENDING
No more paper receipts cluttering your wallet - all your purchases and digital receipts are visible in your activity feed.
SECURITY
Caffè Nero never holds onto your money or your payment details. 
Our QR code payment technology is randomized every few seconds so codes cannot be duplicated for fraudulent use. Set your passcode to ensure that you are the only one making payments from your account.
Any questions? Contact us at support@yoyowallet.com

bluejetty:00037026:ios.summary: Takes the guesswork out of what is clean at the grocery store by helping you chose products made with simple ingredients. Curious if a product has clean ingredients? Point your camera at the barcode and get answers immediately. Empower you
bluejetty:00037026:ios.description:
Takes the guesswork out of what is clean at the grocery store by helping you chose products made with simple ingredients. Curious if a product has clean ingredients? Point your camera at the barcode and get answers immediately. Empower your health by making informed choices. Discover the easiest way to transform your shopping habits and nourish your body with the healthiest foods.
The food industry has made food really confusing - no one knows how the food is made, where it is coming from or what the ingredients do to you. The only thing that has been shoved in our face is nutrition facts and selling points on a box – it’s time to discover what’s really inside of the food - the ingredients. This app will help you understand if a food is clean or not clean based on the ingredients. It will highlight which ingredients are good, okay and bad. This will help you make an informed decision. You will be able to find foods you love and feel good again. 
If you choose to purchase Monthly or Yearly payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period or free trial. Prices for yearly are $29.99 a year USD, and monthly is $4.99 a month USD. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Terms Of Service Link: https://jensmiley.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy Link: https://jensmiley.com/privacy-policy/
