bluejetty:00131051:ios.name: Polar Team
bluejetty:00131051:ios.summary:
** Polar Team is ranked among the top 10 Health and Fitness apps in 18 countries!
Polar Team allows coaches and trainers of any indoor sports team – basketball, ice hockey, indoor tennis, volleyball and more – to see exactly how hard each
bluejetty:00131051:ios.description:
** Polar Team is ranked among the top 10 Health and Fitness apps in 18 countries!
Polar Team allows coaches and trainers of any indoor sports team – basketball, ice hockey, indoor tennis, volleyball and more – to see exactly how hard each team member is working. This allows you to coach each of them individually, in real time. It also provides information to see who is tiring, who needs to work on their fitness, and who may have energy left in the tank.
To coach with Polar Team, you’ll need an iPad and a compatible Polar heart rate sensor or a sport watch for each player.* Follow the performance of your whole team or concentrate on one player at a time. Spot the differences and guide your players at once. Compare several players on screen in real time. Motivate your players by showing them their effort on the go during training. After the training Polar Team reveals objective data on your players’ performance and shares reports with your players and coaching staff. Use the data to plan your next session.
*Compatible devices: https://support.polar.com/en/support/FAQs/Compatibility_and_Requirements_Polar_Team_app
Key features:
-Follow your team’s heart rates on screen in real time (in beats per minute and percentage of maximum heart rate, and by target heart rate zone)
-Guide and motivate your players at once, as a team or individually
-Compare chosen players on screen during training
-See objective data on the effort of the whole team and each player individually after the training (average and maximum heart rate per session, calorie consumption, accumulated time in heart rate zones, heart rate curve, weekly training overview)
-Share this data with your team and coaching staff via email as a pdf summary
Coach your team to the top with Polar Team.
Discover more about Polar Team sports solutions at:
http://www.polar.com/en/b2b_products/team_sports
Note: We recommend using the app in indoor team sports only due to limitations in the Bluetooth Smart transmission range. The maximum line-of-sight coverage for Bluetooth Smart transmission is around 60 meters (66 yards).

bluejetty:00060681:ios.description:
Bible German
Version: Luther's Bible 1912
Read God's Word without internet. The app was conceived to propagate and make The Christian Bible studies easier through reading and listening anytime and anywhere, with resources such as: Audiobook, Search, Favorite, Note, colorful markers, Sharing Versicles, Devotionals, Hymnal, Biblical Plans, Biblical Dictionary, Bible Themes and Maps.
This friendly application can accompany you everywhere, making the Word of God accessible at any time for a blessed day.
The Team who has elaborated and keeps improving this oficial application(*) believes that God’s Word must reach everyone easily, quickly and clearly. Our App was the first offline Holy Bible on the app stores and now there are Christians from more than 168 countries using it.
Details:
o Reading Plans: several Reading Plans that can help you study Bible texts or specific topics.
o Bible Themes: find verses according to more than 700 themes.
o Versicles: resources to highlight, mark with colours, bookmarks, copy, add personal notes. Share verses on Whatsapp, Facebook, Instagram and others, Use the Verse of the Day Widget and create verses images. 
o Reading Progress: users can mark the chapters as "read" and can track the percentages of what they have read in relation to each book, the whole Bible, and the Old and New Testaments.
o Audio: audio versions for all translations, including NIV Live Audio, with Oscar winning cast and renowned Pastors. The audio is synchronized with the reading of the verses.
o Geochurch: feature to find churches near your location, using the GPS system of your cell phone.
o Searching System: option for the whole Bible, Old Testament, New Testament or separate by book. Users can type more than one word or parts of the verses in the search. 
o Reading Comfort: Adapt word size, choose the font and activate nocturnal reading mode.
Other Features:
• Words of Jesus in red;
• Book Introduction (informations and curiosities about the book);
• Book list in alfabetic order;
• Option to remove ads;
• Biblical dictionary with more than 900 words;
• Audio versions for all translations, including NIV Live Audio, with Oscar winning cast and renowned Pastors;
• Sharing verses as images to be posted on social networks.
More than 80 versions in different languages. In German you will find: 
• Luther (1912) - LUTN
• Luther (1545) - LUT
• Elbefelder (1871) - ELB
• Elvefelder (1905) - ELBN
• OT: Aleppo Codex - ALE
Other important versions available are: King James Version (KJV) and New International Version (NIV) in English, Reina Valera in Spanish and the original Greek and Hebrew.
Acknowledgements:
(*) Official Application = according to copyright, including authorized content.

bluejetty:00116299:ios.name: Hunter's Journey: Find Objects
bluejetty:00116299:ios.summary: Drown in mystery and danger in "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake", an atmospheric hidden object games adventure that blurs the line between hunter and hunted. In a world where ancient myths stir beneath the still waters, you play as Veli
bluejetty:00116299:ios.description:
Drown in mystery and danger in "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake", an atmospheric hidden object games adventure that blurs the line between hunter and hunted. In a world where ancient myths stir beneath the still waters, you play as Velimir, a determined young man desperate to prove his worth in a realm that scorns him. As you search for clues, find hidden objects, solve item search games, and face the chilling legends of the Lake of Tears, you’ll uncover secrets long forgotten… and confront the darkness that waits below!
Velimir has spent his life chasing the shadow of his father, desperate to prove himself. But without an Animorph by his side, he's an outcast among hunters. Until the chance to prove himself worthy arrives. Rodrik, his mentor and guardian, delivers his first real assignment - a mission that will test more than just his combat skills. A girl named Malena has disappeared from the village of Stillwater, nestled on the misty shores of the ominous Lake of Tears. The villagers whisper of mermaids with cold, dead eyes, dragging their victims into the abyss... Velimir and Rodrik begin their hunt, determined to solve the mystery and find Malena. But beneath the lake’s surface, something far more ancient - and far more dangerous - awaits.
· Journey Through a Haunting World!
Explore an unforgettable hidden journey through cursed waters and mist-covered ruins. This is one of the hidden object games that blends narrative depth with horror and fantasy elements. You'll find hidden objects in dim-lit caverns, shattered temples, and strange underwater realms!
· Discover Hundreds of Objects!
Put your skills to the test in a world crafted for lovers of hidden object games and item search games. With hand-drawn environments full of mysterious clues, you’ll need to carefully find hidden objects in cursed altars, hunter camps, and drowned ruins in search and find games!
· Solve Twisted Puzzles!
Your hidden journey is packed with riddles, cursed mechanisms, and ancient magic. Will you outwit the Lord of the Lake? For fans of puzzle mystery games, this adventure weaves puzzles directly into the narrative of mystery hidden object games, don’t forget to seek and find hidden objects along the way!
· Reclaim Velimir’s Destiny!
Progress through an achievement system that rewards exploration, cleverness, and a sharp eye for hidden object games. From locating elusive talismans to completing search and find games challenges across various maps, every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind the legends!
Explore shadowed shores and investigate sunken ruins in the free trial of the "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake"!

bluejetty:00165924:ios.description:
Welcome to this magical continent, transform into a radish warrior, and bravely embark on a journey of battle!
This is a fantasy mobile game that combines easy idle and deep RPG elements, allowing you to enjoy the endless fun of brave adventure in your leisure time.
[Automatic combat, easy upgrade]
There is no need for cumbersome operations, your Radish Warrior will automatically embark on the journey, fight fiercely with various monsters, and continue to gain rich experience and treasures, making upgrading simple and fast.

Thousands of unique equipment, more than a hundred unique partners, dozens of different professions, strategic combinations, and unlimited possibilities for unlocking lineups. Whether it's violent output or an impenetrable defensive formation, it's all in your hands.

Join a clan and fight alongside players from around the world. Participate in clan wars, fight against powerful BOSS together, and share strategies to make your adventure no longer lonely.
Become a Radish Warrior now and start your wonderful adventure in this mobile game that perfectly combines casual hang-up and in-depth role-playing! No need to wait all the time, but the fun never stops.

bluejetty:00029751:ios.description:
Bear is a beautiful, powerfully simple Markdown app to capture, write, and organize your life.
Take notes, plan your day, journal thoughts, organize tables, create lists and tasks, sketch ideas, link notes together, write a book, and much more. Bear is used by writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students, parents.. you get the picture. Getting started couldn’t be faster—no signup and no account. Just open a note and write naturally.
"My journaling app of choice is Bear" - Kit Eaton, New York Times
* 2017 Apple Design Award 
* 2016 App Store App of the Year
* Editors' choice for 7 consecutive years
* Most of our parents love it
## BEAUTIFUL. SIMPLE. POWERFUL. PRIVATE
- Tools stay out of your way so you can just write
- Sketch ideas on iPad with an extendable canvas and Apple Pencil (and other styli)
- Clip web pages and other content with Bear’s app extension
- The redesigned Info Panel now with Table of Contents and Backlinks
- Use Apple Watch to dictate and append to recent notes
- Support for all the scripts including RTL languages like Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian
- Easily create notes with Siri and Shortcuts
- Your notes, not ours - Bear is private at its core: We cannot see your notes, tags, or anything else
## FLEXIBLE MARKDOWN
- Work in plain text - easy to move between apps
- Still use formatting like bold, italics, strikethrough, links, tables, and more with Markdown
- Combine text styles like bold and underline, even in headings
- Markdown hides for a clean reading experience
- Use WikiLinks to connect notes and build a personal wiki or knowledge management tool
## GET ORGANIZED with #tags, tasks, and more
- Add #tags, #multi-word tags# and even #multiple/nested/tags anywhere in a note for quick organization
- Pin important tags to the top of the Sidebar
- Make important tags stand out in the Sidebar with TagCons
- Add tasks to notes and easily view all notes that include tasks
- Fold sections to get them out of the way
## SHARING MADE EASY
- Export notes to plain text, Markdown, TextBundle, Bear note, and rich text
- Export notes to HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub (Bear Pro required)
- Easily share your notes to any third-party app with the Share Sheet
## SEARCH FAR AND WIDE
- Use Spotlight to search your notes from anywhere
- Search for text inside photos and PDFs (Bear Pro required)
- Focus on specific types of notes with powerful Special Searches like @todo, @images, and @yesterday 
## CREATE YOUR COZY SPACE
* Pick from nearly 30 themes for the perfect writing space in both Light and Dark Mode (Bear Pro required)
* Choose an app icon that speaks to your personality (Bear Pro required)
* Set your own fonts for plain text, headings, and code
* Set line height and width, paragraph spacing, and more
## GET MORE WITH BEAR PRO
One subscription enables a variety of features on all your devices and keeps the Bear hugs coming.
- Sync notes between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud
- Encrypt individual notes with a password that is entirely private to you
- Lock Bear with Face/Touch ID
- Export to more formats including HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub
- Search for text inside images and PDFs in Bear notes
- Over 30 beautiful app themes & app icons
$2.99 monthly
$29.99 yearly
14-day free trial
-----
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00018813:ios.description:
Love dim sum, but don't know what to order or how to order? Bring this app, find what you like, and tap the speaker icon to hear the dish pronounced in Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin) using iOS text-to-speech.
I made this app after visiting Hong Kong and trying to crash course learn Cantonese in the food courts. The early focus was just on dim sum and Cantonese text-to-speech and my favorite restaurants, but has since expanded (based on user tips and requests and my own interests) to more broadly cover Chinese and Chinese-adjacent food (over five hundred dishes) and include features such as Mandarin (traditional and simplified), search (English and Chinese), saving favorites, AI camera recognition of dishes, speech-to-text pronunciation practice, basic phrases, and over five hundred restaurants in the US (sorry, I gave up on trying to list every restaurant in the world, it's just not feasible).
Tips:
If the voice is stuck in Cantonese or Mandarin even after switching the tabs in the Practice screen, go to the Settings app, select Accessibility then Spoken Content and check the Chinese voice. If it's not one of the Siri voices, try selecting Siri in Mainland China, Hong Kong, or Taiwan.
If you don't hear the Chinese speech
1) check the mute switch on your iPhone and make sure it isn't on.
2) text-to-speech for a particular voice sometimes seems to require an internet connect, at least on initial use (same with speech-to-text, the microphone practice button).
2) sometimes a device will have trouble accessing the text-to-speech voice (it's the Hong Kong Chinese voice used for Accessibility in Settings), so try turning your device off and on.
Tapping the speaker icon plays back the Chinese pronunciation at half speed to help you learn. Tap the microphone icon to bring up more options, including adjusting the playback speed, switching between Cantonese and Mandarin, and practicing speaking (the speed and language settings are also in Settings).
Aside from the default speed, the speech may sound not quite natural because the app does not play back recorded speech but instead uses iOS text-to-speech functionality, which utters one character (i.e. one syllable) at a time, which may not match how an entire compound word or phrase is normally pronounced (you can hear this effect when using Siri).
The home screen shows categories of dishes. Tap each category to see the dishes. Or tap on the Search button at the top left (some vocabulary items like "takeout" are not in categories but available in via search).
Talk Dim Sum is developed with:
The dim sum icon from Stock Image Folio on Iconfinder.com.
The technicat logo designed by Dakota Snow.
Restaurant link icons from Simple Icons.
Photos from many dim sum excursions.
Regional map images from Wikipedia (Creative Commons License from Wikimedia).
Swift open source packages: AlertToast, ImagePickerView, LinksKit, Qgrid, SQLite.swift, SwiftUIPager, and SwiftyJSON.

Aside from the default speed, the speech may sound not quite natural because the app does not play back recorded speech but instead uses iOS text-to-speech functionality, which utters one character (i.e. one syllable) at a time, which may not match how an entire compound word or phrase is normally pronounced (you can hear this effect when using Siri).

The home screen shows categories of dishes. Tap each category to see the dishes. Or tap on the Search button at the top left (some vocabulary items like "takeout" are not in categories but available in via search).

Talk Dim Sum is developed with:

The dim sum icon from Stock Image Folio on Iconfinder.com.
The technicat logo designed by Dakota Snow.
Restaurant link icons from Simple Icons.
Photos from many dim sum excursions.
Regional map images from Wikipedia (Creative Commons License from Wikimedia).
Swift open source packages: AlertToast, ImagePickerView, LinksKit, Qgrid, SQLite.swift, SwiftUIPager, and SwiftyJSON.

bluejetty:00136903:ios.description:
• #1 Most Downloaded Game (April, May, June, July 2021) — Japan Mac App Store!
• Featured in Apple's "What We're Playing", "Games We Love" and "Best Games Made in France"!
• "Beautiful, minimalistic and highly addictive." — TouchArcade
• "A simple but captivating game." — Mac4Ever
• "From us, this small but fine application therefore receives an absolute recommendation." — Appgefahren
• "Whether you're a fan of the game or not, Piccolo will make you love Othello." — MaxiApple
Piccolo® is the best Othello app for iPhone®, iPad® and Mac®. It features a strong, fast AI on top of a polished user interface, with beautiful themes, advanced features, online play and more. Piccolo is available in 20 languages and comes with no ads or tracking. It's an Othello app made for Othello players by Othello lovers.
 • Strong AI: Piccolo features a custom Othello AI engine written in the Rust programming language, designed to be fast, challenging and customizable. The AI's default Level 1 difficulty can be beaten by beginners, while its Level 8 difficulty is likely to challenge even top Othello masters around the world. Designed from scratch, the Piccolo AI engine is sure to give seasoned Othello players a new type of opponent to play against, with often surprising and creative strategies.
 • User Experience: Piccolo features a native user experience designed for iOS and macOS. A modern design lets you focus on the game, with helpful move indicators, the ability to undo moves, and automatic game saves between every move in case you close the app by mistake or your phone's battery runs out. Multiplayer play is supported both locally and online.
 • Themes: Piccolo features a variety of beautiful themes to customize and breathe fresh life into your Othello experience. Othello veterans might enjoy sticking to the Classic theme, while others might prefer the handsome Seasoned Wood theme, the adorable Sailor Moon theme or even the Persian Spray theme, inspired by traditional Iranian ceramics. Additional themes designed by guest artist Aline Corrêa are also available, giving you access to an Othello game on top of an alligator lake, inside an ancient castle, next to Egyptian pyramids, and more!
 • Play Online: Piccolo Online is a free online service that lets you connect with friends via easily exchangeable Game Codes to play friendly Othello games wherever you are around the world. Piccolo Online also supports automatic matchmaking so that you can quickly play games with random opponents worldwide. Piccolo Online features quick, stable connections, and benefits from a strong privacy policy.
 • Cute iMessage Stickers: Send cute “chibi”-style iMessage stickers to your friends with Piccolo's bundled iMessage Sticker Pack! Featuring 36 custom illustrations drawn by anime artist Erica Li, the stickers feature Piccolo's adorable mascot in different relatable situations.
 • No Ads, No Tracking: Unlike a majority of games on the App Store today, Piccolo has no terms you need to accept before playing. Piccolo will never show you a single ad, and will never track you. The app is entirely a labor of love for the game of Othello, made by players for players.
 • Available in 20 Languages: Thanks to contributions from players around the world, Piccolo has been translated from English into Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese. No matter where you are, Piccolo's interface will be easy to understand.
Othello® is a registered trademark of MegaHouse Corporation. Piccolo: Othello is an independent implementation of the underlying game, which is placed in the public domain.

Have you ever wished to keep your music playing while recording a video?

bluejetty:00125756:ios.description:
Have you ever wished to keep your music playing while recording a video? 
Hi there! Not too long ago, I grew tired of expensive subscriptions in a small market of recording apps that either had overly complicated features or lacked options altogether. So I turned a solution for me into a product for you.
Videou really is the ultimate video recording app designed for the gym-goer, musician or dancer that combines essential functionality with exclusive features that you won't find anywhere else.
Now on iOS 17+ you also have the choice to use a new recording mode "Shazam mode". This starts the video recording when the timestamp of a saved song is reached during playback. This is powered by Shazam and also works through wireless headphones. Flick through the slides to see how it works :) 
Features
- Continuously plays music from any streaming service while recording, whether you're connected via Bluetooth or not
- Flexible video storage options, allowing you to choose any location and easily access the most recent video in that album
- Supports your device's maximum resolution on both the front and back cameras for high-quality recordings
- Ability to control video recording with your Bluetooth headset's media buttons, enabling you to start or stop recording effortlessly
- Selectable fall-over detection with an on-screen and Bluetooth (if connected) audible alert, notifying you if your camera has been moved
- Fully functional even without a Bluetooth connection
- Option to select a countdown timer to aid in creating shorter videos, with the ability to customize timer intervals
- Choice to use automatic re-arming, allowing you to start recording again without returning to your phone
Main image credited at https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-sitting-on-flat-bench-3490348/
"Lady (Hear Me Tonight)" credited at https://music.apple.com/au/album/lady-hear-me-tonight/692624255?i=692624266

bluejetty:00062077:ios.description:
Welcome to ClassIn and embrace the new era of lifelong learning!
ClassIn, developed by Empower Education Online (EEO) for eight years, is an integrated teaching platform encompassing online live classrooms, offline smart classrooms, an LMS learning management system, and a PLE personal learning environment. ClassIn adheres to the essence of education, releasing the charm of teaching and learning, and cultivating independent and self-disciplined lifelong learners.
As of now, ClassIn has been favored by educators and learners across the globe:
· 150 countries 
· 2 million educators
· 30 million learners 
· 20,000 K12 schools, higher education institutions, and enterprises.
ClassIn effectively assists K12 schools, universities and enterprises with achieving high quality online, offline, hybrid, and intelligent teaching; ClassIn facilitates educators in creating a course system, knowledge space, learning community, and evaluation data that focus on learners; further, ClassIn enables teachers to enrich courses and teaching, and enhance students' core literacy and lifelong learning ability.
Hybrid Learning Solutions
ClassIn is widely praised for its comprehensive online and offline teaching solutions. It offers a seamless experience for up to 2000 people to attend online live classes, with 50 people's audio and video being displayed simultaneously. Furthermore, it provides a host of features, including collaborative blackboard, collaborative documents, group teaching and virtual experiments, to replicate the feeling of an offline environment. With its state-of-the-art intelligent teaching system, ClassIn provides an easy and efficient learning experience for both online and offline teaching.
Learning Management System (LMS)
ClassIn offers a comprehensive learning platform for traditional teaching activities, such as classrooms, homework, discussions, and assessments, to help students construct their own learning pathway. Moreover, with collaborative documents and internet communication, ClassIn promotes project-based, cooperative and inquiry-based learning, enabling students to practice and enhance their creativity, communication, and collaboration skills.
Personal Learning Environment (PLE) 
ClassIn enables personalized and lifelong learning. In the era of internet and artificial intelligence, knowledge is iterating rapidly and is no longer centered in schools or libraries, but dispersed in society and networks, which requires learners to take the initiative to learn and pursue lifelong learning. ClassIn will continuously upgrade the PLE personal learning environment to build a lifelong learning system and cultivate self-disciplined lifelong learners.
More to Explore on www.classin.com

bluejetty:00089498:ios.description:
Tired of stress and anxiety? Welcome to Manifest, your personal companion for motivation and mental wellness.
Meet your new friend—a star mascot dedicated to being your biggest supporter. Manifest is a free app designed to help you navigate feelings of depression and anxiety with supportive chat, or to supercharge your day with positive motivation. We're your 24/7 resource for building a healthier, happier mindset, one conversation at a time.
Manifest is your pocket companion if you are:
- A student navigating the pressures of school, exams, and social life.
- A young professional looking to build confident habits and a positive routine.
- Seeking free, supportive tools to supplement your mental health journey.
- Someone who wants a daily dose of motivation and a space to practice self-care.
How Manifest Supports You:
YOUR 24/7 SUPPORT COMPANION
Feeling anxious or overwhelmed? Our friendly, AI-powered chat is here to listen without judgment. It’s a safe space to unpack your thoughts, process difficult emotions like stress and anger, and find a moment of calm. Think of it as a supportive friend, available whenever you need it.
TOOLS TO CONQUER YOUR ANXIETY
Searching for free therapy options? We provide powerful tools that professionals recommend for self-guided wellness. Use our Mood Tracker to understand your emotional patterns. Unwind with our Guided Journal, which offers mindful prompts to help you reflect and find clarity before you sleep. These resources help you build resilience and manage your mental health on your own terms.
DAILY MOTIVATION & POSITIVITY
Get your daily dose of inspiration with personalized affirmations, positive reminders, and motivational quotes. Whether your goal is to practice gratitude, build self-love, or stay focused, our tools are designed to help you overcome self-doubt and create a positive daily routine.
TRACK YOUR GOALS & HABITS
True change comes from small, consistent actions. Our integrated goal and habit tracker makes it easy and fun. Set your personal wellness goals—from journaling every day to practicing mindfulness—track your progress, and get the support you need to stay consistent and celebrate your wins.
A Day with Manifest:
Imagine waking up not with dread, but with a personalized, positive affirmation that sets the tone for your day. Feeling a wave of anxiety at lunch? Open a 5-minute chat session to recenter yourself. Before bed, spend a few moments with a mindful journal prompt to calm your mind and prepare for a restful sleep. That is the power of having a companion dedicated to your well-being.
Disclaimer
Manifest offers supportive conversations, mental health motivation, and therapy alternatives, but it is not a substitute for professional therapy or medical care. If you are experiencing a crisis or need formal mental health support, please seek help from a licensed therapist, doctor, or another qualified health professional.
Download Manifest today to affirm your worth, fortify your mental wellness, and experience the transformative power of personalized self-care—right at your fingertips!

bluejetty:00141160:ios.description:
Get ready for a mesmerizing journey on the yellow brick road through the whimsical world of Emerald Merge! Inspired by Frank Baum's classic fairy tale, this captivating merge 3 game invites players to explore the vibrant landscapes of the Munchkin Country, Emerald City, Winkey Country, and beyond.
Build and grow your kingdom on the magical island. Collect keys to discover new and exciting adventures under the clouds. Each plot of land you unlock brings something new to the game. Discover treasure, and materials and build a cozy house for each of your friends.
Find and merge iconic elements from the Wizard of Oz universe! Help familiar heroes like Dorothy, Toto, and the Scarecrow to find their way to the magical island by merging their respective accessories.
Farm and grow various crops! Dorothy sure knows how to bake a tasty sweet treat. Collect ingredients for characters to turn into different dishes. Complete orders and get rewards! Merge copper pieces into gold Oz coins, and turn crystal shards into piles of riches. Be careful and plan your spending. Train your brain and carefully manage resources.  
Feel stuck? Catch the magical glowing seeds flying in the sky. Send your gnome workers to chop down trees, mine rocks, or harvest giant pumpkins… and many more! Find hidden chests. Will you open them right away or stash them for later and merge them to the max level? 
Decorate your island of dreams. Each character has a building and a theme of their own. Collect materials, merge, and build cute little houses. Once you've gathered four of each it's time to reveal a big castle! Come back every 24 hours for epic rewards from each castle you've built. Arrange them and decorate them with the materials and plants. 
Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, manage resources, and follow Dorothy & Friends on her quest to defeat an evil Witch of the West as you journey through captivating lands filled with surprises and challenges.
Here are more features:
Merge Magic: Combine items to create powerful new ones and progress through enchanting levels.
Work smart, not hard: Keep track of your progress and resources. Merge 5 items at once to get an extra high-level item
Puzzle Quests: Solve intricate puzzles and uncover hidden treasures as you explore the country of Oz.
Beloved Characters: Interact with cute heroes from the Wizard of Oz story, each with their unique charm.
Build & Customize: Rebuild the Emerald City and create your version of Oz. Merge, sort, and decorate to make an island your work of art.
Spin the Wheel: Log in daily to get rewards. Win lots of energy with each spin.
Special Events: Emerald Merge offers tons of special events that let players earn exclusive rewards and unlock new content.
Clean & Organize: Your board only has so much space! Sort all your items and be careful not to overflow them. Merge, collect, and keep a neat order on your dream island
Log in every day: Complete quests and challenges every day to get a lot of rewards!
Immerse yourself in the magic of Emerald Merge and experience the joy of merging in the beloved world of Oz! 
Download now and embark on a merging quest like no other.

bluejetty:00153941:ios.description:
Meet Albo by the feel good project.
Your universal save-for-later app - helping you finally *do* the things you save.
Albo is like a digital notebook for all your interests and hobbies. Save links, videos, recipes, workouts, places, and more - all in one place, beautifully organized and easy to find. Whether it's a recipe to cook, a trip to plan, or a movie to watch, Albo keeps it all where you can actually get to it.
Why Albo?
- Save anything you want to do - links, videos, books, recipes, workouts, tools, and places.
- See your world on the map - Albo pins your saves to a map.
- Organize with smart collections - build categories that make sense to you.
- Share with friends - swap collections and plan together.
- Simple & fast - save in seconds, find it when you need it.
Perfect for:
- Planning your next trip (save places, hotels, guides).
- Collecting recipes to cook later.
- Tracking movies and books to enjoy.
- Saving workouts and training plans.
- Keeping a library of tools and apps to try.
With Albo, "I'll check this later" becomes "done."
Download Albo and start saving - then do the thing.

bluejetty:00099121:ios.description:
Space Waves – CrazyGames
Dash through space and feel the geometry vibes. Test your reflexes across 80+ levels of rhythm and precision.
About the Game:
Space Waves is a rhythm-based arcade game that challenges your speed, timing, and focus. Control your arrow through geometric paths filled with obstacles, sharp turns, and rotating traps. Every level is a test of reflexes and reaction time.
With more than 80 handcrafted levels, Space Waves combines geometry-inspired design, dashing movement, and flowing momentum to create a satisfying challenge for casual and hardcore players alike.
Features:
80+ handcrafted levels with geometric precision
Free level selection — play any level, anytime
Increasing difficulty with fresh patterns as you progress
Instant restarts for fast, addictive gameplay
Smooth, responsive controls for precise dashing
Rhythm and flow that make every run satisfying
How to Play:
Move your arrow through each level without crashing into walls, spikes, or moving obstacles. Stages are color-coded by difficulty — from easy green zones to extreme red challenges. Find your rhythm, react quickly, and aim for a perfect run.
Tips:
Zigzag through narrow spaces for smoother control
Master timing on easier levels before tackling hard ones
Sync your moves to the rhythm for the smoothest dashes
If you enjoy geometry-inspired challenges, rhythm-based movement, and fast arcade action, Space Waves – CrazyGames delivers. Challenge your reflexes, unlock your flow, and conquer the waves.
Download Space Waves now and start dashing through 80+ rhythmic levels.
Rated for ages 3+ by IGRS (Indonesian Games Rating System).

bluejetty:00033209:ios.description:
It's time to upgrade your piano playing experience. Simply Play is the fun easy app, with unlimited access to all the sheet music you love, fit to your level. Enjoy a seamless experience anytime, anywhere with scores personalized to your taste and adapted to your skill level. 
Simply Play is the new Piano companion, one app for all your piano playing needs.
- Easily browse & search for what you want to play
- Unlimited access to quality piano sheet music - no restrictions
- Access a curated library of songs across all genres: Classical, Movie Soundtracks, Musicals…
- Enjoy song recommendations based on your preferences & skill level
- Play along with premium music scores, arranged by world-class musicians
- Auto scroll through music notes and adjust the speed to fit your pace
- Preview music & listen to phrases of songs you intend to play
- Personalize & organize your scores in one place, easily access songs you've played with just one click
Say goodbye to fumbling through papers, speedily turning pages and say hello to the next generation of piano playing, digital sheet music. Optimized to your playing needs. 
How it works:
- Place your device (iPhone/iPad/iPod) on your acoustic/MIDI piano or keyboard 
- Easily browse or search specific songs in your curated music catalog 
- Select a song & your playing level, then easily preview the song 
- You're all set! Enable autoscroll to easily follow notes, and begin to play
Simply Play is developed by Simply, creators of award-winning apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, Piano Maestro and Piano Dust Buster. Developed by world-class musicians, the apps are used by millions of players, and tens of thousands of music teachers worldwide with over 1 million songs learned every week. Simply are experts in creating educational and fun music apps for playing & learning piano.
Simply Apps have received awards & recognition for over the last 12 years, including titles such as: 
- "Editor's Choice" and "App of the day" - Apple
- "EMI’s Innovation Challenge"
- "World Summit Award", by the United Nations
- "Best Tablet Game", GameIS
- "Parents' Choice Award"
- "Golden App", Apps for Homeschooling
Have questions, feedback or suggestions? Reach out to play@hellosimply.com
Enjoy Playing!
privacy policy: https://www.hellosimply.com/legal/privacy
terms of use: https://www.hellosimply.com/legal/terms

Get ready to transform the way you think about chess! Hungry Horses is a unique chess puzzle trainer that focuses on mastering the knight’s tricky movements. It's a fun visualization exercise.
And now, it includes Offline Chess Games against our chess bots.
Join Tex and Jerri, two daring horses, as they escape their blitz chess-obsessed owner. Explore farms, orchards, and wild landscapes while solving puzzles that challenge your logic and train your chess skills for beginners and experts, kids and adults!
Features You’ll Love:
 * Offline Chess bots
 * Knight-Focused Gameplay: Learn the hardest chess moves in a fun and engaging way.
 * Story-Driven Adventure: Follow Tex and Jerri’s journey to freedom in Quest Mode.
 * Practice Mode: Perfect your knight visualization skills.
 * Leaderboards and Achievements: Compete daily and track your progress.
 * Customization: Personalize your chessboard and stable.
 * Daily Puzzles: A new difficult challenge every day!
 * Quest Mode: Explore farms, forests, and more.
 * Practice Mode: Hone your skills at your own pace.
 * Power ups!
Why Choose Hungry Horses?
Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned player, this game is for you. If you love Sudoku, brain teasers, or logic puzzles, you’ll enjoy the challenges Hungry Horses offers.
What Players Are Saying:
5 STARS! "It’s more than a game — it’s a trainer disguised as fun!"
5 STARS! "I’ve always struggled with knight moves, but now I actually enjoy them."

Why Go Premium?

• Detailed price insights & trends
• Unlimited custom collection tracking
• Perfect for growing or large card collections

- Those who've always wanted to play the games featured on the Earth Arcade show!

- Players looking for hassle-free gaming, anytime and anywhere - no data worries!
- Hipsters at heart who cherish the retro vibes of the 90s!

bluejetty:00156502:ios.description:
Cooking shouldn’t be complicated. Units is a fast, accurate kitchen converter that helps you switch between 40+ cooking units instantly. With a growing catalogue of 400+ ingredients, Units gives you precise weight to volume conversions based on real ingredient densities.
No scale or measuring cup? Register any container you have at home and Units will tell you exactly how many of those you need for your recipe.
Lightweight, modern, and easy to use, Units works 100% offline and supports geographic measurements from the US, UK, Australia, France, and Germany. It’s designed to be your reliable companion in the kitchen; whether you're following international recipes or adjusting portions on the fly.
FEATURES
- Instant conversions for weight, volume, temperature, and distance
- Volume to Weight conversion using 400+ ingredients
- Register your own containers as measuring tools
- Built-in calculator
- Favorites and fractions support
- 100% offline
- Modern, fast interface
- Geographic units (US, UK, AU, FR, DE)
- Siri Shortcuts
- Dark Mode
- No ads. No tracking.
SUPPORTED UNITS
Celsius, Fahrenheit, Gas Mark, Thermostat, Stufe, Milligram, Gram, Kilogram, Ounce, Pound, Inch, Centimetre, Meter, Millimetre, Millilitre, Centilitre, Decilitre, Litre, Tablespoon, Teaspoon, Fluid Ounce, Cup, Pint, and more.
TIPS
Enable geographic units in Settings
Create custom units from the Unit List
Add Siri shortcuts from the Shortcuts app
If you enjoy Units, please consider leaving a rating or review. Your feedback helps us grow!

bluejetty:00083187:ios.name: AI Tattoo Maker & Generator
bluejetty:00083187:ios.summary:
Welcome to AI Tattoo world! Design your tattoos & see them on your body before they're inked—AI-powered creativity at your fingertips!
AI Tattoo is your personal tattoo artist in your pocket, powered by cutting-edge artificial intelligence
bluejetty:00083187:ios.description:
Welcome to AI Tattoo world! Design your tattoos & see them on your body before they're inked—AI-powered creativity at your fingertips!
AI Tattoo is your personal tattoo artist in your pocket, powered by cutting-edge artificial intelligence and augmented reality (AR). Whether you're dreaming of your first tattoo or looking to add to your collection, AI Tattoo offers endless possibilities for creating stunning, personalized designs. With just a few taps, you can generate unique tattoo concepts based on your preferences—whether it’s traditional, abstract, or something entirely new.
The app goes beyond just design. You can take a photo of your body and use the built-in AR technology to virtually apply the tattoo directly onto your skin. This allows you to see exactly how the design will look on your body in real-time before making any commitments. Experiment with placement, sizing, and different angles until it’s perfect.
Key Features:
AI-Powered Tattoo Design: Create custom tattoo designs tailored to your style, whether you want something simple or complex.
Stencils and Customization: Fine-tune your design by choosing different line styles, shading options, and patterns.
AR Try-On: Visualize how your tattoo will look on your body using AR technology. Snap a photo and "try on" your design for the perfect fit.
Ink & Color Options: Choose from a variety of ink colors and effects to see what suits your design and skin tone best.
Save & Share: Save your designs to revisit later or share with friends and tattoo artists for feedback.
AI Tattoo combines creativity, precision, and technology, making it easier than ever to design and try out tattoos before committing. Whether you're experimenting with ideas or preparing for your next inking session, AI Tattoo helps you bring your body art vision to life!
Community Guidelines: https://static.aitattoo.app/community-guidelines-en.html
Privacy Policy: https://static.aitattoo.app/privacy-en.html
Terms and Condition: https://static.aitattoo.app/terms-conditions-en.html

bluejetty:00147284:ios.name: WEconnect Health
bluejetty:00147284:ios.summary: WEconnect is a versatile mobile app that empowers individuals on their journey towards mental wellness. This tool is designed to assist those dealing with various behavioral health concerns, including anxiety, grief, substance use disorders
bluejetty:00147284:ios.description:
WEconnect is a versatile mobile app that empowers individuals on their journey towards mental wellness. This tool is designed to assist those dealing with various behavioral health concerns, including anxiety, grief, substance use disorders (SUD), mental health issues, and other challenges that affect quality of life.
Using the WEconnect app you can
- Meet 1 on 1 with a dedicated peer support specialist
- Attend online support meetings
- Track your goals and create healthy habits
- Celebrate your progress
- Stay on track with your recovery
* note: peer support is only available to those who are signed up through their employer or insurance provider
Get the app to join online support meetings instantly!
WEconnect has been crafted by individuals who possess deep, personal insights into the challenges of maintaining mental and emotional health. We know everyone’s journey is different. That’s why we made the app: to help people improve their lives.
With multiple meetings hosted every day, WEconnect provides instant access to a supportive online community of people in recovery.
Our online recovery meetings are a safe space. They’re open to anyone dealing with substance use, mental health concerns, disordered eating, and any other quality of life concerns.
Meetings are open to all pathways and recovery statuses. They’re led by our certified Peer Support Specialists, compassionate folks who have firsthand experience with recovery.
Thousands of people from all over the world have found a recovery community in our meetings. Find your meeting today!
We also offer specialty meetings for harm reduction, women, LGBTQIA+, and family and loved ones of those in recovery.
After 6 months, 84% of our surveyed members agree or strongly agree that WEconnect helps them reach their recovery goals.
Our certified peer support specialists will support you along the way. They’re people with real-world recovery experience who know what you’re going through. Get matched with a dedicated peer who can help you find the recovery lifestyle that works best for you.
Create an account and add your rewards code to unlock all of WEconnect’s rewarding features!
——————
We'd love to hear from you! Contact support@weconnectrecovery.com with questions or feedback.
Your security is important to us, and we take your privacy seriously. We follow all state and federal laws and regulations to protect your data (including, but not limited to HIPAA compliance standards).

bluejetty:00182042:android.description:
Weather forecast is one of the best weather app to know today weather or weather tomorrow is good or not.
You want to see weather today to go to school, to work, or want to see weather for the next few days, next week, next 2 weeks to travel. It is very easy with the weather forecast app.
🌦 Main features of free weather forecast app
✔️Weather report information: display all information of weather: location real-time, current temperature, atmospheric pressure, weather condition, visibility distance, relative humidity, precipitation in different units, dew point, wind speed and direction etc..
✔️Weather world : weather forecast for global, for all countries. It provides specific information about local weather of different countries such as United States weather (US weather), United Kingdom (UK), Japan, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Korea, Spain, Portugal, South Africa, Hong Kong, Russia etc.
✔️Local weather: weather forecast of many other locations especially big cities like New York(NYC weather), California(Los Angeles CA weather) London, Paris, Tokyo, Berlin, Seoul and so on at the same time.
✔️My location weather: When the user allows the app weather automatically detect GPS or over the network, the app will get information about your weather location . In addition, the app weather forecast also allows searching for weather information in various locations that users want.
✔️Hourly weather: weather forecast accurately the weather new among each hour per day.
✔️Daily weather: accurate weather forecast every day of the week.
✔️Weather chart: weather forecast charts in 24 hours, 7 day forecast and many charts helps users to see easier such as: temperature, precipitation, radar maps, wind, sun & moon charts .
✔️Weather radar: have weather radar to support looking wind direction, rain...
✔️Weather news: display history searching positions to see weather news.
✔️Weather widgets: You can easily view weather information via weather widgets with sizes: 4*1, 4*2, 4*3, 4*4.
✔️Weather notifications: have notifications whenever new weather information.
✔️Weather alert: temperature change notification, rain forecast, clouds and snow.
✔️Weather setting: mult

bluejetty:00019591:ios.description:
No. 1 App for file upload/download on iPhone/iPad! Most secure file download/upload tool for business and professional users. 
Supported features include: 
1. Download files from your iCloud Drive. Save local files to iCloud Drive.
2. Upload/download files to/from FTP/SFTP/FTPS servers.
3. Upload/download files to/from DropBox, Box, OneDrive, and GoogleDrive.
4. Support both user name/password and Private Key authentication for SFTP. Support both PPK and PEM keys. Support importing keys from/exporting keys to iCloud Drive under iTransfer/keys folder.
5. Email files. 
6. Manage files, including adding a folder, searching, renaming, moving or deleting files. 
7. View supported files, including: PDF, DOC, EXCEL, PPT, image files, TXT, etc.

Have you ever wanted to extract audio from a video file?
Video to MP3 allows you to convert video files into audio in seconds!

bluejetty:00145941:ios.summary: Enter the realm of sweet tastes with Pop Puzzle. Group jellies of the same shape or color to crush them, score points, solve puzzles and level up in this amazing match 3 game. With addictive match 3 gameplay, tons of challenges, amazing boo
bluejetty:00145941:ios.description:
Enter the realm of sweet tastes with Pop Puzzle. Group jellies of the same shape or color to crush them, score points, solve puzzles and level up in this amazing match 3 game. With addictive match 3 gameplay, tons of challenges, amazing boosters and beautiful graphics, Pop Puzzle will bring you an unforgettable puzzle experience.
You can also spin the toy boosts wheel and win surprises so when ever you get stuck remember you can always use the special boosts and complete the level by just solving the toy block puzzle.
Functions:
• Explore a delightful world filled with delicious treats.
• Match 3 puzzle games with hundreds of levels, each level takes about 2 minutes to complete.
• Casual and relaxing gameplay. Enjoy the world anytime, anywhere.
• Simple and clear rules that create a surprisingly deep gameplay.
• Beautiful illustrations, animation and sound effects.
• Can be played offline, so the fun of jelly chopping never stops.
• Unique boosters bring wild variety and an unforgettable seating experience.
• This is a fantastic yummy jelly puzzle game.
Gameplay:
• Tap 2 or more connected same jellies blocks to blast them.
• Tap 5 connected same jellies blocks to get a Horizontal or Vertical candy .
• Tap 7 connected same jellies blocks to get a Dynamite.
• Tap 7 or more connected same jellies blocks to get a rainbow boom.
• The combination of special jellies will make great and suprise power on the game board.
The game is challenging, it look easy at start to help you learn it but afterwards you will have to think hard and consider your tactics, we promise you that you will have the best time playing and as you progress you will enjoy it more and more, there is nothing better then solving the puzzle blocks and smashing all the cubes.
Whether you love puzzles, match-3 games, or just looking for a game to kill time, Pop Puzzle is a casual game that you can blow your mind into. So what are you waiting for? Join the wonderful match 3 adventure and have fun!

bluejetty:00077684:ios.description:
Introducing the Latest Features in Boxing Manager for 2026
New Additions:
 • The most realistic world title simulation ever! All the titles working as they do in real life!!!
 • The most insanely accurate and realistic boxing simulation EVER. 
 • Build Your Own Shows: Take full control by organizing your own boxing events.

 • Approach Any Fighter: Negotiate contracts with any fighter in the game.
 • UI Enhancements: Enjoy a more intuitive and streamlined user interface.
Become a Boxing Manager — Take Control and Make History!
Build your roster, develop fighters, manage gym trainers, create epic matchups, and guide your athletes to the Hall of Fame.
Key Features:
 • Unique and vast boxing game world and universe for every player. Step into the biggest and most accurate boxing game of all time. Over 5000 boxer uniquely generated on your device alone.
 • Amateurs: Compete in amateur leagues and aim for gold medal achievements.
 • Over 160 Customizable Title Belts: Battle for world and regional championships.
 • Expansive Game Universe: Experience a unique world with up to 5,000 fighters.
 • Develop Prospects: Scout and train new talent on their path to greatness.
 • Tailored Training Camps: Customize training regimens and intensities for each fighter.
 • Full Career Control: Make strategic decisions about opponents and career trajectories.
 • In-Depth Fight Commentary: Receive detailed analyses and statistics for each bout.

 • Manage Your Gym: Hire top trainers, attract elite fighters, and upgrade facilities.

 • Community Support: Join our welcoming community on our Forum and Discord Server.
As a gym owner, manager, and promoter, your decisions will shape the future of boxing across all weight divisions.
Can You Etch Your Name in History?
With immersive gameplay and unmatched detail, Boxing Manager offers the ultimate boxing management experience.
Experience the thrill of the fight world like never before. Download Boxing Manager today and start your journey to the top!

bluejetty:00021172:ios.summary:

Creating stunning ornamental patterns and mandalas are the focus o
bluejetty:00021172:ios.description:
iOrnament Pro combines beauty, structure and creativity.
You create, you play…you are blown away by your own designs.
A colourful and sparkling treat for digital creatives!
Creating stunning ornamental patterns and mandalas are the focus of this App.
The first steps in iOrnament Pro are as easy as moving your finger over the screen...they can lead to an amazing creative journey... leading to beautiful pieces of art. The fun is in the discovery!
No matter whether you are a casual doodler, a design professional, a child, a craftsperson, or just seeking for a relaxing soothing drawing experience, iOrnament will make your creative juices flow and unleash your inner artist. Get your fingers and pencil ready for a new drawing experience!
Main features:
While you draw on the iPad iOrnament Pro repeats your strokes by rules of symmetry. Highly expressive pens, effects like gold, silver or glitter create a rich variety of styles. Whether you go for highly artistic calligraphy, strict geometric constructions, or just casual doodling iOrnament offers a suitable tool set to create extraordinary designs.
For the Artist
Full support of all possible symmetry patterns and highly expressive pens allow for the creation of stunning patterns. The possibility of image import brings real world elements into the world of pattern creation. Realistic effect pens, precise brushes seamless patterns and the mathematically precise symmetries make it possible to create crisp geometric drawings and glamorous jewellery likewise.
For kids of all ages
First of all: its fun! Starting at the age of four kids can dive into joyful and creative play for hours. Playing in iOrnament is a creative and satisfying experience starting from the very first stroke. Vivid color palettes, glitter, gold, mandalas, varieties of shapes, and much more offer an endless playground of discovery. And while playing children learn basics about the maths of symmetry.
For meditation 
Drawing in iOrnament connects your left and the right brain: the creative and the structural. This leads to a very calming and relaxing drawing experience with even therapeutic effects. It is like playing a flute in a big room with a great echo. You create something, it comes back from all directions and you react to your own creations. Ornamental structures and symmetries can be helpful to focus and relax at the same time.
For teaching
iOrnament gives access to all mathematical possible planar ornament groups. And even spherical and hyperbolic symmetries. It contains an interactive tutorial explaining the maths behind it and can be used to trigger an exciting journey in the border of art and maths. Suitable for both maths and art classes.
For experimenting
Life is exploration and the best way of learning is playing. The possibilities of iOrnament are endless. Go on your own creative journey and find your own unique way of using this app.
Some feature highlights:
– glitter and gold pens and brushes
– advanced color support 
– photorealistic textures 
– hyperrealistic sparkles 
– image import 
– video and time lapse export 
– advanced layer functions 
– on board help center 
– stroke and color post-editing 
– many versatile stroke properties
– clean and well-structured UI 
– embossing effect 
– dynamic responsive pens 
– patterns on the sphere 
– local mandala symmetries 
– Escheresque color symmetries 
– calligraphy pens and brushes 
– mesmerising geometric deformations
– 3D paper models via the iOrnament Crafter 
The predecessor App iOrnament was featured in Apple Retail Stores and used by Apple for graphics on their website and at the WWDC.

bluejetty:00042134:ios.description:
Vibemap connects you to meaningful places, people, and experiences that match your unique vibe. Discover local travel activities, including things to do, events, and where to stay. 
Use Vibemap to find places to go, and things to do, based on vibe, activity, time of day and location. Whether your lifestyle is adventurous, social, quiet, family, foodie, free, chill, new, lively, or luxury, sightseeing you'll find places near by that fit your vibe and interests. 
Features:
• Discover engaging local places, people, and experiences in your city
• Filter the map of point of interests and list of activities by your vibe
• Explore walking maps and city guides of local events & places
• Find engaging social gathering and places to make friends
• Share the vibes of places and leave tips for others
• Read travel guides, maps, and stories about cool things happening near you
• Vibe check with your mood and get suggestions for what to do or where to go in the moment
• Customize, manage and keep track of your vibes while unlocking rewards for exploring the city.
• Smart recommendations, tips, and ideas for activities to do near you.
• Essential culture guides and stories that provide a real, authentic city guide
• Easily plan your next vacation destination, getaway trip, or night out with friends
• Pin or save places to the map around you; check in and keep track of places you visit
Explore things to do and events in these cities: 
• Vancouver, British Columbia
• Seattle, Washington
• Portland, Oregon
• Oakland & San Francisco Bay Area, California
• Los Angeles, California
• Guadalajara, Mexico
And coming soon: 
• Austin & Houston, Texas
• Chicago, Illinois
• Mexico City & Puerto Vallarta, Mexico
• New York, NY
We believe that in-person, social relationships are crucial to our well-being. Vibes can lead to unexpected sources of connection. We each have an emotional life whose energy changes. We constantly navigate this changing energy or what we call personal “vibes.” Our mission is to bring people together in real life in order to create a greater sense of belonging for everyone.
Powered by civic data and tools, Vibemap connects you with where you want to be based on your vibe. We pull in event tickets, tours, reservations and city passes from apps including Ticketmaster, Get Your Guide, Goldstar, Tickets, Bands in Town, and many other city guides and venue event calendars. Filter by music, comedy, food, film & books, kids & family, outdoors, tours & attractions, nightlife, etc. We use vibes as a way to make finding things to do less daunting and more tailored to you, so you can create real-life relationships and achieve personal growth.
We use vibes as a way to make finding things to do less daunting and more tailored to you, so you can get out and create real-life relationships and achieve personal growth. 
Visit us at our website vibemap.com 
And sign up to receive monthly Vibe Reports and Content Roundups at vibemap.com/newsletter/ 
Follow us on:
Facebook: @vibemap
Twitter: @vibemap
Instagram: @vibemap

bluejetty:00187643:ios.description:
Genius Scan is a document scanner app in your pocket. Quickly scan your paper documents on the go and export them as multi-page PDF files.
*** Apple App of the Week *** 20+ million users *** 1000s of small businesses ***
Place any document in front of your device’s camera: our scanner app automatically recognizes the paper against the background, crops it, and cleans up the result. You obtain a crisp, legible scan. Batch scanning lets you scan dozens of pages in a matter of seconds. Powerful tools help you organize, share, or archive your documents.
“Next time you plan to hit the road, don’t forget to download Genius Scan to make life easier for yourself and your accounting department.” - AppPicker.com
“Camera apps aren’t designed for close-up text scanning, but Genius Scan is.” - The Guardian
== KEY FEATURES == 
Smart Scanning:
- Document detection & background removal
- Distortion correction
- Shadow removal and defect cleanup
- Filters (black & white, whiteboard, photo)
- Batch scanning
PDF Creation & Editing:
- Document merging & splitting
- Multiple page PDF creation
- Photos and PDF import
Security & Privacy:
- On-device document processing
+ Face ID locking
+ PDF password encryption
Document Organization:
- Document tagging
- Metadata and content search
+ Smart document renaming (custom templates, …)
+ Backup and multi-device sync with Genius Cloud (separate subscription)
Export:
- Email
+ Box, Dropbox, Evernote, Expensify, Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, OneNote, FTP, SugarSync, WebDAV.
+ Any WebDAV compatible service such as Citrix ShareFile, NextCloud, ownCloud, Synology, Yandex. 
+ Automatic background auto-export
OCR (Text Recognition):
+ Text extraction
+ Searchable PDF creation
+ Business card scanning & contact creation
The features denoted with [+] are available as part of a premium plan.
== ABOUT US ==
It’s in the heart of Paris, France that The Grizzly Labs develops Genius Scan. We take pride in crafting apps that help millions of users throughout the world and hold ourselves to the highest standards in terms of quality and privacy. Get in touch with us @thegrizzlylabs if you have any questions.
== PRICING & LEGAL ==
Genius Scan is free to use for as long as you want.
Should you choose to, you can subscribe to the Genius Scan Plus plan for more features. You can subscribe to Genius Cloud for backup & synchronization. In that case, Genius Scan’s store displays the duration and price of each subscription, updated at the time of purchase. Payment will be charged to iTunes account when the order is confirmed. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions, disable auto-renewal in the iTunes account settings.
Download the best free mobile scanner and scan your documents in a snap.
https://www.thegrizzlylabs.com/genius-scan/cloud/terms

• Beautiful Design: Enjoy a clean writing environment that makes daily journal entries a pleasure.
Unlike other diary journal apps, Glimmer talks back. It helps you reflect, grow, and heal—one honest conversation at a time.
Whether you're new to journaling or have maintained a diary journal for years, Glimmer AI Journal transforms the experience from a one-sided activity into a meaningful conversation that builds self-awareness.

bluejetty:00134890:ios.name: Avigilon Unity Video
bluejetty:00134890:ios.summary: Manage your Avigilon Unity Video (formerly known as ACC) with ease through your mobile devices. Quickly access videos across organizations and sites via the new Unity Video mobile app. Navigate seamlessly and switch swiftly between events
bluejetty:00134890:ios.description:
Manage your Avigilon Unity Video (formerly known as ACC) with ease through your mobile devices. Quickly access videos across organizations and sites via the new Unity Video mobile app. Navigate seamlessly and switch swiftly between events, live and recorded videos and notifications – all from a sleek, intuitive design.
With the Avigilon Unity Video mobile app, you can:
• Sign in using Avigilon Unity Cloud Services credentials for seamless access to an organization’s cloud-connected Unity Video sites using firewall traversal
• View live or recorded video from any H.264 or H.265 cameras connected to Unity Video software and Avigilon Unity Video sites
• Efficiently stream live or recorded HD video from Avigilon cameras using High Definition Stream Management (HDSM)™ technology to optimize the use of network bandwidth
• Receive push alarm notifications to quickly detect, verify, and act on events such as motion or video analytic rule triggers
• Easily review recorded video using the recorded video timeline
• Control PTZ cameras, including running tours and moving to defined presets
• Create and customize your video views through Saved Video Views
• Gain immediate awareness of your site by checking the recently viewed camera feeds.
• Switch easily between organizations and sites with Org and Site selectors. 
Avigilon Unity Video mobile app is available for use with Avigilon Unity Video Core, Standard, and Enterprise edition sites. Avigilon Unity Video app requires Avigilon Unity Video sites to be running the Avigilon Unity Web Endpoint component. The Avigilon Unity Video Web Endpoint is pre-installed on Avigilon Network Video Recorders (NVRs) and High Definition Video Appliances (HDVAs), is part of the firmware for Avigilon ES Appliances, and is available as a separate download for any server running on Windows.

MUZO AI — THE MUSIC YOU DIDN’T KNOW WAS INSIDE YOU
You know that tune stuck in your head while brushing your teeth this morning? Yeah, that one. What if it didn’t just vanish into thin air? What if it became something real — a track, a beat, maybe even the song that shifts your whole mood? That’s where Muzo AI wanders in.
It doesn’t matter if you’ve been producing since the dial-up era or if you barely know the difference between a drum kit and a toolkit. Muzo takes your scribbled idea — a messy note, a random mood, a “hey, what if it sounded kinda like this?” — and turns it into something you can actually play, share, or loop on repeat.
WHAT CAN YOU DO HERE?
- Turn vague ideas into real music. Say it, type it, hum it, talk it — Voice-to-Song, Text-to-Music and the Lyric Generator pick up the vibe and build a full track around it. You can even upload your own audio or voice clip and watch it transform into a complete song in under a minute.
- Let the algorithms sweat. All the AI wizardry runs in the background, shaping polished beats, lush chords, clean vocals and melodies across any style — pop, hip-hop, EDM, cinematic, romantic piano and more.
- Take full control of your sound. After generating a track, you can instantly extract the vocal stem or the instrumental stem — perfect for duets, remixes, covers, practice sessions, or building your own edits like a real producer.
- Spark your brain when inspiration runs dry. Templates and musical styles sit there like half-opened doors — walk through one and boom, a new idea catches fire.
- Save it, share it, own it. Export in high quality and use your music anywhere: TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Spotify or just in your headphones. Everything you create comes with 100% usage rights.
WHO’S THIS FOR?
- Pros already know the grind — Muzo removes the boring parts so you can stay creative.
- Beginners can make something worth listening to without touching a DAW.
- Everyone else gets a wide-open door into music, no permission slips required.

- Because it’s quick instead of complicated.

Volleyball Arena is an online fast paced 1v1 game where each second truly counts. Enjoy incredible graphics in this fresh, easy to play yet competitive volley game. Challenge your opponents to a fun, casual game, with simple, intuitive controls and engaging gameplay! Master the playing field and take pride in showing off the special characters and prizes that you’ll unlock along the way!

Welcome to an unmatched casual approach to volleyball. Easy to learn for casual players, skill based for players who seek something more, real physics induced and power ups to make the gameplay interesting & dynamic.

- Collect awesome powers and destroy your opponent, while improving your own skill.

6 distinct and original courts with increasingly higher stakes and rewards, as you progress through your volleyball career.
From London to Beijing, travel around the world, across the globe’s hottest Volley courts, scoring the highest amount of points, in the nick of time, in this new arcade game!
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

bluejetty:00032577:ios.name: Mahjong Solitaire: Match Game
bluejetty:00032577:ios.summary:
Get Ready for an Exciting and Innovative Mahjong Experience!
Welcome to Mahjong Solitaire, a relaxing game that offers a fresh take on the classic Mahjong games! Your goal is simple—match identical tiles and clear them from the board. With
bluejetty:00032577:ios.description:
Get Ready for an Exciting and Innovative Mahjong Experience!
Welcome to Mahjong Solitaire, a relaxing game that offers a fresh take on the classic Mahjong games! Your goal is simple—match identical tiles and clear them from the board. With lots of levels to conquer, this matching game will challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours. Can you clear all the levels and become the ultimate Mahjong master? Download now and start your journey in this addictive and rewarding puzzle game!
【Key Features】
• Lots of Free Board Levels: Immerse yourself in a plethora of free board levels, ensuring endless hours of gameplay excitement.
• Auto Fit: Enjoy smooth, uninterrupted gameplay with our auto-fit feature, optimizing the display on your device screen for a great experience.
• High Scores & Personal Statistics: Keep track of your progress with detailed stats and high scores, helping you monitor your improvement in this fun brain game.
• Toggle Sounds On or Off: Personalize your experience by choosing whether to play with sound effects and music or in silence for a more immersive, relaxing game.
• Offline Play: No internet? No problem! Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay anytime, anywhere, with full offline support.
• Simple Pick-Up-and-Play Controls: Jump straight into the action with intuitive controls, designed for easy navigation and quick learning in this addicting matching game.
【How to Play Mahjong Solitaire】
► Tiles are randomly dealt on the Mahjong board, with up to 144 tiles available.
► Match identical pairs of tiles to remove them from the board and make progress in the tile match game.
► Each matched pair vanishes, bringing you closer to clearing the level and advancing to the next challenge.
► Clear all the tiles to complete the level and move on to even more exciting challenges in this fun puzzle game.
► For the great experience, connect online to access features and progress, though offline play is also supported!
【Why Play Mahjong Solitaire】
Mahjong Solitaire is more than just a traditional Mahjong game—it’s a fun and engaging brain game that exercises your mind while providing a relaxing escape. Great for fans of tile match games, match games, and puzzle games, this game offers a refreshing twist on the classic matching game formula. Whether you're a casual player looking for relaxing games or a competitive gamer striving to beat all levels, this game has something for everyone.
Download Mahjong Solitaire now and embark on an unforgettable matching adventure! Unwind, challenge your mind, and immerse yourself in the best Mahjong puzzle game available!

bluejetty:00126885:ios.summary: Kahoot! Learn Chess by DragonBox is an immersive, interactive game for kids (recommended for age 5+) and adults who’d like to learn to play chess and challenge their minds. Join grandmaster Max on her adventure to solve puzzles and beat bos
bluejetty:00126885:ios.description:
Kahoot! Learn Chess by DragonBox is an immersive, interactive game for kids (recommended for age 5+) and adults who’d like to learn to play chess and challenge their minds. Join grandmaster Max on her adventure to solve puzzles and beat bosses across multiple levels". When you complete the adventure you’ll be ready to take on your friends and family in a real-life battle for the grandmaster title!
**REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION**
Access to the content and functionality of this app requires a Kahoot! Kids or Premier subscription. The subscription starts with a 7-day free trial and can be cancelled at any time before the end of the trial.
The Kahoot! Kids and Premier subscriptions give your family access to premium Kahoot! features and a collection of award-winning learning apps.
Adventurous learning
The main goal of Kahoot! Learn Chess by DragonBox is to introduce beginners to chess rules and strategies so they can apply this knowledge and skills on a real board. 
Through a smooth game progression, you’ll be introduced to each chess piece while exploring six different worlds together with grandmaster Max. Step by step, you’ll solve chess situations with more and more pieces, and learn to apply more and more chess rules. Eventually, you’ll meet bosses who challenge you to use your newfound skills in a game of chess.
Pedagogical steps 
- Learn how different pieces move and capture.
- Learn the notion of checkmate and simple checkmating patterns.
- Learn to complete simple tactical and strategic tasks.
- Intro to basic checkmating techniques against a lone king.
- Complete games versus a basic chess engine.
Kahoot! Learn Chess by DragonBox is designed to create an experience that is not only immersive and fun but also provides cognitive training and qualitative learning.
Terms and Conditions: https://kahoot.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy https://kahoot.com/privacy-policy/

This game is for you! Enjoy thousands of questions and images of the best songs, bands, artists, awards, albums and more! Test your knowledge and play nonstop!

RATE THE QUESTIONS
Don’t you like that question? Are you sure the answer was not correct? After each game you can review, report and rate each question, indicating whether you like it or do not to improve the game everyday!
Go ahead! Start playing and enjoy the best of the music world!

bluejetty:00127002:ios.name: Bike: Tips, tests & reviews
bluejetty:00127002:ios.summary: The official app of Britain's best-selling motorcycle magazine. With intelligent writing, stunning photography and exclusive content, Bike takes you on a motorcycling journey celebrating everything on two wheels. From in-depth comparisons a
bluejetty:00127002:ios.description:
The official app of Britain's best-selling motorcycle magazine. With intelligent writing, stunning photography and exclusive content, Bike takes you on a motorcycling journey celebrating everything on two wheels. From in-depth comparisons and reviews of new and used bikes, to inspiration for your next biking adventure and behind-the-scenes race access, Bike magazine is your definitive guide to all things motorcycling. 
As a Bike magazine subscriber, you will get: 
- Immediate access to all our content 
- Full access to the Bike archive, meaning you can take a look through our back issues. 
- A selection of highlighted articles from the editor 
- Subscriber-only rewards including discounts, prizes, and freebies 
Features of the app we love: 
- Read or listen to articles (choice of three voices) 
- Browse all current and back issues 
- Free articles available to non-subscribers 
- Search content that interests you 
- Save articles from the content feed to enjoy later 
- Switch between Digital View and Magazine View for the best experience 
Honest, opinionated, authoritative motorcycle tests 
From revealing first rides of the latest new models to in-depth group comparison tests, Bike magazine’s hugely experienced test team tell you all you need to know. Expertly written and with beautiful images, nobody tests and reviews motorcycles quite like Bike. 
Epic motorcycle adventures 
Whether it’s getting lost in Kazakstan, crossing America on a hyperbike, or bobbing across the country on a moped, Bike puts you in the saddle for some of the world’s most compelling adventures. Read exclusive first-hand experiences and discover just where a motorcycle can take you. 
Intelligent racing insight 
Sneak inside pit garages and hear first-hand from the people who matter most in racing. From riders and engineers to team owners and series directors, Bike magazine gives you the definitive line on the biggest stories in racing – all delivered with passion and authority. 
Technical knowledge 
With exclusive access to world-class engineers, Bike’s technological expertise is world class. Discover everything you need to know, from untold engine design secrets to biking’s electric future and the latest developments in racing. 
Amazing tales from the biking world 
Meet the motorcyclists with the most intriguing stories. From collectors and restorers to high-mile heroes and obscure races, Bike delivers you the most interesting and entertaining two-wheeled stories from around the globe. 
For the most informed and interesting take on the world of motorcycling, delivered with the finest writing and breathtaking photography, download Bike today. 
PLEASE NOTE: This app is optimised for iOS 14 and up. If you're using an iPad 1 or 2, iPad Mini 1 or iPhone 5 (or before) you may struggle to run this app smoothly. 
Your subscription will automatically renew each billing period, and you will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current cycle. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24 hours before the end of the current period, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information: 
Terms of use: 
https://www.bauerlegal.co.uk/app-terms-of-use-03032025 
Privacy policy: 
https://www.bauerdatapromise.co.uk
