bluejetty:00046653:ios.description:
Fast Sign-in for Senior Living Communities
Skip the wait. Complete your sign-in steps before you arrive, then just scan your QR code at the kiosk and go.
Accushield Mobile lets family members, caregivers, healthcare providers, and other visitors complete their community's sign-in process from their phone and generate a QR code for a fast, seamless check-in at the kiosk.
Already signed in at an Accushield kiosk with your mobile number? You're ready to go. Just download, verify, and start using Accushield Mobile on your next visit.
WHY VISITORS LOVE IT
Sign In Before You Arrive — Complete your community's sign-in steps and generate a QR code from your phone. When you get there, just scan and go.
One App, Multiple Communities — Visit more than one community? Manage all your connections from a single account.
Quick Sign-Out — Tap the sign-out button in the app when you leave. No need to stop back at the kiosk.
Share Feedback on the Spot — Rate your visit experience with a quick survey right from your phone on your way out.
FOR HEALTHCARE AND SERVICE PROVIDERS
Upload and store community-required documents directly in the app. Check your compliance status with each community's credentialing requirements so you always know where you stand before your next visit.
HOW IT WORKS
Select the community you're visiting. Verify your identity with a quick text code. Complete the sign-in process and generate your QR code. Scan it at the Accushield kiosk when you arrive. When you're done, sign out from the app.
YOUR INFORMATION STAYS SECURE
Personal details and uploaded documents are only shared with the communities you visit and are protected by Accushield's trusted security infrastructure.
Whether you're visiting a loved one, providing care, or checking in for a shift, Accushield Mobile makes every visit a breeze.

bluejetty:00025822:ios.description:
O aplicativo "Agenda da Beleza: Profissionais" é uma ferramenta completa e indispensável para profissionais do ramo que desejam otimizar sua gestão. Com um design intuitivo e funcionalidades abrangentes, o aplicativo visa simplificar e aprimorar a organização diária e o crescimento financeiro das profissionais.
Uma das principais características do aplicativo é o "Agendamento", que permite visualizar e gerenciar sua agenda de compromissos. Você poderá registrar os horários de atendimento, datas e serviços agendados, garantindo que sua jornada seja organizada, evitando conflitos. Além disso, você receberá Notificações de suas próximas agendas, para não perder nada!
O "Cadastro de Clientes" é outra funcionalidade fundamental. Você poderá armazenar informações detalhadas sobre seus clientes, incluindo nome, contato, preferências e histórico de serviços. Isso permite uma abordagem personalizada, aprimorando a experiência do cliente e fomentando relacionamentos duradouros.
O "Controle Financeiro" é uma ferramenta valiosa para o gerenciamento das finanças. Você poderá registrar ganhos e despesas de forma fácil e detalhada, categorizando transações e visualizando relatórios claros sobre sua situação financeira. Você tem também o "Histórico Completo de Ganhos e Despesas", oferecendo uma visão geral das transações passadas.
Para estimular o crescimento pessoal e profissional, o aplicativo oferece a possibilidade de criar "Metas Pessoais e Profissionais". Você poderá definir objetivos para a sua família e para o seu negócio. O aplicativo acompanha o progresso em direção a essas metas, incentivando seu planejamento financeiro.
Com uma interface amigável, o aplicativo "Agenda da Beleza: Profissionais" concentra-se em proporcionar uma experiência otimizada para você. Desde o agendamento até o controle financeiro e o estabelecimento de metas, o aplicativo busca ser um parceiro confiável na sua jornada, auxiliando no crescimento dos negócios e na satisfação dos clientes.

bluejetty:00150020:ios.description:
Step into the world of Felina – your ultimate destination for high-performance intimates, everyday essentials, and sculpting shapewear engineered to support every move you make. Designed with patented technology, seamless silhouettes, and functional elegance, Felina redefines what support really feels like. 
WHO WE ARE
Founded in 1983, Felina has spent decades perfecting the art of intimate apparel. With deep-rooted expertise and a passion for innovation, we’re committed to creating solutions that empower women to feel strong, confident, and comfortable in their own skin. At our core, Felina is about more than just what you wear – it’s about how you feel. We champion inclusivity, functionality, and design that works with you, not against you. From early mornings to late nights, Felina is built to move with you. 
WHAT WE OFFER 
From subtle shaping to all-day comfort, Felina offers a curated collection of intimates, shapewear, and lifestyle staples designed to elevate your everyday routine.
INTIMATES & EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS 
Discover solution-oriented bras, seamless bodysuits, supportive bralettes, and everyday underwear – all available in an inclusive size range from XS to XXL, with bras in cups A to H and bands 30 to 44. Each piece is designed with movement, softness, and support in mind – so you can focus on living your life, not adjusting your outfit.
SCULPTING SHAPEWEAR 
Our precision-sculpted shapewear features innovative technology to provide subtle yet powerful shaping without compromising on comfort. Whether you want to smooth, shape, or sculpt, Felina shapewear moves with you, never against you. 
LOUNGEWEAR & MORE 
Experience comfort that doesn’t quit with our collection of versatile loungewear and layering essentials. Designed to take you from couch to coffee run and everywhere in between. 
APP FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE
Explore Our Full Collection: Browse every style at your fingertips – from high-performance shapewear to barely-there bralettes and must-have basics. 
Find Your Fit: With inclusive sizing across all categories, our size guide and fit recommendations help you discover your perfect match. We offer sizes from XS-4X and bras in cups A-H and bands 30-44. 
Shop by Solution: Need subtle shaping for a special event? All-day comfort for work? Filter by your needs and find pieces designed to solve real-life wardrobe challenges. 
Exclusive Offers & Early Access: Be the first to know about limited-time sales, new arrivals, and exclusive in-app offers. Felina members get early access to drops you won't want to miss!
Styling Tips & Inspiration: Get inspired by curated looks, how-to-wear guides, and behind-the-scenes content straight from the Felina team.

bluejetty:00078404:ios.summary: VisualEyes is the ultimate coaching and video analysis tool for athletes, coaches, and trainers. With features like frame-by-frame scrubbing, video comparison, and drawing tools, you can easily analyze your technique and make improvements.
bluejetty:00078404:ios.description:
VisualEyes is the ultimate coaching and video analysis tool for athletes, coaches, and trainers. With features like frame-by-frame scrubbing, video comparison, and drawing tools, you can easily analyze your technique and make improvements. Whether you're a coach looking to help your athletes succeed or an athlete looking to improve your skills, VisualEyes has the tools you need.
Useful for any sport with highly technical aspects, Baseball, Softball, Football, Tennis, Track & Field, Bowling, Hockey, Figure Skating, Dance, Soccer, Basketball, Wrestling, Lacrosse & many more.
Use the app to record high-speed videos in up to 4K resolution and any frame rate supported by your device. With frame-by-frame scrubbing, you can analyze every aspect of your performance in detail. The app's drawing tools allow you to demonstrate and highlight specific areas of focus, and you can organize your videos by athlete and/or tags for easy reference.
VisualEyes also includes a slow-motion feature that lets you watch your videos back at fractions of their original speed. You can zoom in and move videos around on the screen for a closer look, and compare videos side-by-side or overlayed to show progress and compare technique to professional athletes. The app even lets you record coaching voiceovers to provide additional guidance and feedback. When you're ready to share your videos, you can export them from the app with the push of a button.
Try VisualEyes for FREE today and take your coaching and training to the next level!
Terms & Conditions: https://www.visualeyesapp.com/terms-and-conditions/

- Text search with auto-completion
- Clear structured result lists
- Wide array of filter options for all search results and lists
- Detailed overview for all titles with additional preview option
- Lending and download options for available eBooks and eMagazines
- Lending and streaming options for available eAudio and eMusic titles
- Download option for eAudio and eMusic titles
- Reservations for non-available titles
- Overview for all lent, reserved and downloaded titles
- Wishlist feature
- Integrated eBook reader
- Optimized for all smartphone- and tablet sizes
- Offline reading feature
- Offline player feature
- Expired titles are automatically returned

The Onleihe – the free of charge service of your library now as an app, supports over 2.900 libraries.
With this app you’ll always have your library with you. Browse the collection of your library and lent eBooks and eMagazine on the fly or from your home directly with your smartphone or tablet. You can also lent eAudio and eMusic titles, listen to them via streaming or download them directly onto your device. Following the same principle as the web-based Onleihe, the lent titles can be consumed free of charge for a certain set amount of time. Afterwards the titles will automatically be returned to the library.
You can search directly throughout the app or browse the collection of your library through different categories and eMagazines. On first sight, you’ll see if a title is available and you can alter your search results with an wide array of different filter or sort options.

If a title is temporary not available you can also reserve it. As soon as the title is then available for you, you will get an e-mail notification to the address you specified. Your reservations are easily accessible with an overview and you can directly lent the titles if they are available. Should you no longer need an ongoing reservation or if you do need to change the address, you are able to edit or delete your reservations.

You are able to directly load and read all eBooks and eMagazines which you have lent beforehand. This also needs to be done directly via the in app player.

bluejetty:00041558:ios.name: PC Remote
bluejetty:00041558:ios.summary:
Monect PC Remote — your PC, in your pocket.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless mouse, keyboard, gamepad, and remote desktop for your Windows PC. Control your computer from the same Wi-Fi or from anywhere over the internet — for work,
bluejetty:00041558:ios.description:
Monect PC Remote — your PC, in your pocket.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless mouse, keyboard, gamepad, and remote desktop for your Windows PC. Control your computer from the same Wi-Fi or from anywhere over the internet — for work, gaming, and everything in between.
REMOTE DESKTOP
• See and control your PC screen in real time with low-latency H.264 or AV1 video and Opus audio.
• Use the screen as a precision touchpad with natural gestures, plus a full mouse, keyboard, scroll, and volume controls.
• Switch between monitors and add or remove virtual displays.
• Type in any language with 16 desktop keyboard layouts, function and media keys, emoji, and Unicode text. Paste from the iOS clipboard and use hardware-keyboard shortcuts.
• Stream in up to 4K with Premium.
GAMING
• Play PC games anywhere with on-screen layouts tailored to each title: buttons, joysticks, D-pads, sliders, touchpads, background touchpad, motion sensors, macros, and scripts.
• Multi-page layouts, custom widgets, and a complete built-in editor.
• Supports Xbox 360, DirectInput, and DSU motion controllers, with rumble feedback on your phone.
• Browse, install, and publish community layouts in the Layout Store.
• Sync layouts with your Monect account, or import .mlo and .mwl packages from other apps.
• Launch console games and ROMs stored on your PC from the Games tab.
MONI AI ASSISTANT
• Ask Moni anything about your PC, or let it look at your screen and help with what's on it.
• Create and edit images, attach photos, and talk to Moni with your voice.
• Answers appear as they're generated, with a live 3D avatar.
Moni runs on your PC and requires Monect AI in PC Remote Receiver.
UTILITIES
• Virtual Camera: use your iPhone or iPad camera as a high-quality webcam on your PC for calls, meetings, and streaming. Custom names and HD/4K output are available with Premium.
• Screen Projector: share your iPhone or iPad screen with your PC, including app audio and your microphone.
• Camera: view and control the cameras connected to your PC.
• File Explorer: browse your device and PC, and transfer files in either direction.
• PC Task Manager: check CPU, memory, disk, GPU, and network usage, inspect processes, and end unresponsive apps on supported PCs.
SECURITY AND CONNECTION
• Encrypted sessions, password-protected PCs, and sign-in tokens stored securely in the Keychain.
• PCs on your local network are discovered automatically. Sign in to reach hosts linked to your Monect account from anywhere.
FREE WITH OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Monect PC Remote is free to download and supported by ads. Free accounts can transfer files up to 10 MB and connect up to 3 hosts. Premium removes ads and unlocks 4K remote desktop streaming, unlimited file transfer size, up to 10 hosts, unlimited game import size, custom virtual camera names with HD/4K output, and custom touchpad themes. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled, and purchases can be restored at any time.
GET STARTED
1. Download the free PC Remote Receiver from monect.com and install it on your Windows PC.
2. Open Monect PC Remote. Your PC appears automatically on the same Wi-Fi, or sign in to see your linked hosts.
3. Connect and enter your PC password if required.
Requires a Windows PC running PC Remote Receiver. Some features depend on your receiver version and PC hardware.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.monect.com/privacy-policy

Developed by Rooster Games, whose games have been downloaded over 150 million times worldwide, Offroad League Multiplayer delivers an exhilarating offroad experience with console and PC-quality graphics.
EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD
A massive 4 km
bluejetty:00166187:ios.description:
Developed by Rooster Games, whose games have been downloaded over 150 million times worldwide, Offroad League Multiplayer delivers an exhilarating offroad experience with console and PC-quality graphics.
EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD
A massive 4 km² open world map awaits you. Complete missions to design your own offroad vehicle and showcase your skills by racing against other players. With rich content and an immersive environment, a true simulation experience is at your fingertips.
REALISTIC GRAPHICS AND PHYSICS
Face the challenges of muddy trails, rugged terrains, and deep water crossings with ultra-realistic vehicle physics and visuals that make you feel like a genuine offroad driver. Inspired by real-world vehicles, the detailed physics engine delivers a premium visual and gameplay experience.
ONLINE EXPERIENCE
Join friends or random players from around the globe for nature-filled exploration adventures or track races. The game offers challenges and fun for players of all levels. Additionally, diverse arcade modes enhance the online experience, creating an ever-evolving game environment.
DESIGN, UPGRADE, AND TRADE
Start your offroad journey by purchasing a base vehicle and upgrading it to become your dream offroad machine. Improve your vehicle, trade to increase your earnings, and eventually sell it to other players. If you’re not in the mood for creativity, you can purchase vehicles from others and create your own track.
USER-CREATED MAPS
Race on challenging tracks designed by other players or create your own maps for others to play. Earn in-game revenue from your custom maps and gain recognition by attracting the attention of other players.
VARIOUS ONLINE MODES
The game brings together globally popular driving game modes. Some modes let you drive vehicles soaring through the sky, while others focus on track racing from a third-person perspective. The variety ensures something for every player.
ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS
When designing an offroad vehicle, customize components like the chassis, suspension, and body kits to suit your style. With endless customization possibilities, you’ll see how a standard SUV transforms into a unique offroad beast!
Privacy Policy: https://rooster.gs/PrivacyPolicy.html

bluejetty:00018154:ios.description:
All your household bills. All under control.
With My Home Bills, you can organize bills, subscriptions, and payments in one place. Stay on top of due dates, see how your spending changes, and find documents and receipts whenever you need them.
From electricity to Netflix, from building fees to insurance: a clear view of your household expenses, always with you.
ORGANIZE YOUR EXPENSES
Add a bill, choose a category, and enter the amount and due date. Include a note and set up daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring payments.
Use the built-in categories or create your own with custom colors and icons.
SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES
Check your average spending by category and your overall monthly average. Explore charts, compare years, and follow your spending trends over time.
From your household overview to the details of a single bill, get the information you need to understand your expenses and see how your costs change.
STAY AHEAD OF EVERY DUE DATE
View payments in the calendar, check unpaid bills, and receive notifications before they are due.
With widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, useful information is always just a glance away.
BUILD YOUR DIGITAL ARCHIVE
Keep bills and payment receipts together with their details. Scan documents using the built-in scanner or attach photos, screenshots, and PDF files.
Import files from other apps, share documents, or print them whenever you need to. Less paperwork to store, more peace of mind.
KEEP EVERYTHING IN SYNC
Sync your data through iCloud and manage your bills on iPhone and iPad. On iPad, work in split screen and drag images and PDFs straight into the app.
DESIGNED TO MAKE EVERYDAY LIFE EASIER
• Export individual categories as CSV files.
• Add new bills with Siri and Shortcuts on iPhone.
• Use quick actions to access common tasks.
• Protect access with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Enjoy Dark Mode and adjust text size with Dynamic Type.
• Drag and drop images and documents on iPhone and iPad.

bluejetty:00082187:ios.description:
Embark on an epic adventure in "Maze of Realities: Synergy of Worlds", where a dark force threatens the mystical world of Etheria. As one of the chosen Guardians, you'll delve deep into an enchanted realm filled with hidden objects and challenging search and find games. The fate of the World Tree, the heart of Etheria, rests in your hands. Can you unravel the mystery tales, solve brain riddles, and piece together the truth before it's too late? Traverse through beautifully crafted scenes, spot the difference in intricate artwork, and find objects in a picture as you uncover secrets and logic puzzles that will test your mind and spirit!
The situation in Etheria has been unstable lately. The power cuts are becoming a constant occurrence, and the locals are forced to evacuate to other regions. These blackouts get fixed quickly, but rumors spread faster. Something bad is afoot, and you have to keep these rumors at bay. But they're not untrue. The World Tree, which feeds virtually everything in this world, right down to the portals through which you can no longer return home, has been struck by an unknown disease and is infecting the creatures around it, making them aggressive. The Tree has chosen several outlanders to protect the innocent etherians and find a cure. But do all of them have the Tree’s welfare at heart?
Immersive Hidden Journey!
Dive into a captivating world filled with mystical riddles and mystery tales. Every location is a new hidden object challenge in search and find games where you must find objects in a picture and spot the difference to progress!
Challenging Logic Puzzles!
 Sharpen your mind with over 100 logic puzzles, brain riddles and hidden objects challenges. As you explore Etheria, uncover the mystery tales that drive the story forward, requiring you to find objects in a picture and spot the difference to reveal crucial secrets!
Stunning Visuals & Atmosphere!
Explore the magical realm of Etheria, brought to life with stunning fantasy-themed artwork. Each scene in this hidden journey is filled with beautifully crafted visuals that immerse you in the story. Whether you're solving logic puzzles, brain riddles, or engaging in search and find games, you'll be captivated by the enchanting atmosphere!
Impactful Choices!
Every choice you make influences the outcome of the mystery tales and the fate of Etheria. Navigate complex relationships and solve mystical riddles, while engaging in search and find games that require you to spot the difference and find objects in a picture. Your actions will determine the future of the World Tree and the entire world of Etheria!
Dive into search and find games, spot the difference challenges, and hidden objects quests as you fight to save the enchanted world of Etheria!

listings.name: Maze of Realities: Synergy
listings.description:
Embark on an epic adventure in "Maze of Realities: Synergy of Worlds", where a dark force threatens the mystical world of Etheria. As one of the chosen Guardians, you'll delve deep into an enchanted realm filled with hidden objects and challenging search and find games. The fate of the World Tree, the heart of Etheria, rests in your hands. Can you unravel the mystery tales, solve brain riddles, and piece together the truth before it's too late? Traverse through beautifully crafted scenes, spot the difference in intricate artwork, and find objects in a picture as you uncover secrets and logic puzzles that will test your mind and spirit!

The situation in Etheria has been unstable lately. The power cuts are becoming a constant occurrence, and the locals are forced to evacuate to other regions. These blackouts get fixed quickly, but rumors spread faster. Something bad is afoot, and you have to keep these rumors at bay. But they're not untrue. The World Tree, which feeds virtually everything in this world, right down to the portals through which you can no longer return home, has been struck by an unknown disease and is infecting the creatures around it, making them aggressive. The Tree has chosen several outlanders to protect the innocent etherians and find a cure. But do all of them have the Tree’s welfare at heart?

Immersive Hidden Journey!
Dive into a captivating world filled with mystical riddles and mystery tales. Every location is a new hidden object challenge in search and find games where you must find objects in a picture and spot the difference to progress!

Challenging Logic Puzzles!
 Sharpen your mind with over 100 logic puzzles, brain riddles and hidden objects challenges. As you explore Etheria, uncover the mystery tales that drive the story forward, requiring you to find objects in a picture and spot the difference to reveal crucial secrets!

Stunning Visuals & Atmosphere!
Explore the magical realm of Etheria, brought to life with stunning fantasy-themed artwork. Each scene in this hidden journey is filled with beautifully crafted visuals that immerse you in the story. Whether you're solving logic puzzles, brain riddles, or engaging in search and find games, you'll be captivated by the enchanting atmosphere!

Impactful Choices!
Every choice you make influences the outcome of the mystery tales and the fate of Etheria. Navigate complex relationships and solve mystical riddles, while engaging in search and find games that require you to spot the difference and find objects in a picture. Your actions will determine the future of the World Tree and the entire world of Etheria!

Dive into search and find games, spot the difference challenges, and hidden objects quests as you fight to save the enchanted world of Etheria!

When your mind won’t quiet down, DUVA AI can guide you through br
bluejetty:00042086:ios.description:
DUVA helps you calm your mind, ease into sleep, and understand your nights with AI support, noise control, sleep tracking, relaxing audio, and connected SomniPods 3 earbuds.
When your mind won’t quiet down, DUVA AI can guide you through breathing, meditation, relaxation, or bedtime support in the moment. When the night gets noisy, use the app with SomniPods 3 to switch noise control modes, play calming sleep audio, and create a quieter path into rest.
DUVA also helps you see what happened while you slept. Track sleep stages, movement, posture, and overnight patterns, then review personalized insights based on your night, routine, and sleep trends. Instead of only showing a score, DUVA helps you understand what affected your sleep and what to try next.
Build a calmer bedtime routine with sounds, meditations, guided sessions, and custom sleep mixes designed to help you unwind.
Key features:
• Connect and control SomniPods 3 earbuds 
• Switch noise control modes and manage playback 
• Check battery status and start your sleep routine 
• Ask DUVA AI for breathing, meditation, and bedtime support 
• Play calming sounds, guided audio, and custom sleep mixes 
• Track sleep stages, movement, posture, and overnight patterns 
• Review personalized sleep insights based on your night and routine 
• Build better bedtime habits for sleep and recovery 
DUVA is designed to support calmer nights, deeper rest, and smarter recovery.
DUVA is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

+++ Listed as “Productivity lifesaver” on the App Store +++
"A streamlined interface packed with powerful features - it’s like having a desktop-quality PDF toolkit wherever we go" – App Store Editor Notes
“I'm impressed by how the folks at PSPDFKit have been able to fine-tune the document browser to the app's needs.” – MacStories.net
"If you want a PDF viewer that is designed for reading PDF books, this is it." – App Review
VIEW DOCUMENTS ON THE GO
• Easily import a PDF from your favorite cloud service provider, email, or directly off a website.
• Supports Open In Place, Drag & Drop and features the familiar Apple Document Browser interface from the Files app.
• Search for the exact text you are looking for within the document.
• Double tap on the screen to Smart Zoom directly to the text you want to read.
• Annotate images (JPEG, PNG) non-destructive, just like PDF documents. (PRO)
ANNOTATE WITH EASE
• While reviewing a document, use your finger or Apple Pencil to highlight and markup text.
• Leave comments by adding a note, text, or drawing directly on the PDF.
• Add images or audio.
• Reply to notes. (PRO)
SIGN DOCUMENTS ANYWHERE
• Add your signature to any document using your finger or Apple Pencil.
• Move and resize your signature as needed.
• Flatten a document to ensure the signature doesn’t change.
CREATE AND EDIT PDFs
• Create new documents from existing documents by moving, rotating, deleting, or adding new pages.
• Combine multiple documents into a single one. (PRO)
• Add bookmarks to easily return to certain pages in large documents.
FILL OUT FORMS
• Quickly fill out PDF Forms by adding text to the fields.
• Flatten and secure the form once you’re done to ensure the document doesn’t change.
• Add a signature to any Form.
STORE, ORGANIZE AND SHARE
• Store documents, create folders and organize your documents.
• Share documents by printing, emailing or saving your edits back any cloud service.
PASSWORD PROTECT DOCUMENTS
• Read document metadata, title and keywords.
• Protect documents with user and owner passwords and limit permissions. (PRO)
AND SO MUCH MORE
• Conveniently switch to night mode when viewing your documents at night.
• Present on external screens without the distraction of toolbars. (PRO)
• Have the text from a PDF read out loud to you with text-to-speech.
• PDF Viewer remembers where you were down to the page/position where you left off - even across devices.
PRICING
PDF Viewer comes with a large feature set, completely free. Some advanced features require the purchase of PDF Viewer Pro, available as a subscription. We offer 3-monthly and yearly subscription plans. There’s also a fully functional 7-day trial, so you can test PDF Viewer Pro (including document merging and password editing) before you commit. All plans unlock the app on iPhone and iPad.
TRUSTED BY COMPANIES YOU KNOW
PDF Viewer is built on top of and powered by PSPDFKit, the same PDF engine trusted around the world by companies like Dropbox, Box, IBM, Atlassian, SAP, and Lufthansa.

bluejetty:00169784:ios.description:
Welcome to "Jigsaw Puzzle Games Antistress," the ultimate puzzle game experience designed to entertain and relax adults of all ages! Dive into a world where puzzles, magic, and mindfulness blend seamlessly to offer you a calming and enjoyable pastime.
Our game features an extensive collection of hundreds of unique jigsaw puzzles, ensuring that enthusiasts will always have something new to explore. Each jigsaw puzzle is crafted to provide a satisfying challenge while also acting as an antistress tool, perfect for unwinding after a long day.
For those who love the classic feel of puzzle games, our traditional jigsaw puzzles will transport you into a world of intricate designs and captivating images. From serene landscapes to vibrant blossom themes, each picture is a visual delight. The magic of piecing together each jigsaw puzzle is not just in the completion but in the calming journey it provides.
Adults seeking a mental workout will find our mind games and puzzle games for adults both stimulating and rewarding. These games are designed to sharpen your cognitive skills while offering a relaxing escape from daily stress. Our adult games section includes a variety of challenges that cater to different skill levels.
If you're a fan of jigsaw puzzle games, our app takes the experience to the next level. With intuitive controls and high-quality graphics, assembling a jigsaw puzzle has never been more enjoyable. Plus, our free puzzles and free puzzle games sections allow you to enjoy a range of puzzles without any cost.
For those moments when you need a quick stress reliever, our antistress and calming games are the perfect solution. Immerse yourself in tranquil settings and gentle challenges that soothe your mind. The addition of mandala and meditation themes brings a unique blend of mindfulness to your puzzle-solving experience.
And let's not forget our animal lovers! Our collection includes beautiful puzzles featuring horses, offering a delightful challenge for equestrian enthusiasts.
Whether you're on trips or enjoying a quiet evening at home, "Jigsaw Puzzle Games Antistress" is your go-to companion. With free jigsaw puzzles and free puzzles for adults, everyone can join in the fun without any barriers.
Join us in this enchanting world of jigsaw puzzle and discover the perfect blend of relaxation and challenge!

Terms of Use: https://abovegames.com/terms-of-service

Don't expect to answer some boring questions from an old guy with a white beard...
In EnigmBox you have to play with all your mobile phone functionalities.

Several times awarded because of its originality, EnigmBox will surprise you every time.
Kids can solve 90% of puzzles without breaking a sweat

Oh, I almost forgot! Take a fork! Yeah, really! |^^|

- Every puzzle is a new surprise

bluejetty:00120649:ios.name: 3rd Grade Learning: School Ed
bluejetty:00120649:ios.summary: 21 fun games to help kids learn Third Grade lessons! Whether they are just starting Third Grade, or need to review and master the subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids aged 7-10. Math, language, science, STEM, reading, and crit
bluejetty:00120649:ios.description:
21 fun games to help kids learn Third Grade lessons! Whether they are just starting Third Grade, or need to review and master the subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids aged 7-10. Math, language, science, STEM, reading, and critical thinking skills are all practiced in these games.
All lessons and activities are designed using real third-grade curricula, so you can be sure these games will help give children a boost in the classroom. Plus, your student will stay entertained with the help of voice narration, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. Improve your child's homework with the teacher-approved lessons & activities. 
Games include:
MATH
• Decimals and Fractions - Add decimals, convert from decimals to fractions 
• Multiply - Word problems, solve for x problems, multiply 3-factor and more
• Geometry - Perimeter, area, and different types of angles
• Measure - Measure length, volume, temperature, and time
• Division - Basic division and word problems
• Rounding and Places - Round numbers to the nearest 10 or 100, and identify place values
• Timed Facts - Quickly solve math problems to play a fun baseball game
LANGUAGE, GRAMMAR & READING
• Sentence Jumble - Help with reading comprehension and grammar
• Parts of Speech - Adverbs, pronouns, prepositions, adjectives, nouns, and verbs
• Syllables - Sound out words to figure out how many syllables they have
• Tense and Grammar - Learn the difference between past, present, and future tense
• Analogies - Compare words to complete the analogy
• Prefixes - Use a prefix to build words in a fun asteroid space game
• Reading - Read articles and answer questions
SCIENCE
• Food Chain - Identify types of animals and their role in the food chain
• Solar System - Learn about the planets and bodies in our solar system
• Water Cycle - Study the phases of the water cycle and how they interact
• Sound and Hearing - Understand what sound is and how the ear works
• Nutrition - Identify types of food and build a healthy plate
• Recycling and Energy - Learn why recycling is important and where energy comes from
• Erosion - Learn the causes and effects of erosion
Games are a fun and engaging way for kids to learn and practice new skills. RosiMosi games include voice narrations, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. 
Suitable for 7, 8, 9, and 10-year-old children. 
=====================================
SCHOOL EDITION APPS
School edition apps have no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads and are completely safe for kids.
PROBLEMS WITH THE GAME?
If you are having issues with the game or have questions, please email us at help@rosimosi.com, and we will get it fixed for you ASAP.
LEAVE US A REVIEW!
If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.

bluejetty:00186265:ios.description:
Welcome to RadarOmega, the next-generation weather app that keeps you up to date with live, local radar, real-time severe weather alerts, and more. Our high-resolution weather data app operates in the US, Canada, Germany, Australia, and South Korea.
RadarOmega provides unique data solutions for all types of weather data, customized to your needs and weather alert preferences. From severe weather to local radar, advanced meteorology technology provides detailed insights for full weather coverage. Track high-resolution radar data, flash flood warnings, excessive rainfall, tornado watches, and more. 
RadarOmega created an exclusive network of weather stations featuring live video and sensor data called cyclonePORT. RadarOmega and cyclonePORT work closely with universities, emergency managers, broadcast meteorologists, and more to provide solutions for relaying extreme weather information through weather alerts.
View weather alerts for wind speeds, precipitation, extreme temperatures, severe weather, hurricanes, and tornadoes seamlessly. Users can subscribe to different packages to access additional data on satellite, MRMS, and models. Explore Alpha, Beta, or Gamma subscriptions to access data from winter to hurricane season. 
Download today to start viewing your customizable weather alerts.
RADAROMEGA APP FEATURES:
EXTREME WEATHER DATA & METEOROLOGY REPORTS
- High-resolution radar: Level 2 & 3, Dual Pol
- MRMS: Reflectivity, hail, rotation tracks, precipitation, etc
- Satellite: Visible, LWIR, water vapor
- Models: HRRR, NAM3KM, NAM12KM, RAP, GFS, ECMWF
- NDFD: Temperature, wind speeds, wind gusts, snow totals
BASE APPLICATION RADAR & ALERTS
- High-resolution single site radar
- Severe weather outlooks & daily meteorology monitoring for excessive rainfall, fire weather & more
- Extreme weather alerts for snow, rain, flash floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, etc. with flash animation & in-app sound alerts
- Real-time NWS storm-based warnings
- Radar & map type customization tools
- Buoy data & tidal forecast charts
- & more
GAMMA PACKAGE
- Hi-Res Satellite Data
- Lightning Detection/Animation, METARS, & GLM for Mesoscale & Storm-Based Satellite Sectors
- National Digital Forecast Database
- Access to Project MesoVort
- 75 Frames of Data
- Dual View Radar with 30 Frames
- Smoothing for Radar/Satellite
- 30 Day Radar History
- 6 Month Storm Report Archive
- 3D Radar / Satellite
- Upload 3 Custom Color Tables
- 30 Custom Locations with Icon Upload & 2 Custom Location Lists
BETA PACKAGE
*Everything in Gamma PLUS*
- MRMS Data
- 150 Frames of Data
- Dual View Radar/Satellite with 50 Frames
- Smoothing for MRMS
- 90 Day Radar History
- 5 Year Storm Report Archive
- 3D MRMS
- Upload 8 Custom Color Tables
- 75 Custom Locations with Icon Upload & 5 Custom Location Lists
ALPHA PACKAGE
*Everything in Beta PLUS*
- Volumetric Radar
- Model Data with Contours for HRRR, NAM3KM, NAM12KM, RAP, GFS, ECMWF, HWRF, & HMON
- 250 Frames of Data
- Dual View Radar/Satellite with 100 Frames
- Quad View Radar/Satellite on Tablet & Desktop with 50 Frames
- Smoothing for Models
- 90 Day Radar History
- 10 Year Storm Report Archive
- Upload 30 Custom Color Tables
- 150 Custom Locations with Icon Upload & 10 Custom Location Lists
- Lightning Monitoring: 1 Site Lightning Monitoring with Custom Range Zones
Additional Add-Ons
- RapidSweep
Start your subscription today to start tracking local radars, daily temps, precipitation, and extreme weather!
Subscriptions are maintained through the iOS App Store. We will work with our customers; however, refunds must be done through the iOS App Store. Please be sure to reach out to our support team if you have any problems, questions, or concerns.

bluejetty:00036639:ios.description:
This guide brings the look and feel of Animal Crossing: New Horizons to your pocket and gives you a full companion for critters, fossils, and everything else in the game. It includes:
- A NookPhone-style interface
- Insects, fish, and sea creatures with handy availability filters
- A full fossil list
- A large DIY collection with smart search
- A complete villager list with their unique personality traits
- An art collection with tips to tell real from fake artworks
- A collection of songs by the beloved K.K. Slider
- Happy Home Paradise – Browse HHP items and vacation-home content right from your NookPhone
- Resort & hotel – Resort and hotel updates so your island getaway info stays current
- ACNH 3.0 – Fully compatible with Animal Crossing: New Horizons version 3.0
Please enjoy using this app, and leave a review if you liked it!
Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize in the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game. Your island getaway has a wealth of natural resources that can be used to craft everything from tools to creature comforts. You can hunt down insects at the crack of dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy sunset on the beach while fishing in the ocean. The time of day and season match real life, so each day on your island is a chance to check in and find new surprises all year round.
Show off your island utopia to family and friends—or pack your bags and visit theirs. Whether playing online** or with others beside you***, island living is even better when you can share it. Even without hopping on a flight, you’ll meet a cast of charming animal residents bursting with personality. Friendly faces like Tom Nook and Isabelle will lend their services and happily help you grow your budding community. Escape to your island getaway—however, whenever, and wherever you want.
Build your community from scratch on a deserted island brimming with possibility
Create your personal getaway and customize your character, home, decorations, and even the landscape itself
Collect materials to construct everything from furniture to tools! Then, use what you create to give your island a personal touch
Watch as the time of day and seasons match real life—even your hemisphere! Each day holds potential for surprises and discoveries
Get to know the island residents, garden, fish, decorate, hunt for fossils, and more!
Show off your paradise – play on the same system with a total of 4 people***, or play together online** or over local wireless*** for fun with up to 8 players

bluejetty:00128430:ios.summary:

RECORDER

bluejetty:00128430:ios.description:
The Sleep Center is a superior all-in-one sleep application. It consists of four modules: RECORDER, SMART ALARM, STOP SNORING, SLEEPY SOUNDS.
RECORDER
Records your talk or snoring while you are asleep (automatic or manual sensitivity level, records only snoring using smart snoring detection), creates the graph of noise in room during the night, takes the total time of snoring down. 
SMART ALARM
Helps you to wake up easy in your lightest sleep phase and allows you to get up relaxed every morning. Improve your sleep naturally, maximize your sleep efficiency. 
STOP SNORING
Tries to stop your snoring by playing chosen sound or using iPhone vibration when the snoring is detected.
SLEEPY SOUNDS
Plays sounds which are specially selected to make you relax and makes your falling asleep easier. Surely you will appreciate a function - automatic fade out time - if the application detects you are asleep, it will automatically stop playing sounds.
HIGHLIGHTS:
- ADJUSTABLE RECORDING SOUND SENSITIVITY:
For different sound conditions in your room (a quiet or loud environment).
- HIGH TECH SNORING DETECTION:
Accurate snoring detection based on A.I.
- POSSIBILITY OF RECORDING ONLY SNORING
- AUDIO VISUALIZATION DURING RECORDING OR PLAYING
- FAVORITE RECORDINGS
- SHARING RECORDINGS WITH YOUR FRIENDS:
Send recordings via email, iMessage or post to Facebook.
- UNLIMITED ALARMS: 
Set your own alarms, daily alarms, weekly alarms, etc. You can use included alarm sounds or your own iPod music.
- SMART WAKE UP: 
Wake up with gradual alarm when you are in your lightest sleep phase (based on your movements).
- SLEEP TRACKER:
Sleep cycle analyzes and statistics with complete history and beautiful charts.
- SNOOZE BY SHAKING:
No need to unlock screen or enter password.
- STOP SNORING:
Possibility of playing chosen sound or using iPhone vibration when the snoring is detected. 
- SLEEPY SOUNDS:
More than 40 sounds with the possibility to mix these sounds together.
- FACTORS, WAKE UP MOOD, NOTES:
User can place factors (alcohol, coffee, stress etc.) to every night as well as the mood after waking up or add own notes.
- ACTIVATION DELAY:
Starts monitoring after a period of time.
- BACKGROUND MODE:
Monitoring runs also in background mode. Alarm also fires from background.
- APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Optionally save your sleep analysis into your Apple Health database.
- iCLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION:
Synchronization among your devices and between free and paid version.
- EXPORTING HISTORY TO CSV FILE
- APPLE WATCH:
Tracks your sleep movements and plays haptic (sound, vibration) if alarm is triggered or snoring is detected.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Happy customers are our highest priority. If you have a problem with our app, please contact us at sleepcenter@apirox.com.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase. Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00151678:ios.description:
Where Classic Card Game Meet Beautiful Jigsaw Magic!
Experience an addictive fusion of solitaire and jigsaw puzzles! Dive into a charming farm story while training your brain with this uniquely relaxing puzzle game. JigStory combines classic solitaire gameplay with innovative jigsaw mechanics, creating the ultimate free puzzle experience.
UNIQUE JIGSAW AND SOLITAIRE GAMEPLAY
Slide and match beautiful art cards to complete stunning jigsaw puzzles! This isn't your ordinary solitaire or traditional jigsaw game. Each card piece fits together like a jigsaw, creating satisfying picture puzzles as you play. Swipe to move cards, connect matching pieces, and watch your puzzle masterpiece come to life!
ENGAGING FARM STORY
Follow an exciting farm adventure across multiple episodes! Meet lovable farm characters, unlock new puzzle collections, and discover heartwarming tales. Each puzzle you solve advances your story, making every challenge meaningful.
TRAIN YOUR BRAIN & RELAX
Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation. Whether you want stress relief or mind-sharpening brain training, JigStory delivers! Play at your own pace with no timers or pressure. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
AMAZING FEATURES
Stunning HD Puzzle Art – Gorgeous puzzle images featuring farm landscapes, adorable animals, beautiful flowers, and scenic nature
Intuitive Slide Controls – Simple swipe mechanics make it easy to learn but challenging to master
Story Driven Progression – Unlock new story episodes and puzzle collections
Daily Puzzle Challenge – Fresh puzzles every day to keep your brain sharp
Multiple Difficulty Levels – From easy to hard challenges for all skill levels
PERFECT BLEND OF CLASSIC GAMES
Love traditional solitaire? Enjoy jigsaw puzzles? JigStory merges both into one incredible adventure! It's like playing solitaire while solving beautiful jigsaws simultaneously. Similar to popular games like Klondike, Spider Solitaire, and classic jigsaw games, but with an innovative twist!
WHY YOU'LL LOVE JIGSTORY
1. Relaxing gameplay perfect for stress relief 
2. Trains your brain while you unwind 
3. Beautiful HD puzzle pictures in every level 
4. Engaging farm story with memorable characters 
5. Free puzzle game with generous rewards 
6. Smooth, addictive card sliding mechanics 
7. Great for all ages!
MORE THAN JUST A PUZZLE GAME
JigStory isn't just another jigsaw puzzle or solitaire game. It's a complete puzzle adventure combining brain training, relaxation therapy, and story progression. Whether you're a casual player looking for relaxing games or a dedicated enthusiast seeking challenging brain games, JigStory offers the perfect experience.
Download JigStory now and start your relaxing jigsaw adventure!
Train your brain, solve beautiful puzzles, complete the farm story, and become a puzzle master! Perfect for daily brain exercise and stress relief. Play offline anytime, anywhere!

bluejetty:00165992:ios.description:
Prepare! — Start! — Release! — Repeat! — Switch! 
• ”I tried quite a few and this is the best one hands down!" 
• ”I might actually DO the exercises my PT prescribed, thanks to this app!"
• ”I've looked at many timers for stretches, floor exercises, weight lifting... and this is the perfect one!" 
TIMER AND COUNTER FOR PHYSICAL THERAPY
Keeps time, counts reps and sets, and lets you focus on your exercise, or something else—not the clock.
YOU ENTER YOUR OWN EXERCISES
Add instructions and photos, or a weblink, and set up your entire routine, exactly as prescribed by your therapist. Fine-tune cues and timers to match your personal pace. Note: this app does NOT offer pre-defined exercises (other than a few examples). 
KEY BENEFITS
*** Some features are available only during the free trial or with a paid subscription as described below.
• Stop counting seconds and reps—focus on proper form, breathing, or even reading or listening to music.
• Clear voice and tone cues that work alongside music, podcasts, or when the app runs in the background.
• Store all exercise instructions: notes, photos, and web links, with spoken guidance in a voice you choose.
• Precisely adjust timers to fit your needs. 
• Schedule exercises and receive reminders.
• Take notes after each exercise and email reports directly to your physical therapist.
• Export workouts to PDF, including instructions, photos, and schedules.
• Apple Health integration records exercise type and duration.
MORE FROM THE REVIEWS
• "The app is very easy to use and has resulted in the quality of my exercises increasing markedly … it does meet my needs to a "T"!" 
• "Best one ever. Have tried 2 others. At 65 stretching is important and this app helps." 
• "…it lets you focus on other things if you have simple boring exercises." 
BASIC VERSUS PAID SUBSCRIPTION CAPABILITIES
Without a subscription, PT Timer provides limited basic functionality. During a free trial or an active subscription, you can create new exercises with instructions, timers, schedules and more. After the free trial, without a subscription, functionality for those exercises becomes limited. 
• In basic (unpaid) mode you can: view exercise routines created during a trial or subscription; view instructions and photos; receive already scheduled alerts; check off completed exercises; add and view notes after completing exercises; export to PDF.
• Subscription-only features include: timing and counting; creating and editing exercises and workouts; modifying schedules; technical support.
• NOTE: This app does not provide exercises or instructions (other than a few examples). You must enter exercises tailored to your own needs. 
TERMS OF SUBSCRIPTIONS
Several subscription options are available with different renewal periods. They all provide access to the full functionality of the app. The prices of subscriptions vary by country and are shown within the app. Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription automatically renews unless the subscription is cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The Apple Account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the price specified for current subscription. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and cancelled by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://www.pttimer.com/privacy.pdf
Terms of Use: http://www.pttimer.com/TermsOfUse.pdf

bluejetty:00016141:ios.name: Carrier Landing HD
bluejetty:00016141:ios.summary:
Carrier Landing HD is a high-end flight sim optimized for iOS devices, offering the following advantages:
Multiplayer Game: 
The multiplayer mode supports authentic Air Combat and Deathmatch modes. You can team up with friends for realisti
bluejetty:00016141:ios.description:
Carrier Landing HD is a high-end flight sim optimized for iOS devices, offering the following advantages:
Multiplayer Game: 
The multiplayer mode supports authentic Air Combat and Deathmatch modes. You can team up with friends for realistic dogfights or join Deathmatch rooms to engage in intense battles with players from around the world.
Aerodynamics:
The aerodynamic model of each aircraft includes multiple components, with careful calculations of their inflow. As a result, the simulator realistically simulates the unique aerodynamic characteristics of many aircraft. This includes the high angle of attack maneuverability of F18 and F22, the ability of F14 to perform a full turn roll using only rudder, the pedal turn maneuver of F35 and F22, and the cobra maneuver of the Su series aerodynamic layout aircraft. The development process involved real pilots for testing and feedback.
Dynamics:
When a 40,000-pound carrier-based aircraft lands on the deck at a descent rate of 5 meters per second, the compression rebound of the landing gear and the damping of the suspension are finely adjusted to create the most realistic visual effects. The recoil force from each bullet is accurately calculated and applied to the aircraft. The simulator also implements rope dynamics simulations for arresting cables and aerial tanker refueling tubes, details that are often not found in many PC flight sims.
Flight Control System (FCS):
Modern fighters often utilize static instability layouts, making it challenging for pilots to fly without the intervention of FCS. The simulator implements an FCS component with the same algorithm as the real flight controller. Your control commands first enter the FCS, which calculates the result using angular velocity feedback or G-load feedback. The result is then passed to the servo to control the control surface. 
Avionics:
The simulator implements a HUD based on the real HUD principle. The size and view angle of the HUD characters and symbols have been strictly verified against the HUD of corresponding real aircraft. This offers the most realistic HUD implementation available in the mobile market. The F18 currently features a fully-featured fire control radar, and fire control radars for other aircraft are also under development.
Arms:
Each missile in the simulator utilizes a real dynamic model, treating them as tiny aircraft. The guidance algorithm employs the same APN algorithm used in real missiles. The guidance results are transmitted to the missile's FCS, which then controls the control surface deflection for maneuvering. The initial speed of the gun bullet in the simulator strictly adheres to real data, accurately calculating the bullet's movement in each frame considering the effects of gravity and air resistance.
Earth Environment Rendering:
The simulator employs multiple scattering algorithms to calculate the color of the sky, ground, and objects, thanks to innovative optimization algorithms. It provides realistic sky colors at dusk and dynamic projections of the earth in the atmosphere. Whether flying at foggy sea levels or 50,000 feet high, you can genuinely feel the presence of the air.Additionally, the game utilizes real astronomical data to determine the positions of stars, the moon, and the sun.

THE NEW LOGIC-IMMO APPLICATION IS HERE!
A more efficient and complete search engine, larger photos, the ability to quickly find listings already seen and contacted: the new application has been completely redesigned to bring you the best search experience of real estate ads !
THE BEST OF REAL ESTATE
Are you looking for an apartment in Paris? A house in the countryside? New housing to invest? With hundreds of thousands of advertisements whatever your region, Logic-Immo is the privileged partner of your real estate search. Whether in Île-de-France, Brittany, in the North, in the mountains, on the Basque Coast, or on the Côte d'Azur, find the best real estate on Logic-Immo. Both to buy and to rent your accommodation, we have what you need!
REAL ESTATE PROFESSIONALS AT YOUR SERVICE
With more than 15,000 partner agencies throughout France, find the right real estate professional to support you in your project. Need an expert to estimate the price of your house or apartment? From a professional who knows your sector to find you the property of your dreams? From an agent who can best advise you in your search? Who says new application, says new interface! We have reworked the Logic-Immo experience for a simpler and more efficient search. Direct access to the latest announcements from your recorded searches, quick connection with real estate professionals to plan your visits and increasingly relevant search criteria.
Looking for a villa, a house, an apartment, a loft, a studio, a parking lot, a building plot? Or even a chalet, a business, a farm, a manor or a castle? You just have to ask ! Enter the number of rooms or the number of bedrooms and browse all available listings!

The Logic-Immo teams work on a daily basis to provide you with an application that is ever closer to your expectations. Many new features are under development and will arrive over the weeks! So don't hesitate to send us your suggestions!

bluejetty:00096631:ios.description:
Discover the Blooming Joy of Flower Sort
After a long day, there is nothing better than losing yourself in a world of colors and calm. Flower Sort is a soothing yet stimulating puzzle game that blends mindful sorting with visual beauty. Arrange blossoms, match hues, and create harmony while relaxing your mind and brightening your mood.
How to Play
Step into the role of a gentle florist and bring order to a garden of chaos.
You will find vases waiting to be filled with matching flowers.
Move the blossoms one by one to group them by type and color.
Think ahead and plan your moves to craft the perfect floral combinations.
Each completed vase rewards you with a burst of color and a wave of calm satisfaction.
Why You Will Love It
Peaceful and Addictive: Simple to play, endlessly relaxing, perfect for unwinding anytime.
Stunning Visuals: Every flower bursts with vibrant life, creating a feast for your eyes.
Smart Challenges: Levels grow more intricate as your arranging skills blossom.
Ever Fresh Variety: Explore countless flower types, colors, and vase designs.
Mindful Relaxation: A casual puzzle that sharpens focus while easing stress.
Serene Sounds: Soft music and gentle effects complete your peaceful escape.
Whether you want a short moment of calm or a long evening of floral fun, Flower Sort is your pocket garden of peace and color.
Download now and let every bloom brighten your day.

کاتەکانی بانگ بە تەواوی و بەپێی کاتی دەس
bluejetty:00186882:ios.description:
بەرنامەی بانگ - کاتەکانی بانگ بۆ شارەکانی کوردستان و عێراق
ئەپی بانگ بە وردترین شێواز کاتەکانی بانگ بەپێی کاتی فەرمی مزگەوتەکانی هەرێمی کوردستان و دەوروبەری پێشکەش دەکات.
گرنگترین تایبەتمەندییەکان:
کاتەکانی بانگ بە تەواوی و بەپێی کاتی دەستنیشانکراوی مزگەوتەکان.
نیشاندانی کاتی ماوە بۆ بانگی داهاتوو بە چرکە و خولەک.
دۆزینەوەی ئۆتۆماتیکی شار بە GPS لەگەڵ توانای هەڵبژاردنی دەستی.
قورئانی پیرۆز بە تەواوی بە خەتی ڕوون، لەگەڵ گەورە و بچووککردنی قەبارەی فۆنت و نیشانەکردنی لاپەڕەکان.
قیبلەنامەی پێشکەوتوو بۆ دۆزینەوەی ئاراستەی تەواوی قیبلە و مەودای دووری لە کەعبەی پیرۆز.
زیکر و دوعاکان: وێردەکانی بەیانیان و ئێواران، زیکرەکانی دوای نوێژ، دوعاکانی ناو قورئانی پیرۆز لەگەڵ تەسبیحی ئەلیکترۆنی.
خشتەی مانگانە: نیشاندانی تەواوی کاتەکانی بانگی مانگێک.
پشتیوانی ویجت (Widgets): دانانی کاتەکانی بانگ لەسەر شاشەی سەرەکی (Home Screen) و شاشەی قوفڵ (Lock Screen).
پشتیوانی تەواوی کاتژمێری ئەپڵ (Apple Watch).
پشتیوانی ئەپڵ کارپلەی (Apple CarPlay) لە ناو ئۆتۆمبێلەکەتدا.
ئاگادارکردنەوەی بانگ و زیکرەکان بە دەنگی خۆش و دڵخواز.
چەندین زمان: کوردی (سۆرانی، بادینی) و عەرەبی.
کارکردن بەبێ ئینتەرنێت (Offline).
شار و شارۆچکە بەردەستەکان (زیاتر لە ٣٥ ناوچە):
هەولێر، سلێمانی، دهۆک، کەرکوک، هەڵەبجە، سۆران، ڕانیە، کۆیە، زاخۆ، قەڵادزێ، ئاکرێ، چەمچەماڵ، دەربەندیخان، کەلار، کفری، موسڵ، دووزخورماتوو، ئامێدی، پێنجوێن، سەیدسادق، هەڵەبجەی تازە، عەربەت، پیرەمەگروون، تاسڵوجە، بازیان، دوکان، تەکیە، حاجی ئاوا، خەلەکان، تەقتەق، بەرزنجە، خانەقین، قادرکەرەم، چوارتا، قەرەداغ و چەندین ناوچەی تر.
تطبيق بانگ (Bang) - مواقيت الصلاة لمدن كوردستان والعراق
أبرز المميزات:
- مواقيت دقيقة للصلاة وفق التوقيت المعتمد في المساجد.
- عد تنازلي يعرض الوقت المتبقي حتى الأذان القادم بالدقائق والثواني.
- تحديد تلقائي للمدينة عبر نظام تحديد المواقع (GPS) مع إمكانية التحديد اليدوي.
- القرآن الكريم كاملاً بخط واضح، مع إمكانية تكبير وتصغير حجم الخط وحفظ الفواصل/الصفحات.
- بوصلة قبلة متطورة لتحديد الاتجاه الدقيق للقبلة مع عرض المسافة إلى الكعبة المشرفة.
- الأذكار والأدعية: أذكار الصباح والمساء، أذكار ما بعد الصلاة، الأدعية القرآنية مع سبحة إلكترونية.
- جدول شهري: عرض كامل لمواقيت الصلاة للشهر بأكمله.
- دعم الودجات (Widgets): عرض مواقيت الصلاة على الشاشة الرئيسية (Home Screen) وشاشة القفل (Lock Screen).
- دعم كامل لساعة آبل (Apple Watch).
- تنبيهات وإشعارات للأذان والأذكار بأصوات عذبة ومخصصة
- لغات متعددة: الكردية (السورانية، البادينية) والعربية.
- يعمل بدون الحاجة إلى إنترنت (Offline).
- المدن والبلدات المدعومة:
أربيل، السليمانية، دهوك، كركوك، حلبجة، سوران، رانية، كويه، زاخو، قلعة دزة، عقرة، جمجمال، دربنديخان، كلار، كفري، الموصل، طوزخورماتو، العمادية، بنجوين، سيد صادق، حلبجة الجديدة، عربت، بيرة مكرون، طاسلوجة، بازيان، دوكان، تكية، حاجي آوا، خلكان، طق طق، برزنجة، خانقين، قادر كرم، جوارتا، قره داغة.
Bang App - Prayer Times for Kurdistan and Iraq Cities
- Key Features:
- Precise prayer times based on official mosque schedules.
- Live countdown to the next prayer down to the minute and second.
- Automatic city detection via GPS, with the option for manual selection.
- Complete Holy Quran with clear typography, adjustable font sizes, and bookmarking.
- Advanced Qibla compass to locate the exact direction of the Kaaba.
- Monthly Timetable: View the full prayer schedule for the entire month.
- Widget Support: Display prayer times directly on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
- Full Apple Watch support.
- Apple CarPlay integration for in-car convenience.
- Adhan and reminder notifications with customizable audio options.
- Multilingual: Kurdish (Sorani, Badini) and Arabic.
- Fully functional offline.
- Supported Cities:
Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok, Kirkuk, Halabja, Soran, Ranya, Koya, Zakho, Qaladiza, Akre, Chamchamal, Darbandikhan, Kalar, Kifri, Mosul, Tuz Khurmatu, Amedi, Penjwen, Said Sadiq, Halabja Taza, Arbat, Piramagrun, Tasluja, Bazian, Dukan, Tekye, Haji Awa, Khalakan, Taqtaq, Barzinja, Khanaqin, Qader Karam, Chwarta, Qaradagh.

Bin Buddy is a cutting-edge application dedicated to optimizing the performance of your device by removing similar & dupliate photos, compressing large videos without losing quality, and swipe to delete capabilities. 
No more stressing about which cherished photo’s and video’s you’ll need to delete to clear up your storage. Bin Buddy is here!

bluejetty:00031364:ios.description:

MEDIEVAL II brings Total War’s compelling mix of massive real-time battles and intricate turn-ba
bluejetty:00070245:ios.description:
READ BEFORE BUYING: Please expand this description and read the full list of supported devices below to confirm that your device is supported.
MEDIEVAL II brings Total War’s compelling mix of massive real-time battles and intricate turn-based strategy to iPhone and iPad. Set across three continents during the turbulent Middle Ages, spectacular conflicts and scheming rivals line the path to power as the great kingdoms of the medieval world vie for supremacy. Be it through diplomacy or conquest, trade or subterfuge, you must secure the resources and loyalty required to rule an empire from the shores of Western Europe to the sands of Arabia.
THE STRENGTH OF NATIONS
Unlock up to 17 playable factions and build them into major world powers through statecraft, subterfuge or all-out war.
THE KINGDOMS EXPANSION
Available via in-app purchase, this massive expansion includes 24 playable factions across four unique, fully featured campaigns. Wage war from the jungles of the Americas to the deserts of the Holy Land, from the deceptively gentle shores of the British Isles to the frigid Baltic plains.
THE HOTSEATS & HALBERDS UPDATE
This major update adds a host of balance improvements to Pikemen, Zweihanders and other late-era units, and, for owners of the Kingdoms expansion, introduces asynchronous multiplayer campaigns on a single device.
THE ART OF WAR
Deploy infantry, archers and cavalry into huge real-time battles, with a full range of medieval weaponry at your command.
THE TOOLS OF STATE
Use sophisticated diplomacy, lucrative trade agreements and daring agents to forge alliances or destabilise your rivals.
THE TEST OF TIME
Shape the destinies of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East through five momentous centuries of combat, competition and conquest.
THE POWER IN YOUR HANDS
Take command, with a brand-new user interface and enhanced touch controls for fingertip control of the battlefield. Or, play with any iPadOS-compatible mouse & keyboard.
===
Total War: MEDIEVAL II requires iOS 16 or later. You need 4.3GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.
A further 7.65GB is required to install the Kingdoms DLC. To save space, you can install each campaign individually.
Americas: 2.06GB
Britannia: 1.66GB
Crusades: 2.11GB
Teutonic: 1.82GB
Supported iPhones:
 • iPhone 8 / 8 Plus and later
 • iPhone SE 2nd Generation (2020) and later
Supported iPads:
 • iPad mini 5th Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad Air 3rd Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad 5th generation (2017) and later
 • Any iPad Pro

bluejetty:00024822:ios.description:
Welcome to YidKit 7!
YidKit features an adaptable Home Screen that changes based on the date and time of day.
• Will show Shacharis in the morning, and Mincha/Maariv in the afternoon.
• Shows candle lighting times for Chagim (Jewish Holidays).
• Shows start/end times for fast days.
• Has candle lighting and havdallah for shabbos
Features: Full smart siddur with Tehilim, Hebrew/English Tanach (Torah, Navi/Prophets, Kituvim/Writings), Zmanim, minyan locator/finder (minyanim), kosher restaurant database locator/finder
Full Smart Siddur with Tehilim
YidKit includes full Ashkenaz and Sfard Smart Siddurim with Tehilim! The Smart Siddur will automatically show/hide sections of davening depending on the day. The smart siddur has an adjustable font size and features a Tefilin mirror.
Zmanim
YidKit has comprehensive zmanim. The Zmanim in YidKit includes over 100 different zman variations, so you can personalize your Zmanim based on your customs.
Minyan Locator/Finder
Use YidKit to find a minyan with the minyan locator/finder! YidKit's Minyan Locator/Finder can show you minyan times, locations, and contact info for minyanim nearby.
The app also includes a kosher restaurant database (locator/finder).
Tanach (Torah, Navi/Prophets, Kituvim/Writings)
YidKit also includes a full Hebrew/English Tanach. Use the Tanach to read the Torah, Navi/Prophets, and Kituvim/Writings. It also includes English translation and trop for the Torah, Navi/Prophets, and Kituvim/Writings.
Also includes an Apple Watch app with quickly-accessible brachos!
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00074004:ios.description:
**U.S. Government’s Most Current and Trusted Travel Health Guidelines**
Preview, Buy, or Sign In using this app.
FREE PREVIEW – Experience the Yellow Book to see the value of having trusted travel information when and where it's needed.
ABOUT YELLOW BOOK
The fully revised and updated 2020 CDC Yellow Book app delivers the U.S. government’s most current travel health guidelines, including pre-travel vaccine recommendations, destination-specific health advice, and easy-to-reference maps, tables, and charts. Authored by a team of the world’s most esteemed travel medicine experts, this app best codifies the U.S. Government’s latest travel guidelines to staying healthy anywhere in the world.
Review dedicated topics on emerging infectious disease threats such as Zika, Ebola, and MERS, new cholera vaccine recommendations, updated guidance on the use of antibiotics to treat traveler’s diarrhea, special considerations for unique types of travel (i.e. wilderness expeditions, work-related travel, and studying abroad), and fully revised advice for specific destinations in international travel.
FEATURES
• Pre-travel vaccinations and preventative care
• Destination specific guidelines with sections on Cuba and Burma
• Advice for travelers with specific health needs (pregnant women, travelers with chronic illness, etc.)
• Practical tips for last minute or resource limited travelers
• Recommendations for air crews, humanitarian workers, missionaries, and others who provide care and support overseas
• Easy to use reference maps, tables, and charts
• Notes for making custom notes and highlights within entries
• Full Text Search to find specific topics quickly
• "Favorites" for bookmarking important topics
EDITOR-IN-CHIEF: Gary W. Brunette
Publisher: Oxford University Press
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00026508:ios.description:
Hunting Sniper - The Ultimate Free Hunting Experience
Embark on a thrilling journey into the wild with Hunting Sniper, the premier free hunting game. Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of stalking and capturing wild animals in their natural habitats.
Unparalleled Wildlife Encounters
Step into a world teeming with real animals, each indigenous to their respective territories. Traverse diverse and authentic hunting locations spanning continents. Set your sights on a majestic big buck, a cunning fox, a ferocious coyote or a formidable bear in the rugged landscapes of Yellowstone Park, USA. Chase after the elusive rhinoceros along the banks of the Nile in Egypt. Venture into the frigid expanse of the Arctic Ocean, Russia, and lay in wait for a massive walrus. Embark on an enthralling mission to capture a dingo amidst the sprawling Australian Outback, and prepare for many more extraordinary encounters. All of this right at your fingertips on your mobile device.
Arms and Arsenal
Marvel at the extensive array of weaponry at your disposal in Hunting Sniper. Experience unparalleled precision, exquisite design, and unmatched quality that enhance your hunting expedition. Elevate your weapon's performance with weapon tokens, allowing you to tailor your arsenal to perfection. And that's not all - complement your gear with cutting-edge bullets bullets to unlock impressive rewards and secure the trophy of a lifetime.
Seamless Gameplay Mastery
Revolutionize your hunting experience with game controls that redefine excellence. Hunting Sniper's intuitive controls empower you to hunt with finesse and pinpoint accuracy. Say goodbye to frustrating gameplay experiences that leave you tempted to toss your smartphone aside. Engage in silky-smooth gun control, mirroring real-life precision.
The Ultimate Hunter's Challenge
Rise through the ranks of the leaderboard and claim your title as the world's preeminent hunter. Hunting Sniper is the sole hunting game that boasts thrilling tournaments and championships. Hone your hunting prowess as you vie against fellow hunters in intense PvP battles. Prove yourself as the unrivaled deer hunting monarch, a title earned through sheer skill and determination.
Soar to New Heights
Can you defy gravity and reach for the skies? As you immerse yourself in the captivating world of Hunting Sniper, you'll find yourself striving for new heights in the pursuit of greatness.
Hunter's Delight
Throughout your adventure, the captivating sights and sounds of the wild will surround you. The words "deer" and "hunter" will become your rallying cries as you aim for the ultimate hunting triumph. Will you seize the opportunity to become the ultimate predator and secure your place as the apex hunter? The call of the wild awaits – answer it with Hunting Sniper.

bluejetty:00073517:ios.description:
Play better golf from the first tee to the final putt.
Featured by Apple as “The Best App for Golfers” and trusted by more than 10 million golfers, 18Birdies gives every player a smarter way to play, practice, compete, and improve.
18Birdies helps you know the distance, choose smarter shots, track every round, and understand where your game can improve. Get free GPS yardages on 45,000+ courses, keep score, follow your handicap, review your stats, and use Apple Watch tools to stay focused.
Improve your swing with AI feedback, Instant Swing Playback, Golf School training, and expert coach reviews.
FREE GOLF GPS, SCORECARD & STATS
Know the distance before every shot. Get yardages to greens, hazards, layups, and carries on 45,000+ courses worldwide. Keep score, save round history, monitor your handicap, and use shot tracking and stats to improve your game.
APPLE WATCH GOLF TOOLS
Keep your phone in your bag. Use 18Birdies on Apple Watch for distances, scoring, shot tracking, and automatic swing detection.
IMPROVE FASTER
Improve your game faster with advanced swing tools built for real results. Upload swing videos to the AI Swing Analyzer for personalized feedback, fault detection, and drills to help you improve. Use Instant Swing Playback to review swings and understand what changed from swing to swing. Build better habits with Golf School drills and lessons designed to help you practice with purpose.
For expert feedback, submit your swing to Pro Swing Analysis for a personalized review from a certified golf coach.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Golf is better with friends. Connect, share rounds, compare progress, and create competition with side games, team formats, leagues, tournaments, and live leaderboards.
FREE FEATURES
 - GOLF GPS RANGEFINDER: Distances to greens, hazards, layups, carries, and more
 - DIGITAL SCORECARD: Track scores for every round
 - HANDICAP TRACKER: Follow your handicap trend
 - STATS & ROUND HISTORY: Track performance over time
 - SHOT TRACKING: Capture shots and learn more about your game
 - APPLE WATCH: Distances, scoring, and shot tracking
 - INSTANT SWING PLAYBACK: Review your swing during practice
 - GOLF COMMUNITY: Connect with friends, share rounds, and celebrate your best golf moments
 - TEAM MODE & SIDE GAMES: Play Scramble, Best Ball, Skins, Wolf, and more
 - TOURNAMENTS & LEAGUES: Create live leaderboards for group competition
 - COACH CONNECT: Share your game with your coach for feedback
PREMIUM TOOLS
Upgrade to 18Birdies Premium for advanced tools and deeper insights. Free trial available for eligible users after download.
 - PLAYS-LIKE DISTANCES: Account for conditions that affect true yardage
 - CLUB RECOMMENDATIONS: Get personalized club guidance
 - ADVANCED GPS TOOLS: Plan shots with more confidence
 - 3D GREEN & HEATMAPS: Read slopes, breaks, and green contours
 - ADVANCED STATS: Analyze your game with charts, filters, and comparisons
 - STROKES GAINED: See where you gain or lose strokes
 - SMART TRACKING & AUTO SWING DETECTION: Capture your round automatically with less manual input, with or without Apple Watch
 - AI SWING ANALYZER: Get personalized swing feedback from video
 - HD INSTANT SWING PLAYBACK: Review your swing with annotations and deeper analysis
 - GOLF SCHOOL: Unlimited training, drills, and lessons
 - SHOT TRACKING INSIGHTS: Understand distance, shape, and performance
 - PRO SWING ANALYSIS DISCOUNT: 25% off personalized swing reviews from certified coaches
LEGAL
18Birdies Premium is an optional auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscription renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in App Store account settings. By using 18Birdies, you agree to Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ and our Terms of Service https://18birdies.com/legal/terms/ and Privacy Policy https://18birdies.com/legal/privacy-policy/.

Welcome to the CCSF Mobile App! Accessing all the tools you need has never been easier. Read news, contact faculty and staff, and locate your class on campus maps. Additional features include:
Academic:
- Browse class offerings and enroll in your favorite courses. Waitlist, too!
- See upcoming assignments, grades and more.
- Buy course books right from your mobile device.
- Share ideas and resources: collaborate and post discussions.
Campus Life:
- View school events.
- Find your way around with campus maps.
- Don’t be late for class! The bus schedule gets you there on time.
- Root for your team with sports updates.
- Manage expenses: pay bills, find out about holds and apply for financial aid.
Information:
- Search the directory for important numbers.
- Grab your favorite meal by looking up dining hall menus
- Access anywhere: read up on school news from any place.
- Stay connected with videos, image galleries and links to social media sites.
This app is free to download and use. It does everything but your homework!
The app provides a campus with QR codes to use in contact tracing.
Forms and templates are managed by administrators to gather vaccination and self reporting information from students.
Campus administrators use this information to manage cases and reduce the spread of COVID-19 on campus.
