bluejetty:00126708:ios.description:
Get ready to pass your Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) exam and start your healthcare career with confidence! The CNA Practice Test app helps you study smarter with realistic exam questions, detailed explanations, and AI-driven learning support. Designed for nursing assistant students, medical trainees, and healthcare professionals, this app covers every topic you’ll encounter on the real CNA certification exam — helping you master the knowledge and skills needed to succeed.
Our CNA practice questions are categorized into various topics:
• Physical Care Skills (Activities of Daily Living; Basic Nursing Skills; Self Care/Independence)
• Psychosocial Care Skills (Emotional & Mental Health Needs; Spiritual & Cultural Needs)
• Role of the Nurse Aide (Communication; Client Rights; Legal & Ethical Behavior; Member of a Healthcare Team)
**Why You’ll Love This App**
- Realistic CNA Practice Tests: Take full-length CNA practice exams based on the latest NNAAP® and state guidelines. Experience real exam-style questions in patient care, safety, communication, and infection control.
- Study by Topic: Review key areas like Basic Nursing Skills, Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), Safety & Emergency Procedures, and Communication. Each section includes clear explanations and examples.
- AI Mentor – Smart Study Assistant: Mentora, your AI-powered tutor, helps you understand difficult concepts, provides rationales, and gives personalized feedback to improve faster.
- Custom & Diagnostic Tests: Start with a diagnostic test to pinpoint your weak spots, then create custom tests for specific skills or topics. Ideal for focused review before the real exam.
- Detailed Explanations & References: Every question includes a detailed rationale and context so you can understand both theory and real-world application.
- Progress Tracking & Analytics: See your performance by topic, passing probability, and overall readiness score. Stay motivated with clear progress visuals.
**Designed for Future CNAs**
Whether you’re preparing for your first certification or brushing up on nursing skills, this app helps you study efficiently and pass with confidence.
Start Your CNA Journey Today! Download the CNA Practice Test app now and take the first step toward becoming a certified nursing assistant.
Note: CNA Practice Test 2025 Prep is an independent app and is not affiliated with any government entities.

Welcome to a new era of AI with our AI Image Generator, where we transform your imagination or ideas into the reality. Turn your text into stunning, creative images in just seconds!
Whether you are designing graphics for projects, creating thumbnails, product visuals, branding concepts, tattoo designs, wallpapers or simply exploring your artistic side Flux Kontext has everything you need. Perfect for influencers, graphic designers, product managers, or art lovers.
Key Features:
1. AI Image Generator: Generate artistic images from text prompts and style. It supports most famous art styles like Realistic, Anime, Cartoon, Oil Painting, Cyberpunk, Vintage, and more.
2. Trending Images: Find the most trending prompts or browse what other people around you are generating from Explore section.
3. Text to Image AI: It has been built with the support of powerful AI image generation models like Flux, Stable diffusions to meet the quality of images to convert text to AI based images.

How It Works:
1. Enter your creative idea as a text prompt or pick from trending topics.
2. Select a style and let the app bring your vision to life.

Download Flux Kontext and start your AI-Powered journey now.

Discover Your Destiny with Magic 8 Ball!
Are you ready to unlock the mysteries of the universe? The Magic 8 Ball is here to guide you, offering answers to your most pressing yes/no questions. Simply ask, shake your phone, and let fate unfold. Whether you’re curious about love, work, or life’s big decisions, the Magic 8 Ball is your ultimate guide to the unknown!
Features that make Magic 8 Ball magical:
• 13 Unique Themes: Immerse yourself in a world of wonder with 13 distinctive themes, each bringing its own special background music and sound effects. Choose from options like Valentine’s Day, Christmas, Halloween, Football, Yin-Yang, Snowman, Galaxy, Disco Ball, 8-Bit, and more. Each theme adds its own magical touch to your experience!
• Interactive Widgets: Want answers on the go? Add customizable widgets to your home screen and check your destiny without even opening the app!
• WatchOS Experience: Take the mystery with you on your wrist. With Magic 8 Ball for Apple Watch, simply tap your watch’s screen to ask your question and receive an answer.
• iMessage Fun: Share the magic with friends and loved ones! Send answers directly through iMessage, with the option to select from any of the app’s themes. Add a personal touch to your messages with fun and mystical answers!
Get ready to make every decision with confidence, and let the Magic 8 Ball reveal your path! Whether you're pondering your next move or seeking cosmic guidance, this app has all the answers you need. Let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00130828:ios.name: Stilla: Skincare Scanner
bluejetty:00130828:ios.summary:
Unlock the science behind your beauty routine with Stilla.
Scan any product to instantly reveal what's in it, how it might benefit your skin, and any potential irritants. Stilla empowers informed choices, whether you're a skincare beginner
bluejetty:00130828:ios.description:
Unlock the science behind your beauty routine with Stilla.
Scan any product to instantly reveal what's in it, how it might benefit your skin, and any potential irritants. Stilla empowers informed choices, whether you're a skincare beginner or a pro.
With Stilla, you can:
▸ Scan barcodes or search our extensive product database to find products that address your specific skin type and concerns.
▸ Discover new favorites and trending ingredients with our curated collections.
▸ Analyze ingredients directly from labels or pasted text. Stilla will break down confusing ingredient lists and explain what each ingredient brings to the overall product formula.
▸ Get personalized recommendations based on your unique goals, and optimize your routine according to your personal goals.
▸ Track problematic ingredients to avoid them (you choose which ones, we don't decide this for you!)
▸ Track expiration dates: Stilla takes into account each product's individual Period-After-Opening.
▸ Create custom routines and follow them with Live Activities.
▸ Sync all your data across devices with iCloud.
More ways Stilla helps:
• Organize your skincare collection: Bookmark your favorite products and keep track of everything in one place.
• Get exclusive insights: See star ingredients and Tracked Ingredient warnings.
• Verify marketing claims: Don't take promises at face value, let Stilla do the research.
• Siri & Shortcuts: Start routines and access features with voice commands.
• Customize your app: Choose an icon that matches your style.
Why choose Stilla?
› Shop smarter:
Scan labels while shopping for beauty products to find the perfect match for your skin.
› Revamp your routine:
Optimize your current skincare regimen for better results.
› Avoid irritants:
Identify common allergens and irritants that might cause reactions.
› Clean beauty made easy:
Track custom ingredients and find products that align with your values.
› Stay informed:
Be notified of product reformulations and get the latest ingredient info.
› Build a dream routine:
See how well a new product will fit into your existing routine.
› Learn as you go:
Discover the science behind popular ingredients and their benefits.
Stilla is an independent app created by just two people dedicated to making skincare information transparent and accessible. Our algorithms are not biased towards any brand and rely solely on scientific evidence behind each ingredient.
We care about your privacy: we do not use any trackers from Meta, Google, or any other advertising platform.
Terms of Service: https://stilla.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://stilla.app/privacy

bluejetty:00015692:ios.description:
Daily Short prayers are prayers you can pray on the go. This is not supposed to replace your prayer with our Lovely Heavenly Father but rather to give you the opportunity to pray when you don't have time on your hands because something came. As Christians we should make our lifestyle, a lifestyle of prayer. Prayer will take us from zero to infinity.
These are prayer models and will greatly help every believer in their prayer. There is a comment function that allows you to write your comment when you are blessed by it. The prayers can be prayed at whichever time you want but it does require the need for internet to be able to access the prayer images.
It will also help new believers who don't know how to pray. Share with new believers so they can learn how to pray. The prayers can be shared through social media and be a blessing to someone today.
These prayers came out of my communication with God and also listening to sermons all around the internet. Credit to all those who have sent their prayers to the website. We appreciate prayers we normally receive.
Features of this prayer application
1. Daily Prayer delivered to you
Each morning you will have one prayer delivered to your phone notification when it is enabled. The prayers are beautifully designed and have a nice background.
2. Archived prayers.
The prayers are stored in archive for easy access
3. Favorite a prayer
If you love a certain prayer and want to make it as favorite, it is possible to do so.
Download this prayer up and grow in the name of Jesus as a Child of the Most High God.

bluejetty:00026066:ios.description:
Speaker Cleaner removes water and dust from your iPhone speaker with sonic sound waves. Use Water Eject mode to push liquid out, clean trapped dust, and restore clearer sound in seconds.
Boost volume for a deeper clean, run low and high frequencies, and target your loudspeaker or ear speaker. Free to start — built for quick speaker cleaning, dust remover sessions, and water eject shortcuts.
The gentle vibrations produced by these sound waves effectively dislodge any unwanted particles. Our user-friendly app offers a range of features to enhance your audio experience, including the option to boost volume for particularly soiled speakers, the choice between low and high frequencies, and the ability to select the specific speaker you wish to clean, whether it's the main loudspeaker or the ear speaker. It's never been easier to enjoy crystal-clear sound.
Extra Key Features:
1. Stereo Test: Unleash the full potential of your audio setup with our Stereo Test feature. Ensure that your speakers are perfectly balanced and in sync. Whether you're enjoying music, movies, or games, this tool guarantees a captivating and immersive listening experience.
2. Beat Frequency: Get ready to groove to the rhythm of your music like never before. The Beat Frequency feature lets you fine-tune your speakers for exceptional bass and treble response. Whether you're a basshead or a treble enthusiast, you can now customize your audio to your heart's content.
3 Customization Options: With the Speaker Fixer app, you have the power to tailor your audio experience. Choose between low and high frequencies, and select the speaker you want to clean, whether it's your loudspeaker or ear speaker.
4.User-Friendly Interface: We understand the importance of simplicity and ease of use. Our user-friendly interface ensures that you can access and use these features with ease.
The app allows you to choose between cleaning the loud speaker or the ear speaker.

bluejetty:00084901:ios.summary: If you're serious about working on iOS, DEVONthink To Go is your document repository when you're not at your Mac. Collect, organize, edit, and annotate. Automate with Shortcuts. Keep your document collection always in sync between your Mac,
bluejetty:00084901:ios.description:
If you're serious about working on iOS, DEVONthink To Go is your document repository when you're not at your Mac. Collect, organize, edit, and annotate. Automate with Shortcuts. Keep your document collection always in sync between your Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Privately and securely.
DEVONthink To Go lets you take your important documents with you on your iPad or iPhone. Browse PDFs, notes, images, bookmarks, and just about any file type, neatly organized into databases and groups. View many types of them without opening them in another app.
Edit texts, Markdown files, or rich text documents, or open files in other apps if the built-in editing capabilities are not sufficient. Read web pages as if they were local documents.
Clip data from web pages or just any iOS app through the Share menu. DEVONthink To Go is also deeply integrated into the Files app so that your databases appear like a local file system to other apps. Save files, via Files and iOS’ file provider mechanism, directly to DEVONthink To Go. Use drag-and-drop both inside the app as well as with other apps.
Like DEVONthink for Mac, DEVONthink To Go offers many ways to organize your document collection. Sort documents into groups, add them to more than one group at a time without duplicating them, or add tags. Flag items, mark them as unread, or give them a star rating. Predefined smart groups show you, e.g., all your flagged or unread documents. Find what you’re looking for with fast full-text search.
Annotate PDFs with all common tools and annotation types. Rearrange pages, rotate or delete them. Run scans, PDFs or images, through the built-in, on-device text recognition (OCR) to make them searchable. Add links to your documents to all apps that take web addresses, e.g. OmniFocus or Apple Notes, or export your documents in their original file formats to the Files app and all other apps that support it.
DEVONthink To Go is best used with DEVONthink for Mac and on multiple devices. Synchronize your databases securely and privately over the local network or through a cloud service of your choice. You decide what data is synced, when, and where. Strong encryption makes sure that your data belongs to you, not to your service provider or us.
Shortcuts lets you automate repetitive tasks without becoming a programmer. Use DEVONthink To Go’s Shortcuts actions to integrate it with other apps. S

bluejetty:00027647:ios.name: iHunter
bluejetty:00027647:ios.summary: iHunter is Canada's all-in-one hunting app designed for hunters across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, & Labrador, Nova Scotia, and the Yukon Territories. The app is both free
bluejetty:00027647:ios.description:
iHunter is Canada's all-in-one hunting app designed for hunters across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, & Labrador, Nova Scotia, and the Yukon Territories. The app is both free to download and free to use.
Regulations are updated annually upon release by the respective provinces.
By overlaying hunting zones onto various base maps, users can easily determine their current location and the corresponding zone. Users can delve deeper into specific zones to view the open seasons for big game, predators, game birds, and small game. Additionally, they can add their own waypoints, tracks, and drawings to keep track of hunting spots, past harvests, and landowner contact information.
Features (Most functional offline):
• View Hunting zones overlaid on your choice of map.
• Multiple satellite, topographic, and road maps included which automatically caching for offline use.
• Add waypoints to the map at your current location, known GPS locations, or by tapping on the map.
• Log in to back up and synchronize waypoints and preferences across devices.
• Utilize the sunrise/sunset calculator to determine legal hunting light at your location or a waypoint.
• Share your current location with friends or family via email or text for easy location tracking requires internet.
• Display weather at your current location or a waypoint (requires internet).
• First Nations Reserve boundaries.
• Import waypoints and tracks from GPX, KML, and KMZ files.
• Track your position, speed, and altitude; draw over the map; search the map; view recently viewed and favourited items. (Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can significantly decrease battery life).
For each province, there are two subscription options to enhance the iHunter app:
With an iHunter Core yearly subscription, you will receive:
• Access to select hunting zones to view summaries of big-game, predators, game birds, and small game seasons (works offline).
• Ability to select regions of base maps and map layers to cache for offline use.
• Unlimited waypoints, tracks, and drawings.
• Capability to add your own TMS and WMS map layers.
• Wind condition display by location (requires internet).
• 3D base maps.
With an iHunter Pro yearly subscription, you will receive:
• All features included in the Core Subscription.
• CarPlay integration.
• iHunter layers in driving navigation for both CarPlay and in-app navigation.
• Additional public and private land layers. The available layers differ for each province. See https://www.ihunterapp.com/ for more information.
For more information, visit: https://www.ihunterapp.com/subscription-terms-of-use/
Other available purchases:
• Land Ownership Maps (AB): Over 60 county land ownership overlays ranging in price from $9.99 to $29.99 are available for Alberta.
• Land Ownership Maps (SK): Over 180 RM land ownership overlays ranging in price from $14.99 to $21.99 are available for Saskatchewan.
• Land Ownership Maps (MB): Over 70 RM land ownership overlays ranging in price from $14.99 to $44.99 are available for Manitoba.

bluejetty:00064095:ios.description:
Smart TV Remote is designed specifically to control Sony Smart TVs. The remote control app offers a wide range of buttons that are available on a physical remote control, an easy to use touchpad for navigation through the content and a list of apps installed on TV.
To control your Sony TV, make sure that your TV is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your mobile device. Launch Smart TV Remote app, select your Sony TV from the list of detected devices and enter the PIN displayed on the TV screen into the app. 
TV control has never been easier. The app features all the necessary buttons. You no longer have to look for your Sony TV remote control or buy a new one in order to replace the one broken down.
Multifunctional touchpad will allow you to easily scroll through the lists of new movies and music, choose your favorite content. 
With Smart TV Remote app you can easily launch apps installed on your TV, such as Netflix, Youtube or a web-browser. 
Smart TV Remote turns your iPhone or iPad into a smart remote control for your Sony TV.
Main features:
- Automatic detection of Sony TV in the Wi-Fi network;
- All the necessary buttons for controlling the TV (Sony TV remote);
- A large touchpad for convenient menu and content navigation;
- Launching of TV applications directly from the iOS app;
Premium Subscription
User can subscribe for unlimited access to Premium features. Subscribed users have unlimited use of the Interaction tab without ads.

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. For details please visit the link https://support.apple.com/HT202039. 
When current trial/subscription period expires, user will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After subscription expires, user will no longer be able to use Interaction tab.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00078845:ios.description:
Tractor GPS™ – Field Guidance
Tractor GPS™ is a GPS field guidance app for tractor and machinery operators, designed to support efficient agricultural fieldwork using an iPhone.
The app provides visual GPS guidance to help maintain consistent passes, reduce overlap, and improve efficiency during farming operations.
Tractor GPS™ is available via a subscription, which unlocks the full GPS guidance system and all features.
A 7-day free trial is included, allowing you to try the complete app before committing.
Why Choose Tractor GPS for iPhone?
• Cost-Effective Alternative
A software-based option compared with traditional tractor GPS systems, using an iPhone you already own.
• GPS Field Guidance
Visual guidance lines assist with maintaining accurate and consistent field passes.
• Easy to Use
Designed specifically for iPhone, with a simple interface and minimal setup.
• Portable Between Machines
Use the app across different tractors or machinery without installing fixed hardware.
• Regular Improvements
Ongoing updates enhance reliability, performance, and features over time.
• Operational Efficiency
More consistent passes can help reduce wasted time, fuel usage, and overlap.
Subscription Information
 • The subscription includes a 7-day free trial for eligible users.
 • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account after the trial, unless cancelled.
 • Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
 • Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store Settings.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00092850:ios.description:
Devi Loka brings spiritual seekers together in a vibrant and inclusive virtual community. Welcoming people from all walks of life, we are dedicated to rediscovering the ancient wisdom of the divine feminine (shakti), exploring its meaning in everyday life. Our community offers a rich and engaging community space for reflection and personal spiritual growth.
Devi Loka Features:
+ Practice & Reflection Tools: Explore a range of tools for contemplation and personal growth.
+ Online Spiritual Ceremonies: Take part in ceremonies held and shared by the community.
+ Monthly Teaching Themes: Topics from ancient knowledge, explored each month
+ Exclusive LIVE Teachings: Enjoy 24/7 access to teachings drawn from the tradition of the Divine Mother.
+ Collaborative Spiritual Journey: Engage with like-minded people across a variety of live activities, including private group sessions and chats, fostering a sense of community and shared growth.
+ Weekly Live, Virtual Teachings: Special online spaces dedicated to guided practice and meditation.
+ 5 Group Process & Meditation Events throughout the year
+ Personalized Guidance: Receive one-to-one guidance to explore your own practice and questions.
+ Small Group Sessions: Build deeper connections through close-knit group interactions led by other members.
+ Heartful & Soulful Exchanges: Engage in genuine exchanges and build lasting bonds with community members.
+ Private & Group Messaging: Stay in touch, share insights, and seek advice.
+ Round-the-Clock Resources: Always have a repository of teachings and tools at your fingertips, so you are never alone on your journey.
+ VIP Live Community Viewing: Exclusive spaces for members to gather during live ceremonies, teachings, and other events.
Devi Loka Benefits:
+ Personal Growth & Reflection
+ Daily Spiritual Nourishment
+ Continuous Learning
+ Community Engagement
+ Special Spiritual Events
+ Soulful Musical Experiences
+ Tailored Spiritual Guidance
+ Authentic Connections
+ Spiritual Support Always Available
+ Stay Connected On-the-Go
+ Exclusive Live Events
At the heart of our community are individuals dedicated to the Divine Mother with a profound desire to help and serve others. Aligning with shakti, the divine feminine, every member can find something they connect with. In this way, we support and uplift one another and serve the world around us. 
Devi Loka is a moderated community. Members can report content and block other members at any time, and all participants agree to our community guidelines.
-----

bluejetty:00022612:ios.description:
Free police scanner app with no subscription or account required. 5-0 Radio is the #1 most downloaded police scanner app since 2009. Use our crime radar to be the first to know about hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, shootings, riots, looting, protests, earthquakes, bombings, terrorist, radiation, nuclear fallout, outbreaks, biological or chemical attacks, and crime waves happening near you.
Tap into over 50,000 live police, firefighter, emergency medical ambulance, emt, air traffic control (ATC), airport, plane, railroad, trains, ham radio, NOAA weather, news, talk, sports, and music stations.
* 5-0 Radio is a Police Scanner app designed for Pros *
- Free to use without a subscription or any payment
- Live Captions (read what they're saying)
- Rewind a Feed and Share/Listen to Audio from the Past
- Record Feeds and Share Recordings via Email, AirDrop, Text, etc.
- More Feeds than Competing Apps
- Sleep Timer (turns off when you're asleep)
- Police Siren Noise Maker
- Access and Use Cool New Player Backgrounds
- Even more extra Airport/Railroad/NOAA weather/Radio/Scanner feeds
- Get new feature updates
+ More
As seen on ABC News, CNN, FOX News, New York Times, NPR, Wired, Yahoo! News, and various other major news organizations.
Listen to real events happening live in other parts of the world or in your local town. Listen to radio chatter in the background while you run other apps. Listen to new music as you surf the web. Share the stations you are listening to with your friends. They do not need to buy this app to listen to the feeds that you share with them.
* Features *
- "Past Recordings From This Feed" lets you access our archives and listen to past audio from the feed.
- You can rewind time and go back to an earlier time frame in a feed, even if you weren't actively recording the audio.
- “Feeds with Active Alerts” shows you feeds with interesting on-going activity happening right now along with a description of the alert and feed.
- Listen to feeds in the background while you run other apps or write emails/text messages.
- Chat with other listeners in real time.
- International support, including USA, Canada, Australia, UK, Mexico, Germany, Brazil, Malaysia, Thailand, Pakistan, Zimbabwe, Europe, Israel, and more.
- Automatically attempts to reconnect the feed if you lose the connection.
- Browse one of the largest collection of feeds you will ever find in the App Store.
- Search through the feeds with any keywords (enter your city name to find local radio stations).
- Browse through radio feeds by genre (Police, Railroad, Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, R & B, etc.)
- Customizable Interface. Download new skins for free or create your skins.
- Integrated map finds your location and the location of most scanner feeds.
- List the Top 100 most-current-listeners feeds so that you wouldn't miss an important event
- The catalog is instantly updated as soon as you start browsing it, with new feeds added every few hours.
- Built-in Web Browser; so that you can browse the web while using this app. The built-in web browser is a powerful browser that can block ads.
- Use the built-in web browser to browse the web for more feeds such as air traffic control feeds, weather, and railroad.
- Search for air traffic control feeds by the airport code (i.e. LAX, JFK, HKG).
- Share feeds to your friends by email. All they need is a computer or iPhone to listen to your feeds.
- Listen to feeds on your own desktop computer or laptop. Just email a link to the feed to yourself and open it with a web browser.
- You location not listed here? Add your own feeds. There are plenty of feeds on the internet. Now you can add them all to one app.
- Your favorite feeds show up as soon as you start the app, and they can be sorted/edited by you.
Feed Requests
For feed requests, go to https://SmartestApple.com for more information
Privacy Policy: https://smartestapple.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The following printers can be used with
bluejetty:00068049:ios.description:
Epson Print Layout is a high-quality print application for Epson printers from iPhone/iPad. Featuring convenient functions such as image layout, color setting, preview, etc., allows smooth printing.
The following printers can be used with this application.
SC-P700, SC-P900, ET-8500, ET-8550, L8160, L8180, SC-P5300
If you are using a printer other than the above, use Epson Smart Panel.
[Main Functions]
≪Search/connect printer≫
 - You can search for and connect to Epson printers in Wi-Fi networks to which your device is connected.
≪Printing≫
 - You can select photos and retouched images from your tablet for easy printing.
≪Layout setting≫
 - You can change the paper orientation, arrange and size images, and crop images.
≪Color setting≫
 - The color type "ICC Profile" allows you to print using a paper profile.
 - You can also print grayscale and monochrome photographs.
≪Print preview≫
 - You can preview your photos to take into account the ambient light they are displayed in. (Color temperature setting of ambient light does not affect printing results)
≪Management≫
 - You can check the status of the connected printer and check the remaining quantity.
≪Troubleshooting≫
 - You can check the manual from the system menu.

[앱 접근권한]
서비스 제공을 위해 다음과 같은 접근권한을 필요로 합니다. 
[필수] 위치 획득 권한
사용할 프린터를 식별해서 접속하기 위한 목적
[필수] 사진 및 동영상
저장된 파일의 인쇄 및 스캔을 위한 목적
[선택] 카메라
카메라로 촬영한 이미지를 인쇄하기 위한 목적
[필수] 로컬 네트워크
사용하는 프린터와 통신하기 위한 목적
* 선택 접근 권한은 동의하지 않아도 앱을 사용하실 수 있습니다.

bluejetty:00119789:ios.description:
【1111找工作APP】獲上萬名網友4.8星以上好評
全台百萬筆全職、打工、兼職、實習職缺一次找
本次更新升級 AI 履歷健檢，可依照目標職缺提供履歷建議；同時優化兼職／立即上工推薦設定、地址管理與履歷更新提醒，並新增更多公司環境及產品內容。
搭配 AI 小精靈、應徵匣以及各種AI等功能，讓找工作更快、更有效率。
滿足你的求職需求：
【全職工作】月薪45K起、無經驗可40K起、上市櫃/外商等
【打工兼職】時薪250+、假日&寒暑假、學校附近
【二度就業】離家近、月薪35K起等
【實習機會】科技業/服務業/網路等相關產業
智慧功能與貼心工具，陪你完成每一步求職
【AI履歷健檢】對準職缺，履歷更加分
選擇想應徵的職缺，AI 依照職缺需求來分析你的工作經歷、自傳與技能證照，提供專屬優化建議。
從選擇職缺、查看建議到接續應徵，都能在 APP 內順暢完成。
【兼職／立即上工推薦】設定更簡單，推薦更貼近
職類與地點設定全面優化，更快找到符合需求的兼職、打工與立即上工機會。
新增或修改地址改為獨立操作，離開前也會提醒儲存，操作更清楚、不怕資料遺失。
【履歷更新提醒】讓企業看見最新的你
履歷長時間未更新時，首頁、履歷列表與應徵流程會主動提醒。
提醒不影響履歷投遞，更新最新資料，增加被企業看見與聯繫的機會。
【公司資訊更完整】應徵前多了解一點
公司介紹新增環境、產品照片與影片，快速認識工作環境與企業特色。
職缺頁也會分類顯示相關內容，資訊更清楚、瀏覽更方便。
【七日自動再主投】幫你爭取第二次曝光
主動應徵後，如果廠商 7 日內尚未讀取，系統可依設定自動幫你再投遞一次。
不用手動追蹤，也能增加被企業看見的機會。
【語言證照管理】履歷資料更完整
語言能力可直接在 APP 內新增、修改、刪除證照與填寫分數。
不用切回網頁補資料，讓你的履歷內容更完整，也更容易展現專業能力。
【AI小精靈】你的找工作GPT
求職問題不知道該問誰？
讓 AI 小精靈隨時為你解答履歷、面試及求職大小事。
語音輸入優化為「按住說話」，降低背景噪音造成的中斷，使用更穩定、更好控制。
【打工兼職】個人化推薦
寒暑假工讀、假日兼職、學校附近等職缺快速篩選，高時薪打工更容易找到。
【立即上工】彈性安排工作
今天有空，明天就上工。
短期、彈性、快速找工作，時間由你做主。
【職缺資訊更清楚】聯絡企業更方便
職缺頁提供工作時段，瀏覽時就能確認班別是否符合需求。
若企業有提供 LINE ID，也可直接快速聯繫，減少來回溝通時間。
【語音通話】免留電話號碼更安心
看到感興趣的職缺，從 APP 一鍵撥通。
不需公開個人電話號碼，就能快速與企業聯繫。
【應徵匣】
想投的職缺，全都放進來。
喜歡的工作機會先收好，一鍵完成投遞。
【多國語系支援】
語言切換，一鍵完成。
繁中、英文、日文、越南文、印尼文語系，提供更多元、友善的求職體驗。
找到適合你的工作機會，立即下載 – 1111找工作APP！

bluejetty:00123647:ios.description:
Get your personal Keto diet plan with the YourKeto App. Take the quiz and start your journey to a healthier you with delicious food and a plan that fits your lifestyle.
Welcome to YourKeto, the app that makes sticking to your Keto diet goals easy and delicious. With YourKeto, you get a personalized diet plan tailored to your needs and preferences. Simply take the quiz to get started and receive a plan based on your favorite foods, daily activity, and personal measurements. Our portion sizes and calorie counts are based on your body and goals, ensuring that you get the right nutrition for your journey.
But that’s not all! With YourKeto, you can customize your diet even further by changing individual recipes or selecting only the best recipes for you. Our app includes over 150 easy-to-cook recipes, including tasty desserts, with step-by-step picture guides and top-up videos to make meal preparation a breeze. We also provide a grocery list for every week, so you can shop with ease.
With YourKeto, you’ll have everything you need to reach your goals and enjoy the journey. And the best part? Our app is affordable, with a price that’s nothing compared to the benefits you’ll receive. Plus, with our auto-renewable subscription, you can keep your personalized plan up to date and access new features as they become available. Payment is easy and secure through iTunes, and you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your account settings.
Start your journey to a healthier you with YourKeto today. Read our privacy policy and terms of use to learn more about our commitment to your privacy and security.

Terms of Use: https://usa.yourketo.diet/terms

bluejetty:00155992:ios.name: Hygiene Staffing - Find Jobs
bluejetty:00155992:ios.summary:
Hi! You’re a professional we’d love to work with because you’re smart! We know that because you took a great first step in the right direction, checking out the Hygiene Staffing app.
We’re more than just an app to find temporary and perman
bluejetty:00155992:ios.description:
Hi! You’re a professional we’d love to work with because you’re smart! We know that because you took a great first step in the right direction, checking out the Hygiene Staffing app.
We’re more than just an app to find temporary and permanent jobs; we’re changing the way the dental world works! Our trailblazing product gives you back what every professional is looking for: financial freedom and control over your career. How? Your new Hygiene Staffing app provides a platform to network directly with top-notch practices and allows you to create your own personalized career path. Take a look at how we empower professionals to be their own business!
Direct Requests
Receive direct job requests from preferred offices! To qualify, both you and the office must mark each other as preferred after a shift is completed. Build up your network of preferred offices to the point where you’ll never need to look for work on the job board.
Rate Offices
After each shift, rate offices based on their friendliness, cleanliness, organization, equipment and more.
Video Introduction
Introduce yourself to offices using our video introduction feature. After applying for a job, each office will have an opportunity to get to know you better!
Direct Messages
Build relationships with offices by messaging them directly. When applying for a job, feel free to add a note attached to your application. If needed, the office may initiate a conversation. Once a job is confirmed, you can directly message the office before and after the shift.
Negotiate Hours
When applying for a job, request a change in hours and select your preferred hours. Add a note to your application detailing your preference.
Auto-Confirmation
Apply at an office's hidden selected hourly rate and be confirmed on the spot! To qualify for an automatic confirmation, professionals must complete 5 jobs and maintain a 3.5-star rating or receive a direct request from a preferred office.
You’re here because you’re forward-thinking and always looking for new ways to enhance your professional portfolio. Those are the professionals we love to partner with, and why we are the #1 trusted jobs platform for world-class dental professionals.
When you download our app, and we’re confident you will, you’ll be tapping into a network that keeps you ahead of the curve. Upon acceptance, you’ll become part of an exclusive team that’s raising the bar for dental professionals.
If you have any questions, message the Hygiene Staffing team via messages > support within the app. We want to help!
We sincerely appreciate your partnership and look forward to a long and successful future.
Best Regards,
HYGIENE STAFFING

bluejetty:00077390:ios.description:
INFINITE Tunes, Talk, Sports, and Entertainment Radio!
CNET readers ranked ooTunes as #2 app overall! Thanks!
ooTunes is arguably the most comprehensive & extensive radio app in the App Store - www.iphoneappreviews.net
*New! Browse talk shows in Radio RooLette
*New! Universal/iPad version. Buy once, use it on all your devices!
*New! Airplay support! Stream audio to your Apple TV!
Its strongest asset [is] the large, global database of streaming radio stations - iLounge
One of Tech Digest's Top 10 Music Apps
Experience the pure enjoyment of the music and voices of the world at your fingertips!
Clean, crisp sound from over 38,000 Internet audio streams. Enjoy FM/AM live-broadcast from over 150 countries. Search the list at http://ootunes.com/stations
FREEDOM OF CHOICE
It is yours. Like Reggae? Listen to seven reggae stations in Jamaica. Classical? How about WFMT in Chicago, WGBH in Boston, Minnesota Public Radio, Radio Swiss in Bern or classical stations from Melbourne to Montreal, Strasbourg to Sydney?
Choose by genre (150 of them): Blues to Bollywood, Rap to Ragtime, Salsa to SKA, Talk to Techno. Find by country or cities of the world. Eavesdrop all over the world on local discussions, news and talk: even police calls. Left or right, listen to either side blather! Whether local or pro, catch the big game live, wherever you are.
TOTAL LISTENING PLEASURE
As your favorite songs play, savor full-screen album art*, bookmark for later, or pop over to watch it on YouTube, right in the app! Search and buy it right from iTunes. Automatic recording lets you hear it again and again!
INNOVATIVE RADIO EXPLORATION
Radio RooLette: See what's playing on 100's of stations at once. Tap to listen. It's that easy. A great way to skip commercials, find new stations, or sample a variety of music.
FEATURE RICH
Want to wake up to bedtime music from China? Set an alarm. Fall asleep listening, with a sleep timer. Record what you hear for a trip with no internet access. Find a song you hear on YouTube, all within one app. No other radio app has it all!
INFINITE OPTIONS
College stations, AM/FM stations, Shoutcast, weather, police, fire, aircraft and emergency radio, Live365, or live professional hockey games. Jam to 1000's of live concerts your parents wouldn't let you attend from the Live Music Archive at archive.org.
MULTITASKING
MP3 and AAC+ streams allow you to stream while using other apps, or use the app's own web browser to surf while you listen.
QUANTITY AND QUALITY
Fast searches. Quick connections. Easy navigation using "favorites," "recently played," "most played" or your own "custom categories."
• NEW Record what you hear to listen again even with no internet!
• NEW Fall asleep listening with a built-in sleep timer!
• NEW Set an alarm to wake up to your favorite station
• Automatically resume last station on start-up
• Automatically reconnect after network loss
• See "now playing" artwork*
• Schedule to record in the middle of the night
• Pause and resume live streams
• Play many streams in the background
• See what's playing right now on 1000's of stations
• Full VoiceOver support for the visually impaired
SUPPORT
Email help@ooTunes.com for our amazingly fast and friendly Customer Support. Check our reviews, we've made lasting impressions with phenomenal, personalized customer support.  Want a station not listed in our 38,000+ stations?  Let us know and we'll add it usually within a few hours.
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
Virtually every stream: .pls .m3u .asx rtsp mms mmsh rtmp hls http AAC+ MP3 WMA OGG Vorbis and many flash streams
* when available
With ooTunes you get infinite Tunes, Talk, Sports, Entertainment!

THE BEST DAILY SELF-CARE APP
Struggling with stress, mental health, or need motivation? Is self-care a chore? Finch makes self-care finally feel rewarding, lightweight, and fun. Complete quick self-care exercises to grow your pet, earn rewards, and improve mental health! People who struggle with mental health, goals, meditation, and journaling found it easier to be mindful with their self-care pet in the Finch app!
REVIEWS
- "I’ve tried other apps for being thankful and thinking positive but never used them long. I enjoy this one because the virtual pet is really cute and it takes just a moment to be honest about I really feel."

- Start mornings with quick mood checks and energize your pet to go exploring! Choose from a variety of quick mindful habits from goal tracking and bullet journaling to mindful breathing exercises and quizzes!
- End days in moments of gratitude with your self-care pet where they'll be back from adventures to share stories with you! Destress, reflect, and recognize your positive moments.
MINDFUL EXERCISES

- Goal Tracker: set goals and celebrate wins you've accumulated from healthy habits.
- Bullet Journaling: guided bullet journaling prompts to clear the mind, track important moments, and practice gratitude.
- Breathing: guided breathing to calm nerves, increase focus, energize your mind, and sleep better.
- Quizzes: quick quizzes to understand your mental health by tracking your anxiety, depression, body image appreciation, and more.
- Mood Tracker: check on yourself and access mood trends to understand what has been lifting you up or bringing you down.
- Quotes: read motivational quotes to lift your mood and gain new perspective.
- Sleep: Unwind yourself for good sleep with guided breathing and next day goal planning.
- Insights: get insights on your mental health from combined analytics on your mood tracker, bullet journal tags, goal tracker, and quizzes.

bluejetty:00157715:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157715:ios.description:
Becoming a mother can feel overwhelming. Canopie makes it possible to overcome the overwhelm by using 3 evidence-based techniques to help you build emotional resilience and mental confidence so that you can:
* soothe your anxious mind
* manage your stress
* show up as the parent, partner, and person you want to be 
Whether you’re struggling with low mood, diagnosed with a perinatal mood disorder like anxiety or depression, or just want to empower yourself with coping tools and mental strength-building techniques to get you through the inevitable ups and downs of motherhood, we can help.
Our curated sessions are personalized for your unique goals, using an expert-formulated and mom-tested blend of clinically-validated therapies proven to prevent and treat postpartum anxiety and depression. Every program will help you gain specific knowledge, tools, and skills to positively transform your behaviors so you begin to find inner calm in spite of the outer chaos that goes along with parenting. As you find relief from stress and anxiety, you’ll cultivate more patience, joy, and energy and see improvements in your life beyond your mood. 
Our sessions are designed with busy moms in mind. We know that worries, fears, and anxieties come at anytime, often when no one else is around or awake. We’re your companion, guide, and cheerleader 24/7.
Rooted in research, we lead with compassion. We’re therapy—on your terms. 
How Canopie’s SIGNATURE CORE PROGRAM works:
- You answer a few questions on your current mood and future goals.
- We curate a 12 day self-guided program to get you to where you want to go. Want better communication with your partner, more sleep, have more control of your emotions, feel less scattered? We’ve got you.
- You commit 12 minutes for 12 days to feel better.
**In a randomly controlled trial, 100% of our moms reported a positive change in their emotional health with Canopie.**
Other features with your Canopie membership:
COMMON CHALLENGE SESSIONS: 120+ mental health expert-created sessions—from 2-10 minutes—focused on navigating the most common parenting hiccups and triggers that affect our emotional and mental health such as:
- Sleep Deprivation
- Breastfeeding, Pumping, and other Feeding Difficulties
- Relationship Challenges
- Back-to-Work Transitions
- Baby Development Confusion 
UNIQUE CHALLENGE SESSIONS: These expert-created sessions guide parents and support their well-being through experiences that pose unique emotional and mental stressors such as:
- NICU Stays
- Traumatic Birth Experiences
- Birth with Multiples 
- Second Time Mothers
- Young Mothers
- DMER 
QUICK BOOSTS: Sometimes, you just need to hit the reset button. These express 2-5 minute sessions are targeted towards a specific mood to help you find equilibrium again. 
PERSONAL STORIES FROM THE CANOPIE COMMUNITY: Real Canopie moms and couples share their real life experiences—the good, the hard, and the really messy so you feel less alone. And get inspired by how they overcame their hardest parenting moments.
PROGRESS TRACKER & CHECK-INS: Our moms see the best results when they commit to consistently engaging in the program. Track your progress to celebrate all the good work you’re doing for yourself. 
JOURNAL PROMPTS: Our journal section allows you to release thoughts, feelings, and worries or reflect on progress that’s been made. 
ONGOING SUPPORT: We’re here for you every step of the way. Reach out to us to get connected with other resources or to request sessions we don’t yet have to better suit your needs.
Join thousands of new moms on their way to and download Canopie today to join thousands of new moms to start your 7 DAY FREE TRIAL.
Canopie is recommended by OBs/midwives, pediatricians, psychologists, and mental health experts. We’re proud to be an American Academy of Pediatrics STAR Center Resource.

bluejetty:00036536:android.summary:
Daily Quran is a thoughtfully designed app that brings the profound teachings of the Quran closer to Muslims around the globe, seamlessly integrating faith into the rhythm of modern life. 
Key Features:
📖 Read and Listen with Ease
Immerse
bluejetty:00036536:android.description:
Daily Quran is a thoughtfully designed app that brings the profound teachings of the Quran closer to Muslims around the globe, seamlessly integrating faith into the rhythm of modern life. 
Key Features:
📖 Read and Listen with Ease
Immerse yourself in the Quran like never before. Our app presents the original Arabic text alongside an official translation, all laid out in a clear and user-friendly format. For those new to Arabic, phonetic transliteration in Latin script ensures that everyone can engage with the Quran, making it accessible to Muslims from diverse linguistic backgrounds.
🌈 Learn with Tajweed
Each verse is enhanced with color-coded Tajweed markings, serving as a silent tutor to guide you in pronouncing every syllable accurately. This feature is especially beneficial for beginners, helping you master the correct rhythm and intonation, thereby deepening your spiritual connection and enriching your recitation experience.
🕌 Stay Connected to Your Faith
Never miss a moment of prayer. Our app allows you to easily find prayer times and the direction of Qibla based on your geographical location. Whether you’re traveling, at work, or in an unfamiliar place, you can stay connected to your faith with just a few taps.
🌟 Personalized Experience
Tailor your Quran journey to suit your preferences: 
- Bookmark your favorite verses 🔖 for quick access.
- Adjust font size 🔍 for comfortable reading.
Our intuitive interface ensures effortless navigation, allowing you to find and explore the surahs that resonate with you.
🤲🏼 Enhance Your Worship
Elevate your worship experience with features designed for your convenience: 
- Read and listen to the Quran anytime, anywhere, fitting seamlessly into your daily routine.
- Control audio playback for a smooth listening experience, allowing you to pause, rewind, or skip as needed.
- Resume reading from where you left off, ensuring a continuous and engaging experience.
- Switch modes effortlessly for a comfortable reading experience, whether day or night.
📿Stay Closer to Allah
Maintain a strong connection with Allah. The Tasbih feature allows you to conveniently engage in daily remembrance (Dhikr), such as سبحان الله (Glory be to Allah, who is Exalted), الحمد لله (All praise is due to Allah), and الله أكبر(Allah is the Greatest, beyond comparison). You can customize personal prayers, track recitation counts, and use reminders to help you stay closer to Allah in your daily life.
Embark on a Transformative Spiritual Journey
With Daily Quran, you are invited to deepen your understanding and connection to the divine. This app is designed to elevate your worship experience, making the teachings of the Quran an integral part of your life.

bluejetty:00045507:ios.summary:

EdgyChic Boutique and our sister company Kobi Ann Cosmetics, has been a lifelong dream! Who doesn’t want a storeroom full of clothes and
bluejetty:00045507:ios.description:
She is clothed with strength and dignity, and she laughs without fear of the future." Proverbs 31:25
EdgyChic Boutique and our sister company Kobi Ann Cosmetics, has been a lifelong dream! Who doesn’t want a storeroom full of clothes and lipstick? With God and a supportive husband by my side, my dream has finally come to fruition. 
Our Store and Cosmetic Line were born from a love of fashion, a need of creative expression on a larger scale, fear of complacency and a strong desire to create a new legacy for our family. After God, our family is the most important thing to us, especially our granddaughter, Kobi Ann. 
Our goal is simple~ Empower and Inspire "You" to express your own creative style through fashion. We want to bring confidence and happiness to a woman's day. Sometimes just having the right outfit is all a woman needs to turn a bad day into a good one, to give a woman the confidence she needs going into an interview or to give that stay at home mom a reason to smile after that rare moment she treats herself. 
Instead of choosing an education in fashion, I chose to get a Masters of Business Administration. I have over 20 years of retail and sales experience. I feel that the best lessons in life are learned through exploration and experience. January 2016, my employer of almost 20 years quit me and told me that my last day of work would 3/31/16. I had two choices at that point, to take the road most traveled or the road less traveled. I feared working for someone for the rest of my life more than anything in the world. 
In life, you choose either security or freedom and I wanted both. So, in those 90 days my husband and I plotted the store. We found a small store front and made the jump. We learned so much during our first year in business. It is hard to run your own business. There are no 9-5 hours here. It is literally at least 65-70 hours a week of nonstop working, but you are free. 
No doubt, it has been the most challenging and fulfilling experience of my life. A notorious workaholic, I live for my store and for helping my customers find that perfect outfit. You cannot walk in my store without seeing me in it. From the way EdgyChic looks to the clothes that are picked...my soul is on display. 
We are beyond grateful to have you shop with us and always want your experience to be a good one. No, a great one. I try on pretty much everything that we offer to give insight on items that run big or small (tough job, ha!). If we can ever assist you while shopping, you need an opinion, or have a question, please don't hesitate to email us at info@edgychicboutique.com or give us a call at 1-314-736-4440. We would love to hear from you. 
Much Love & Happy Shopping 
Angela, Chief Fashion Officer

Ahyl Music is a simple player for your own music files.
KEY FEATURES

Explore weekly, monthly, and yearly listening trends, compare daily averages with the previous period, and tap a bar to view a specific day or month. See your streak, total listening time, longest day, most played songs and artists, and times of day, plus a listening calendar.
Choose an auto-renewable yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Both options unlock the same PRO features. Each comes as a plan for iPhone and iPad only, or as a "+ Mac" plan that also works on Mac. Prices are shown in the app before purchase.

apple-macos:6779970822.name: Phrase: AI Meeting Note Taker
apple-macos:6779970822.description:
Phrase is an AI note taker for meetings, lectures, and voice notes on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. Record or import audio, get a transcript in 100+ languages and a clear summary, then edit any part of the note.
At work, meetings become notes with the decisions and to-dos. With Pro, Phrase adds them to Reminders and drafts the recap, and it asks first.
In class, lectures become study notes. With Pro, turn them into flashcards and quizzes.
FOR WORK
• Meeting notes and minutes: a summary, the decisions, and action items with owners and due dates when they're mentioned.
• Record in-person meetings, 1:1s, client meetings, interviews, and research sessions. It's bot-free: nothing joins your meeting.
• With Pro, ask Phrase to add action items to Reminders, put the next meeting on your Calendar, or draft a recap email or message. Phrase asks for your OK first and never sends anything on its own.
• With Pro, ask the assistant across all your notes, like "What did we decide about pricing?" Answers show the notes they came from.
FOR STUDENTS
• Lectures and classes become study notes: key ideas, terms and definitions, examples, and assignments.
• Turn a PDF, lecture slides, or up to 8 photos of the whiteboard into one organized note.
• With Pro, review with flashcards, quizzes, and mind maps made from your own notes.
USE IT FOR
Team meetings, 1:1s, client meetings, interviews, lectures, seminars, study groups, research, brainstorms, sermons and talks, voice memos, and audio or video files you already have.
AI NOTES YOU CAN ACTUALLY EDIT
Every note is a document you can edit, not a read-only summary. Retype a line, drag a section, check off to-dos, and add headings, colors, images, code, math, or diagrams. Undo any change. With Pro, ask Phrase to rewrite a section, see exactly what changed, and undo it in one tap.
CHECK THE SOURCE
The original stays attached. Play the audio with a timestamped, speaker-labeled transcript that follows along, and tap any line to jump to that moment. Phrase transcribes 100+ languages and keeps up when a conversation switches languages.
TURN NOTES INTO SOMETHING NEW
With Pro, ask for a slide deck, a one-page brief, a dashboard, flashcards, a quiz, or a mind map. Present decks on an external display or export them as PDF.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up and no Phrase account. Phrase is local-first: your notes live on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and with Pro they sync through your own iCloud. We never store your notes.
QUICK ANSWERS
• Does a bot join my meeting? No. Phrase records the room from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch.
• Does it work on Mac? Yes. Phrase is a native Mac app with the same features, recording included, and one subscription covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• How do I start recording fast? Jump straight to a new recording from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or Siri, or start one on Apple Watch.
• Do I need an account? No. There's no sign-up, and your notes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.
PHRASE PRO
Phrase Pro unlocks more AI notes from recordings and files, Ask AI, the assistant, flashcards, decks and other Artifacts, iCloud sync, and unlimited notes. AI features have usage limits. One subscription works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

fdroid:it.pviotti.readeck.name: Readeck
fdroid:it.pviotti.readeck.summary: A client for managing and reading saved articles with Readeck.
fdroid:it.pviotti.readeck.description:
Readeck is a free and open-source Android client for your Readeck server. Browse saved bookmarks, read articles, and keep content available offline. Text-to-speech lets you listen to articles in supported languages.
Optional article summarization can use an Azure OpenAI endpoint configured by the user. When used, article content is sent to that endpoint.
Requires access to a Readeck server.
